Title: Senior Design Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Design Manager to lead design initiatives for defense projects in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the design strategy, execution, and delivery of complex defense systems and components. You will manage cross-functional teams, ensure compliance with stringent defense industry standards, and drive innovation while maintaining the highest levels of precision and security. This position offers the opportunity to shape cutting-edge defense solutions and lead a talented group of design professionals.

* Lead and manage the design team, providing strategic direction, mentorship, and performance feedback to ensure excellence and professional development
* Oversee the complete design lifecycle for defense projects, from concept development through final delivery, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards
* Develop and implement design strategies that align with project objectives, regulatory requirements, and organizational goals
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, and risk mitigation to ensure successful project completion within scope and schedule
* Ensure all designs comply with defense industry standards, international regulations, and UAE-specific security and compliance requirements
* Collaborate with stakeholders, including engineering, procurement, and client representatives, to define requirements and resolve design challenges
* Conduct design reviews and quality assurance checks to maintain technical excellence and identify areas for continuous improvement
* Analyze complex technical problems and provide innovative solutions that balance performance, cost, and manufacturability
* Maintain detailed documentation and design records in accordance with defense sector protocols and security guidelines
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in defense design and project management

  
**Qualifications**  

* Minimum 12 years of professional experience in design management, senior design roles, or equivalent leadership positions within the defense industry
* Proven expertise in managing large-scale, complex defense projects from conception through delivery
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, or a related field
* Must be an Arabic speaker

  
**Additional Information**

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Title: International Analytics Manager

Title: Project Manager
Description:
Job Description

Project Manager, Infrastructure (UAE)

Role overview

We are hiring a Project Manager to lead the delivery of infrastructure projects across the UAE, from design coordination through construction handover, on time, within budget and to specification.

**Job title**

Project Manager, Infrastructure

**Department**

Projects / Engineering and Delivery

**Location**

UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah, with regular site visits)

**Reports to**

Projects Director

**Employment type**

Full-time, permanent

**Project types**

Roads and bridges, utilities (water, power, drainage), district infrastructure, marine or rail works

Key responsibilitiesPlanning and delivery

* Own the full project lifecycle: scope, programme, budget, procurement, execution, testing, commissioning and handover.

* Develop and maintain the project execution plan, baseline programme (Primavera P6 or MS Project) and work breakdown structure.

* Track progress against milestones, forecast delays early and agree recovery plans.

Cost and commercial control

* Manage the project budget, cash flow, variation orders, claims and final accounts.

* Review and approve contractor and consultant payment applications.

* Report cost forecasts and risks to senior management on a monthly basis.

Stakeholder and contractor management

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, main contractors and subcontractors.

* Secure permits and no-objection certificates (NOCs) from UAE authorities such as RTA, DEWA, ADDC, Dubai Municipality, Department of Municipalities and Transport, Etisalat and du.

* Lead progress, design and coordination meetings; resolve interface issues across disciplines.

Quality, health, safety and environment

* Enforce HSE standards in line with UAE regulations, client requirements and ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.

* Ensure works meet approved drawings, specifications and quality plans, including inspection and test plans.

* Investigate incidents and non-conformances and close out corrective actions.

Risk and reporting

* Maintain the risk register and run regular risk reviews.

* Issue weekly and monthly progress reports covering programme, cost, quality, safety and risks.

* Lead, mentor and review the performance of the project team.

Qualifications and experienceRequired

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

* 10+ years of experience in infrastructure project delivery, with at least 5 years as a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager.

* 5+ years of experience on projects in the UAE or GCC, with working knowledge of local authority approval processes.

* Proven record of delivering projects above AED 100 million, on time and within budget.

* Experience with FIDIC contracts and claims management.

* Valid UAE driving licence (preferred at hire, required within the probation period).

Preferred

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 certification.

* Master's degree in Engineering or Project Management.

* Experience with PPP, design-and-build or EPC delivery models.

Skills and competenciesTechnical

* Strong command of civil and infrastructure construction methods, specifications and UAE standards.

* Advanced programming and cost control using Primavera P6, MS Project and Excel.

* Contract administration: extensions of time, variations, claims and dispute avoidance.

* Familiarity with BIM coordination tools and document platforms such as Aconex or Procore.

Leadership and behavioural

* Decisive leader who builds accountable, multidisciplinary teams.

* Clear written and verbal communication in English; Arabic is an advantage.

* Negotiation and conflict resolution with clients, authorities and contractors.

* Sound judgement under pressure, with a strong safety-first mindset.

* Comfortable working in a multicultural environment and on site in UAE summer conditions.

What we offer and how to apply

* Competitive tax-free salary, with the package to be confirmed by the hiring team.

* UAE employment visa, Emirates ID and medical insurance for you and eligible dependants.

* Housing or transport allowance, annual flight ticket and end-of-service gratuity under UAE labour law.

* 30 calendar days of annual leave, plus public holidays.

* Training, certification support and a clear path to Senior Project Manager or Programme Manager.

To apply, send your CV and a cover letter to **admin@adcondxb.ae**

Pay: AED15,000.00 - AED20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Business Division Manager
Description:
***BUSINESS DIVISION MANAGER***
**Job Purpose**

* Lead and manage the business functions for the Beach Valves Project from concept development through project execution, ensuring effective project governance, planning and reporting, risk and change management, cost and schedule oversight, contracting and procurement support, and organisational readiness to enable safe, timely and effective delivery of the Project.
* The Business Division Manager is responsible for managing and integrating the business requirements of the Beach Valves Project throughout all project phases, from concept development through execution. The role requires close coordination across Major Projects functions, Operations, Engineering, Supply, Finance, Legal, P&D and other supporting organisations.
* Establishing and maintaining fit-for-purpose project governance, controls, reporting, risk, change, planning and business processes appropriate to the maturity and execution phase of the project.
* Supporting Project Management in managing interfaces, priorities, emerging risks and decisions within a brownfield operating environment involving multiple stakeholders and existing facilities.
* Maintaining alignment between the company, contractors and key stakeholders to support timely decisions and achievement of safety, quality, cost and schedule objectives.

**REPORTING & RELATIONSHIPS**

* Reports to Project Manager

+ Direct Reports: 4.

* Internal Stakeholders

+ Frequent contact with Project PMT.
+ Frequent contact within the Major Projects group and other departments such as Execution Planning and Services (EP&S), Legal, Supply, Operations, Finance, Other MP PMTs, and Shared Services.

* External Stakeholders

+ Frequent contact with the EPC contractor, their sub-contractors, vendors and other third parties during the execution of the project.
+ Frequent contact with Beach Valves project shareholders.

**KEY JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Project Business Management: Lead and manage the project business functions and associated activities, including project governance, reporting, risk, change management, planning, cost, contracting and procurement support to enable achievement of project objectives.
* Governance & Business Framework: Establish and maintain the project business management framework from concept development through execution, ensuring appropriate processes, controls and governance arrangements are implemented in accordance with company requirements.
* Performance Management: Drive project performance through the review and coordination of schedule, cost, risk, change, KPIs, management reporting and other performance indicators, escalating areas requiring management intervention.
* Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Manage the preparation and coordination of project management reports, presentations, decision papers, committee submissions and approval documentation to meet governance requirements and enable timely, informed management decisions.
* Project Management System Compliance: Manage compliance with the company Project Management System (PMS) through coordination of applicable gate requirements, deliverables, reviews, findings and close-out actions to demonstrate project readiness for progression through the applicable lifecycle gates.
* Risk, Issue & Change Management: Lead project risk, issue and change management processes, ensuring risks and changes are identified, assessed, communicated, tracked and appropriately escalated to support informed project decisions.
* Organisational & Resource Planning: Coordinate project organisational and resource requirements, including recruitment, manpower planning, organisation charts, facilities and support services to maintain appropriate project capability through the different phases of execution.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate business interfaces with Major Projects functions, Operations, Engineering, Supply, Legal, Finance, P&D and other Company organisations to facilitate timely decisions and resolution of Project issues.
* Contracting, Procurement & Commercial Support: Support project contracting, procurement and commercial activities through coordination of business requirements, change orders, management recommendations and interfaces with contractors, vendors and service providers to enable timely contractual and commercial decisions in support of project delivery.
* Compliance, Audits & Continuous Improvement: Monitor project business processes and procedural compliance, supporting internal and external reviews, audits, lessons learned and continuous improvement throughout project execution.

**PERSON SPECIFICATION - Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in: Business / Accounting / Commercial / Marketing / Sciences / Engineering / Project Management / Supply Chain Management / Law / Communication / Technologies / Mathematics / Statistics
* Knowledge & Experience

+ 12 years experience in a business-related function or discipline.
+ Including 8 years in the Oil & Gas Industry.
+ Including 3 years experience in a supervisory or acting role or oversight of contractor/subcontractor/service/vendor personnel.

* Technical & Business Skills

+ Strong knowledge in project business-related functions/disciplines such as planning, scheduling, cost control, estimating, claim management, risk management, change management, procurement, pre- and post-award contract management, actionable and informative reporting, support services, lessons learned, etc.
+ Extensive knowledge in international standards, best practices and methodologies as it relates to business disciplines.
+ Broad experience and demonstrated competence in managing a business function and disciplines, including contractors, cost and tenders.
+ Strong experience with risk assessment approach in decision-making.
+ Strong knowledge of relevant software and computer skills, e.g., dashboards, data analytics, SAP, etc.
+ Experience working in large-scale operating organisations in operations, projects, subsurface, etc.

Title: Senior Digital Project Engineer
Description:
Location: Doha, Qatar
  
  
Work Schedule: Standard office hours, 5 days a week.
  
  
**Job Purpose & Key Accountabilities**

* The Senior Digital Project Engineer in Conceptualisation shapes digital ideas into clear, viable, and delivery-ready initiatives. The role combines business analysis, stakeholder engagement, technical understanding, and digital consulting capabilities to help business teams define problems, assess opportunities, and prepare initiatives for successful delivery.
* The role leads and oversees early-stage discovery, requirements gathering, process and data analysis, value and cost framing, conceptualisation, definition of ready (DoR) assurance, and structured handover into use case delivery teams. This includes overseeing conceptualisation activities performed by third parties, ensuring that work progresses to plan, the appropriate activities are completed, stakeholders are engaged, and deliverables meet company and department quality and governance standards.
* The role also stewards the Digital idea backlog, ensuring opportunities are visible, prioritised, progressed, and governed through a consistent framework.
* The role requires sufficient Oil & Gas engineering, operational, and technical understanding to engage credibly with subject matter experts and assess engineering-focused opportunities while remaining capable of supporting digital opportunities across other business domains.

**Job Dimensions**

* Initiative Responsibility: Leads and oversees several opportunities at different maturity levels, from initial screening through to delivery handover, ensuring progress, quality, and alignment with the conceptualisation process.
* Facilitation and Coordination: Facilitates workshops, drives cross-functional discussions, aligns stakeholders, and coordinates Conceptualisation activities across business and DBS teams.
* Stakeholder Management: Engages a broad range of stakeholders across business entities, digital, DBS, and third parties. Builds relationships, manages expectations, resolves ambiguities, and navigates organisational processes to progress opportunities through the Digital lifecycle.
* Process Navigation and Governance: Maintains a strong understanding of company and department governance, demand management, procurement, cybersecurity, architecture, data governance, and delivery processes to ensure opportunities are progressed efficiently and through the appropriate pathways.
* Financial Responsibility: Develops and maintains initiative business cases, including cost estimation, income/spend forecasts, value assessments, and funding assumptions.
* Third-Party Oversight: Oversees Conceptualisation activities delivered by service contractors, ensuring agreed activities, milestones, and deliverables are completed on time and to the required quality. Reviews contractor outputs, provides direction and challenge, and ensures work remains aligned with company business needs, department processes, and delivery readiness requirements.

**Key Activities**

* Safety

+ Demonstrate the company Incident Free culture and HSE leadership behaviours.
+ Ensure project activities, deployments, and third-party work comply with all HSE guidelines.
+ Maintain psychologically safe team environments and promote transparent communication.
+ Ensure digital solutions contribute positively to safety and risk reduction.

* Cybersecurity

+ Apply the company's cyber security policies and department security standards to all project phases.
+ Coordinate cyber risk assessments, security architecture reviews, and threat modelling.
+ Ensure correct identity/access management, data handling, and data classification compliance.
+ Ensure vendors and partners meet NOC’s cybersecurity and data governance expectations.

* Opportunity Identification, Conceptualisation & Business Analysis

+ Act as a structured entry point for digital ideas and opportunities, supporting evaluation, prioritisation, and progression through the conceptualisation lifecycle.
+ Lead discovery activities with business stakeholders to understand problems, processes, pain points, data requirements, risks, constraints, and desired outcomes.
+ Facilitate workshops, interviews, and analysis activities to define business requirements, user needs, scope, value drivers, and success criteria.
+ Challenge assumptions, evaluate solution options, and assess process, data, technology, and organisational alternatives.
+ Coordinate Conceptualisation activities and prepare key deliverables including framing documents, requirements, value cases, roadmaps, prioritised functionality, and scopes of work.
+ Maintain visibility of the Conceptualisation portfolio and provide reporting on progress, priorities, dependencies, and resource demand.

* Delivery Readiness, Governance & Stakeholder Management

+ Coordinate Definition of Ready (DoR) activities and ensure initiatives meet agreed readiness and governance requirements prior to delivery.
+ Engage and align stakeholders across business entities, digital, DBS, and external partners to ensure initiatives progress effectively.
+ Navigate the company and department processes, including demand management, architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, procurement, and delivery governance.
+ Identify risks, issues, dependencies, and gaps, escalating where required.
+ Facilitate structured handover to delivery teams and support transition activities as required.
+ Prepare updates and reporting for management, governance forums, and steering committees.

* Third-Party Oversight and Quality Assurance

+ Define and communicate the expected scope, activities, deliverables, milestones, and quality standards for third-party-led conceptualisation work.
+ Oversee progress against agreed plans and ensure the appropriate discovery, analysis, stakeholder engagement, and governance activities are completed.
+ Review and challenge Conceptualisation outputs to ensure they accurately reflect business needs, technical context, requirements, value, costs, risks, and dependencies.
+ Provide direction and feedback, addressing delays, quality concerns, scope gaps, and unresolved decisions through corrective action or escalation.
+ Ensure outputs produced by third parties meet the definition of 'ready' requirements and provide a complete, coherent, and usable handover to Delivery.

* Costing, Value & Commercial Support

+ Develop and maintain cost estimates, forecasts, value assessments, and funding assumptions throughout the conceptualisation lifecycle.
+ Lead business case development, demand reviews, planning activities, and procurement processes.
+ Coordinate with Finance, Cost Control, Contracts and Procurement, delivery teams, and vendors to validate estimates, assumptions, and commercial inputs.
+ Maintain visibility of budget, commitment, forecast, and cost-related information for assigned initiatives, escalating risks and variances where appropriate.
+ Support Contracts and Procurement to review and challenge vendor proposals, effort estimates, and resource assumptions to support informed decision-making and investment prioritisation.

**Qualifications, Experience & Skills - Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in petroleum engineering, data science, computer science, or information systems.

+ Business Analysis, Project Management, Agile, or Change Management certification is preferred.

* Minimum Experience

+ Minimum 6 years’ experience in digital product development, digital transformation, or engineering/technology-enabled improvement.
+ Demonstrated success delivering digital products, ideally in the energy or industrial sector.
+ Experience in digital transformation within O&G is highly desirable.
+ Demonstrated experience working with engineering, operational, and technical stakeholders to understand complex requirements and shape digital or technology-enabled solutions.
+ Experience within Oil & Gas, energy, industrial, or other asset-intensive environments is highly desirable.
+ Experience overseeing work performed by third parties, service contractors, or multidisciplinary delivery partners, including reviewing progress, quality, and deliverables.

* Technical & Job Specific Skills

+ Ability to engage effectively with both business and technical stakeholders, translating operational needs into structured digital opportunities and requirements.
+ Sufficient understanding of engineering, operational, and business processes, with the ability to rapidly develop domain knowledge and challenge assumptions constructively.
+ Strong understanding of modern digital delivery practices, including Agile methodologies, SDLC, and product-based delivery.
+ Familiarity with cloud and digital platforms (e.g., Azure) and enterprise technology landscapes.
+ Experience with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Azure DevOps.
+ Understanding of data platforms and digital ecosystems (e.g., OSDU, Cognite Data Fusion, data lakes, and analytics platforms).
+ Awareness of AI, generative AI, automation, and data-driven solutions, with the ability to identify opportunities and assess applicability to business challenges.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with attention to detail.
+ Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
+ Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
+ Ability to influence, challenge constructively, and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
+ Fluent in English.

Title: Manager, Client Engagement (1 year contract)
Description:
**Our Company**

BrandActive specializes in the financial analysis, strategy, and logistics of rebrand implementation. Since 1998, we’ve helped many of the world’s most valuable brands plan, budget, and implement brand change—optimizing spend, improving efficiency, and reducing complexity along the way.

  

Our work combines industry-leading analytics with a proven methodology to help clients make smarter decisions, save time and money, and get more value from their brand investments—whether they’re navigating a major rebrand or managing their brand day to day. You can explore examples of our work in our case studies.

  

At BrandActive, we’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive workplace where people can do their best work and grow together. We strive to set the global standard for excellence in our industry while fostering a culture rooted in trust, agility, and growth —guided by our North Star: great people, doing great work, and having a great time doing it.

  

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to a Director, the Manager serves as the project lead and is accountable for strategic planning, project formulation/scoping, scenario planning, cost estimating and relationship management that supports the conversion of the client’s branded assets to a new identity/logo. The Manager then oversees the project as it moves into subsequent implementation and roll-out phases while ensuring that the client’s needs are met.

  

To fulfill these responsibilities, the Manager typically works directly with clients at senior levels of the organization including the C-suite. When conditions safely permit, travel between North America and internationally may be a requirement.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Strategy/Analytics**

* Consult with clients about all elements for project scope and delivery, providing a high-level of expertise and instilling confidence in the client.
* Work with the client and BrandActive’s team to define the scope of brand transition across all branded asset categories (e.g. signage, ID badges, website, etc.)
* Develop several high-level scenarios to achieve brand launch and completion objectives using cost, time, quality and impact as the key variables.
* Provide senior leadership and their Board the information they need to make fiscally responsible brand decisions.
* Establish high-level transition strategies by branded asset category with priority given to those categories which are required for brand launch and have longer lead times.
* Formulate and comprehend overall implementation financials and to evaluate the implications of alternative strategy approaches on these financials at a macro and micro level.
* Develop cost estimates based on developed transition strategies.
* Define the high-level processes required to support an efficient implementation process.
* Create a high-level project communications plan to ensure engagement of all project constituents.
* Define the project organization required to execute the brand transition in a way that ensures achievement of client goals and desired outcomes.

  

**Project Management**

* Lead the project team, allocating and utilizing resources in an efficient manner and maintaining a co-operative, motivated and successful team.
* Communicate project status regularly (e.g. using dashboard reports) and escalate issues to stakeholders, sponsor(s), and senior leadership as required.
* Manage project deliverables in line with approved project plans.
* Manage or coordinate partners and work groups engaged in project delivery.
* Lead internal projects and client-facing (or conference call) meetings.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans (following PMI methodologies).
* Record, track and manage project issues and risks, escalating concerns when necessary.
* Manage project scope and change control.
* Monitor project progress and performance.
* Monitor the project budget.
* Create and present deliverables, and facilitate approval of recommendations.
* Review and provide guidance with new statements of work with current projects.
* Manage the creation of change orders with direction from the Director.

  

**Professional Development**

* Own your growth by setting and updating development goals, actively seeking feedback, and aligning your aspirations with business goals.
* Contribute to internal initiatives that impact the client and/or team member experience such as our Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion Advisory Committee, Community Impact Committee, or our Social Committee.
* Bring forward smarter, faster, better solutions to processes and identify opportunities to be more agile in day-to-day activities.
* Demonstrate inclusive and supportive behavior, contributing to BrandActive’s core values of trust, agility, and growth, commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion, (EDI), humanity, and wellbeing.

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

You might not tick every box, but if you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about the role, we’d love to hear from you. We value potential, curiosity, and a growth mindset.

  

**Education and Experience**

* Demonstrated commitment to life-long learning; post-secondary degree, diploma or certificate preferred.
* Three to four years of project management experience with at least two years as the Project Lead (managing projects from start to finish).
* Strong consultative skills gained through experience working as an internal consultant or in a professional services environment.

  

**Competencies**

* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Superior organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity including the ability to handle multiple tasks under pressure across more complex/multi-faceted projects.
* Presence including the ability and confidence to manage client calls.
* Proven credibility gained by consistently delivering on commitments.
* Demonstrated ability move across a range of projects and clients over time.

Title: Senior Solution Architect - Core Networks
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
At Capgemini Engineering, we are shaping the future of mission-critical connectivity across the globe. Our Connectivity & Network Engineering teams are at the heart of next-generation telecom transformation, delivering resilient, secure, and scalable core network platforms for some of the most demanding environments in the world. In Al-Khobar, we are growing our team of senior technical leaders who can own architecture decisions, drive multi-vendor integration, and lead high-performing engineering teams. If you are a seasoned core network architect who thrives at the intersection of technical depth and strategic leadership, this is the opportunity for you.
  
  
We are looking for an exceptional
**Lead Core Network Architect**
to own the architecture and technical leadership of mobile core networks for private mission-critical connectivity platforms. You will define end-to-end core architecture strategies, lead complex multi-vendor integrations, and serve as the principal technical authority across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS domains — ensuring every solution is resilient, scalable, and built to the highest standards of carrier-grade reliability.
  
  
In this role you will play a key role in:
  
  

* Architecting and owning end-to-end mobile core network solutions across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS domains, including subscriber management, policy and charging frameworks, and gateway functions, ensuring carrier-grade resilience and scalability for mission-critical private network environments
* Defining comprehensive core network architecture strategies including capacity planning, redundancy models, and geo-resilience designs, translating complex SLA requirements into robust, future-proof technical solutions that meet the highest standards of availability and performance
* Leading multi-vendor integration across RAN, transport, OSS, MCX, and security domains, managing technical interdependencies and ensuring seamless end-to-end interoperability across the full network stack in large-scale deployment programs
* Producing high-quality High Level Design (HLD) and Low Level Design (LLD) documentation, operational runbooks, and technical reference architectures, ensuring that all solutions are thoroughly documented and ready for operational handover
* Driving vendor technical and relationship management, acting as the primary technical interface with key technology partners, evaluating vendor capabilities, influencing roadmaps, and ensuring alignment with program objectives and customer requirements
* Leading customer engagement activities at a senior technical level, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders, presenting architectural recommendations with clarity and confidence, and translating complex technical concepts into business-aligned outcomes
* Managing and mentoring the core network engineering team, providing technical guidance, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, and developing the next generation of core network talent within the organization
* Supporting deployment, performance optimization, and acceptance activities, providing hands-on technical leadership throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure every solution meets design intent, performance benchmarks, and operational readiness criteria

Your Profile
  
  
We are looking for a technically exceptional and strategically minded core network leader who brings deep domain expertise, proven delivery experience, and the gravitas to lead in complex, high-stakes environments.
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in telecom core network architecture, with a strong and demonstrable background in mission-critical network environments and a proven track record of leading large-scale, complex core network programs from architecture through to deployment
* Deep technical expertise across EPC, 5G Core, and IMS technologies, including thorough knowledge of subscriber management, policy and charging systems, gateway functions, and the end-to-end mobile core architecture in both standalone and non-standalone 5G configurations
* Extensive experience leading large-scale, multi-vendor core network deployments, with the ability to manage complex technical interdependencies, drive vendor alignment, and ensure seamless integration across RAN, transport, OSS, MCX, and security domains
* Strong proficiency in IP networking, routing protocols, and security controls, with the ability to design and validate transport and security architectures that underpin mission-critical core network platforms with uncompromising reliability
* Demonstrated ability to translate SLA requirements into robust technical solutions, with experience producing HLD/LLD documentation, operational runbooks, and capacity and geo-resilience strategies for carrier-grade network environments
* Proven senior stakeholder management and customer engagement skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at executive level, influence architectural decisions, and communicate complex technical strategies with clarity and authority
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities, with experience building, guiding, and mentoring core network engineering teams in fast-paced, multicultural, and high-pressure delivery environments
* Experience working in or with KSA-based telecom operators or service providers is highly advantageous, with familiarity of the regional deployment landscape, operational expectations, and the strategic connectivity priorities aligned to Vision 2030

**What You'll Love About Working Here**

* Career acceleration programs — From associate to leaders and beyond, get support in your career at every stage with award-winning programs such as our leadership development program, Connected Manager, to accelerate your growth and develop your expertise.
* Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services — Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleashing their R&D potential to develop smart products and services of tomorrow.
* Dedicated innovation labs — We help the world's largest innovators engineer the products and services of tomorrow by leveraging our experts and labs, dedicated to topics as 5G, 6G, AI, Autonomous Vehicles and Quantum.

Title: Director of Retention Marketing
Description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.

We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**

Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**

We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
* **Email, SMS and lifecycle:** own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
* **Post-purchase experience and loyalty:** ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
* **Customer experience and support:** lead the Customer Experience Manager, own the weekly CX KPI scorecard (CSAT, first response time, AI resolution rate, refund rate and chargebacks), set customer service policy, and grow 4- and 5-star reviews.
* **Retention data and reporting:** track cohort retention, repeat purchase rate and lifetime value by brand and channel, report retention KPIs weekly, run a monthly retention review with the CEO, and write the retention playbook as SOPs so it runs without one person.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with our CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final Interview with our CEO

**Salary Expectation**

USD $115,000 to $145,000 a year (based on experience and expertise) + performance bonus of 15-20% of base after the trial period.

Title: Marketplace Operations & Partnerships Manager
Description:
**About NEEZO**

NEEZO is a UAE-based family lifestyle and services platform connecting families with children’s activities, experiences, products, and services. We are seeking a proactive manager to build and grow our marketplace partner network in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Vendor Acquisition & Business Development:** Identify and approach kids’ activity centers, play venues, sports academies, education providers, attractions, and family service businesses. Pitch NEEZO, negotiate commissions and offers, and manage the prospect pipeline.

**Vendor Onboarding & Marketplace Launch:** Own onboarding from signed agreement to live listing. Collect descriptions, images, prices, schedules, availability, and booking policies; coordinate account setup, quality checks, training, and launch.

**Partner Relationship Management:** Act as the main point of contact for vendors; resolve operational issues, maintain regular communication, update listings, and secure seasonal promotions and new offerings.

**Marketplace Operations & Performance:** Monitor listing accuracy, availability, booking readiness, partner engagement, and fulfillment issues. Work with product and marketing teams to improve conversion and vendor performance.

**Strategic Partnerships:** Develop relationships with nurseries, schools, parent communities, event organizers, and family-focused brands; pursue exclusive offers and co-marketing opportunities.

**Requirements**

**Experience:** 3–5+ years in marketplace operations, vendor acquisition, partnerships, account management, or business development; UAE experience preferred.

**Industry Knowledge:** Experience with activity booking, kids’ services, education, entertainment, hospitality, or lifestyle marketplaces is a plus.

**Skills:** Strong sales, negotiation, communication, organization, CRM/spreadsheet skills, and ability to work independently in a startup.

**Languages:** Fluent English required; Arabic is a plus. UAE driving license preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**Acquisition:** Qualified vendors approached, new agreements signed, and partnership pipeline.

**Activation:** Vendors fully onboarded and accepting bookings; onboarding turnaround time and activation rate.

**Marketplace Health:** Number and quality of live listings, vendor engagement, retention, bookings, and GMV.

**What We Offer**

**Opportunity:** Build a fast-growing family marketplace in the UAE with significant ownership of partnerships and operations.

**Compensation:** Competitive salary plus performance-based incentives and growth opportunities.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV and a brief summary of your vendor acquisition, marketplace operations, or partnership development experience.

Title: Test & Commissioning Manager (Qatar-based, 6-month contract, extendable)
Description:
**Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced Test & Commissioning Manager to own the end-to-end testing lifecycle of complex, multi-domain technology programmes. The role covers test strategy, planning, execution and go-live readiness across software, AI, infrastructure, network, OT/SCADA and cybersecurity, while coordinating internal teams, customers and third-party vendors. This is a hands-on leadership position requiring strong technical breadth and customer-facing delivery experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the test and commissioning strategy, master test plan, schedule, entry/exit criteria, environments and reporting cadence
* Lead test planning and execution across system integration, UAT, operational readiness, performance, resilience, security and commissioning
* Run workshops with technical leads and customers to define requirements, acceptance criteria, operational scenarios and test cases
* Coordinate test resources, environments, data, tools and vendors; manage risks, issues, defects and retesting through to closure
* Establish quality gates, requirements traceability and sign-off packs; provide go/no-go recommendations based on readiness and residual risk
* Manage and coach test engineers and specialist partners, ensuring consistent methods and documentation quality
* Coordinate VAPT activities across remote sites, on-premises, cloud and applications, including evaluation and selection of third-party testing vendors
* Align test activities with domain project managers to meet the programme schedule
* Report status, defects and risks to programme leadership and customer stakeholders

**Technical domains covered:**

* Software: API, cloud, web application and end-user scenario testing
* AI: LLM testing, ML model validation, video analytics testing
* Performance: load, stress and reliability testing (Master SCADA/OT, web applications, Azure)
* Network & WAN: NOC testing, passive and active ICT infrastructure
* IT infrastructure: monitoring solutions and service deployment validation
* Cybersecurity: VAPT management

**Qualifications/Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field (equivalent experience considered)
* 8+ years in testing, QA, systems integration or commissioning, including 3+ years leading complex test programmes or teams
* Proven ownership of end-to-end test strategy and execution across multiple technical domains, ideally in enterprise, public-sector, critical infrastructure, OT/SCADA or large-scale cloud environments
* Strong test management, defect management, requirements traceability, risk-based testing and sign-off experience
* Working knowledge of API, web, cloud, performance, network, infrastructure and cybersecurity testing, with the ability to lead domain specialists
* Experience working with customers, system integrators and third-party vendors in structured delivery programmes
* Excellent communication, workshop facilitation, prioritisation and decision-making skills

*Preferred:*

* Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Test Manager, ISEB, PMI, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum; security certification such as CISSP, CISM or CEH
* Azure testing, CI/CD, test automation and tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Postman, JMeter, LoadRunner, k6
* AI/ML evaluation, LLM risk controls, computer vision/video analytics or responsible AI assurance
* OT/SCADA, NOC operations, ICT infrastructure, VAPT coordination or regulated/mission-critical environments

Title: Senior Manager Projects
Description:
**About the role**

Lead QAS Cargo’s end-user oversight and operational integration for Cargo Terminal 2 (CT2), providing the senior point of accountability across operational requirements, delivery interfaces, systems integration, testing, operational readiness, handover and transition into service.

Head the dedicated QAS Cargo CT2 project team and protect the integrity of the approved operating solution by ensuring the facility, Material Handling System (MHS), technology, processes, people and operational arrangements are integrated, validated and supported by sufficient evidence for operational acceptance and go-live.

*Contract Duration: 3 years*

**Responsibilities**

Strategic

* Lead the QAS Cargo CT2 delivery strategy and end-user governance framework to maintain clear ownership, timely decision-making and alignment between project outputs, cargo operating requirements and business objectives.
* Translate QAS Cargo’s strategic capacity, service, automation, safety and operational objectives into clear project priorities to ensure CT2 can support the intended operating model and future cargo growth.
* Provide senior end-user advice to the Vice President QAS Cargo and relevant governance forums on operational impacts, integration risks, readiness status, critical decisions and emerging threats to successful entry into service.
* Oversee the integration of CT2 with the existing QAS Cargo operation, Cargo Terminal 1 and the wider HIA operating environment to support business continuity and a controlled transition to the future operating model.

Operational

End-User Project Leadership

* Act as the senior QAS Cargo representative for CT2 and head the dedicated QAS Cargo project team, setting priorities, delegating accountabilities and ensuring operational assurance activities, decisions, deliverables and escalations are completed in line with the approved project programme and governance requirements.
* Maintain an integrated view of construction interfaces, MHS, IT and automation, operational processes, project controls and ORAT to identify cross-workstream dependencies and prevent isolated decisions from affecting the overall operational outcome.
* Establish structured QAS Cargo assurance, decision and escalation processes to ensure execution-stage matters from the Major Projects Department (MPD), Project Management and Construction Management (PMCM) consultant and delivery parties are directed to the appropriate operational owner and resolved within required timeframes.

Operational Requirements and Delivered-Solution Assurance

* Maintain senior oversight of the approved QAS Cargo operational-requirements baseline and associated traceability arrangements to verify that operational requirements are addressed through construction, installation, systems configuration, testing, commissioning, handover and transition.
* Ensure significant operational departures from the approved solution are supported by documented impact assessments covering safety, security, functionality, capacity, productivity, maintainability, staffing, training, business continuity, readiness and whole-life operational implications.
* Endorse the consolidated QAS Cargo operational position on material changes and unresolved delivery matters before formal communication or escalation through the approved project governance route.
* Ensure the dedicated QAS Cargo CT2 team verifies the delivered solution through progressive inspections, system demonstrations, testing, commissioning evidence, operational trials and readiness reviews.
* Determine when unresolved operational matters require executive intervention, formal risk acceptance, conditional acceptance or recommendation against handover or go-live.



MHS, Technology and Process Integration

* Oversee end-to-end operational integration across the base building, MHS, cargo applications, screening systems, IT infrastructure, Cool Chain facilities, security systems, operational processes and relevant airport systems.
* Ensure MHS and technology outputs are aligned with QAS Cargo process requirements, ConOps, exception-handling arrangements, recovery procedures and required operating performance.
* Direct coordinated end-user participation in system demonstrations, factory and site acceptance activities, integrated systems testing, commissioning, operational simulations and trials to verify end-to-end operational performance against approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with the Manager IT Integration – CT2 and Manager Delivery Integration– CT2 to resolve cross-functional dependencies and ensure systems, processes, people and facilities progress toward a single operational outcome.
* Ensure proposed system workarounds or manual fallback arrangements are not treated as permanent operating solutions unless their operational, safety, staffing, capacity and business-continuity implications have been formally assessed and accepted by the appropriate authority.

Stakeholder and Interface Management

* Lead QAS Cargo’s project interface with MPD and the PMCM while preserving clear accountability for asset delivery, contractor management, design coordination, site supervision, quality assurance, commercial management and contract administration.
* Coordinate QAS Cargo engagement with Qatar Airways Cargo, QAS Cargo Operations, MATAR Facilities Management and Operations, IT, Security, Safety, Customs, MOI, QCAA and other relevant authorities and stakeholders.
* Chair QAS Cargo project-delivery and integration forums to maintain action ownership, resolve cross-functional issues and escalate decisions that cannot be resolved at working level.

Programme, Change and Risk Oversight

* Review integrated schedule, cost, risk and performance information provided through the Senior Manager Project Controls, MPD and appointed consultants to assess implications for QAS Cargo deliverables and operational readiness.
* Ensure QAS Cargo dependencies, approvals, training, recruitment, process development, testing, trials and transition activities are incorporated into the integrated project schedule.
* Identify and maintain oversight of QAS Cargo operational, integration, readiness and business-continuity risks, ensuring owners and mitigation actions are assigned and regularly reviewed.
* Maintain senior oversight of decisions and unresolved matters that could result in operational rework, deferred scope, reduced capacity, increased manpower, additional operating cost or reliance on temporary arrangements.
* Escalate any proposed acceptance of incomplete, non-compliant or operationally constrained outputs where the residual risk or business impact exceeds delegated authority.
* Perform other department duties related to his/her position as directed by the Head of the Department

* Minimum 10 years of job-related experience, including substantial senior responsibility for complex projects, programmes or operational transformation.
* Demonstrated experience representing an owner, operator or end user on a major airport, air-cargo terminal, logistics, automation or comparable complex infrastructure programme.
* Significant experience leading the execution, systems integration, testing, commissioning, operational readiness, handover and transition phases of a complex infrastructure, airport, cargo, logistics or automation programme.
* Expert working knowledge of air-cargo terminal operations, including cargo flows, special products, screening, automated handling, safety, security, operational continuity and interfaces with airlines, authorities and airport stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience with automated MHS and its integration with buildings, IT systems, operational processes and supporting infrastructure.

Title: Manager Delivery Integration
Description:
**About You**

Manage the day-to-day integration and operational validation of Cargo Terminal 2 (CT2) delivery outputs on behalf of QAS Cargo, within the governance and priorities established by the Senior Manager Projects – CT2, ensuring the facility, Material Handling System (MHS), technology, processes, people and operational arrangements are aligned with approved end-user requirements and collectively prepared for safe and effective operations.

Coordinate QAS Cargo’s end-user assurance, Concept of Operations (ConOps) and operational-readiness activities across the dedicated CT2 project team, translating approved priorities into integrated actions covering operational validation, systems testing, trials, handover and transition into service. Lead the Senior Project Officer and Cargo Process Improvement Specialist in converting project outputs into an integrated, executable and operationally ready air cargo operation.

*Contract Duration: 3 years*

**Responsibilities**

Strategic

* Develop and implement the QAS Cargo Terminal 2 (CT2) delivery-integration and operational-validation framework, within the governance and priorities established by the Senior Manager Projects – CT2, to provide a consistent approach across facility, Material Handling System (MHS), technology, process, people and operational-readiness workstreams.
* Translate the Senior Manager Projects' strategic priorities into integrated workstream plans, review cycles, readiness activities, decision requirements and team actions to maintain alignment across the dedicated QAS Cargo CT2 team.
* Identify cross-workstream dependencies and integration risks that could affect safety, operational functionality, capacity, maintainability, business continuity or readiness and coordinate timely resolution or escalation.

Operational

Delivery Integration and Coordination

* Lead the day-to-day integration of QAS Cargo activities across facility and construction interfaces, MHS, technology, operational processes, project controls and Operational Readiness and Airport Transfer (ORAT) to ensure parallel workstreams collectively support the approved CT2 operational outcome.
* Develop and maintain an integrated QAS Cargo delivery and readiness plan covering end-user assurance activities, operational decisions, dependencies, execution-stage deliverables, testing, commissioning, trials, training, handover and transition requirements.
* Maintain an integration and operational-interface register identifying dependencies, operational impacts, accountable workstream owners, required decisions, target resolution dates and escalation status.
* Lead working-level integration meetings and workshops to align facility, MHS, IT, processes, people and readiness activities and resolve matters that cross individual workstream boundaries.
* Escalate unresolved integration matters, conflicting requirements and material operational impacts to the Senior Manager Projects – CT2 with supporting evidence, options and recommended actions.

End-User Assurance and Operational Validation

* Manage QAS Cargo’s day-to-day end-user assurance and operational-validation activities throughout construction, installation, testing, commissioning, handover and transition, within the governance, priorities and delegated authority established by the Senior Manager Projects – CT2.
* Develop and maintain the end-user assurance plan, identifying required operational reviews, inspections, demonstrations, testing activities, responsible subject-matter experts, decision dates and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate QAS Cargo subject-matter experts in assessing execution-stage deliverables requiring operational input, including contractor proposals, equipment configurations, system functionality, testing documentation, commissioning outputs, operational procedures and proposed changes affecting the approved operating solution.
* Verify through site inspections, walkthroughs, demonstrations, simulations and testing that installed facilities, MHS, technology, equipment and operational interfaces are consistent with approved QAS Cargo requirements and capable of supporting the intended cargo operation.
* Coordinate the operational validation of end-to-end cargo processes, including normal operations, peak conditions, exceptions, degraded modes, system recovery, manual fallback and business-continuity arrangements.
* Provide the Senior Manager Projects – CT2 with evidence-based operational assessments, acceptance conditions and recommended actions relating to operational suitability, testing, handover and readiness.

Construction and Asset Interfaces

* Coordinate QAS Cargo input into construction sequencing, access arrangements, temporary works, project logistics and delivery interfaces where these could affect existing cargo operations, future operational requirements or CT2 readiness activities.
* Direct the Senior Project Officer’s coordination of site observations, operational walkthroughs, installation verification, progressive inspections, testing support, operational snagging and handover preparation.
* Identify the operational consequences of layout, access, installation, construction-interface or asset-readiness issues and refer technical non-conformances and workmanship matters to the appropriate MPD, PMCM, designer or contractor representative.
* Ensure the QAS Cargo team does not issue site instructions, direct contractor activities or assume responsibility for construction methodology, supervision, quality control, technical acceptance or contractual administration.

Process, Concept of Operations (ConOps) and Operational Integration

* Lead the Cargo Process Improvement Specialist in the development, validation and maintenance of the CT2 ConOps, future-state processes, operational requirements, standard operating procedures and operational scenarios.
* Ensure facility layouts, MHS functionality, technology solutions, staffing assumptions and operating procedures remain aligned with approved cargo processes, service standards, capacity requirements and performance outcomes.
* Coordinate end-to-end process mapping and operational validation across acceptance, build-up, breakdown, transfer, storage, screening, special products, truck-dock, airside and landside interfaces, as applicable to the approved CT2 operating scope.
* Maintain alignment between ConOps, operational procedures, training content, test scenarios and transition arrangements so that the intended operating model can be implemented effectively at go-live.

Operational Readiness and Airport Transfer (ORAT)

* Integrate ORAT requirements and activities across QAS Cargo’s facility, MHS, technology, process, people and delivery workstreams within the governance and priorities established by the Senior Manager Projects – CT2.
* Act as the day-to-day QAS Cargo coordination point for ORAT interfaces affecting delivery integration, ConOps, operational processes, end-user requirements, testing, handover and transition activities.
* Coordinate with the appointed ORAT consultants to ensure QAS Cargo operational requirements, workstream dependencies, stakeholder inputs and readiness constraints are accurately reflected in ORAT plans and activities.
* Coordinate QAS Cargo operational stakeholders and subject-matter experts in support of readiness assessments, familiarization, simulations, testing and operational trials, ensuring the required participation, information and operational resources are available.
* Lead the Senior Project Officer and Cargo Process Improvement Specialist in providing the construction-interface, process, ConOps and operational inputs required to support ORAT planning and execution.
* Coordinate QAS Cargo participation in integrated systems testing, familiarization, simulations, the Non-Operational Trial Period, the Revenue Operational Trial Period and other applicable operational trials.
* Support knowledge transfer from the ORAT consultants to QAS Cargo and ensure relevant readiness documentation, tools and lessons are retained within the operation.

Additional Accountabilities

Handover and Transition

* Develop and manage the QAS Cargo operational-handover framework, ensuring facility, systems, equipment, process, people and documentation requirements are coordinated before transition into service.
* Coordinate QAS Cargo review of operations and maintenance manuals, as-built information, asset data, training materials, operational procedures, warranties, support arrangements and other documents required for safe and effective operation.
* Maintain an operational-handover matrix defining required documentation, training, access, equipment, systems, approvals, support arrangements, outstanding works, accountable owners and target completion dates.
* Coordinate development of migration, cutover, fallback, contingency, stabilization and ramp-up plans across existing and future QAS Cargo operations.
* Ensure transition plans clearly address interfaces between CT2, Cargo Terminal 1, supporting airport systems, operational stakeholders and relevant third parties
* Maintain the CT2 operational lessons-learned and knowledge-transfer process to retain project, process and systems knowledge within QAS Cargo.

Reporting and Governance

* Provide the Senior Manager Projects – CT2 with integrated, evidence-based reporting covering workstream status, QAS Cargo actions, operational dependencies, readiness, interface risks, unresolved requirements and decisions required.
* Coordinate with the Senior Manager Project Controls to ensure QAS Cargo milestones, decisions, constraints, dependencies, testing and readiness activities are represented in integrated programme reporting.
* Prepare integration assessments, decision papers, operational-impact reviews and readiness recommendations for the Senior Manager Projects – CT2 and relevant governance forums.
* Perform other department duties related to the position as directed by the Head of the Department

Title: Technical Project Manager
Description:
**What We’re All About.**
It isn’t often you get to be part of a tech company that, since 2016, has been innovating the data analytics market in ways no-one else can. Our technology started out in FinTech, helping tackle serious criminal activity. Now, its potential is virtually limitless.
  
  
Working at Quantexa isn't just intellectually stimulating. We’re a real team. Collaborating and constantly engineering better and better solutions. We’re ambitious, we think things through and we’re on a mission to discover just how far we go. Nearly half of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We’re made up of people from 47 nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.
  
  
If our incredible culture sounds like you, we’d love you to join us.
  
  
**The opportunity.**
As a Technical Project Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution and successful end-to-end delivery of implementation projects to our clients. You will join a wider Delivery team of engineers, analysts, data scientists and architects focused on achieving the best outcomes for our clients.
  
  
You will be part of the Project Management practice, a global network of project and programme management professionals within Quantexa, a group designed to support your career development and ensure you fulfil your full potential.
  
  
As well as working with some of the largest and most prestigious organisations in the world, you will also be working hand in hand with our delivery partner network, which includes the big four consultancies as well as major systems integrators.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* You will take full ownership of the delivery of Quantexa projects end-to-end, putting your arms around all aspects, actively mitigating risks and issues, driving high standards of quality and best practice and being in full control of the costs, timelines and scope.
* You’ll drive successful outcomes - delivering projects in the most optimal way that realise maximum value to our clients.
* Managing the commercial and financial aspects of your projects, working with our clients to agree contracts for professional services, using both Time and Materials (T&M) and Fixed Priced constructs.
* Coaching and mentoring your technical teams to ensure they have the skills and capabilities necessary to produce high quality deliverables to our clients.
* Working and learning with a high degree of autonomy with minimal supervision, seeking and knowing when to engage the rest of the Quantexa organisation for support.
* You will devise critical strategies to successfully manage your project stakeholders, both from the client as well as Quantexa leadership.

**What You’ll Bring.**

* You are an accomplished project management professional with strong leadership skills and a track record of delivering complex projects with excellent outcomes.
* You are an expert on project methodologies and approaches such as Agile, can apply them to maximum effect and you appreciate how these methodologies and approaches can scale to multiple teams and functions.
* You have broad stakeholder management experience either as a supplier delivering to clients, such as a consultancy or professional services organisation, or within a client-side environment.
* You have experience of delivering large and complex data-driven projects through the full software lifecycle.
* You have a good understanding of the technical aspects that impact the project outcomes and can grasp technical issues and devise mitigation strategies to address them.
* You have a strong appreciation of the business purpose and drivers of your projects and direct the team to ensure that achieving them is paramount.
* You are adept at operating in complex multi-team environments where you harness your skills and knowledge to influence other teams to deliver the best overall outcome.
* You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, critical thinking and the ability to devise delivery solutions to address client challenges.
* Exhibit strong technical communication skills with demonstrable experience of working in rapidly changing client environments.
* Have an excellent appreciation of what makes a high quality, operationally stable system and how to streamline all areas of development, release, and operations to achieve this.
* You are a self-starter and bring a great deal of determination, initiative and tenacity to your projects.
* Proficiency in speaking Arabic at a fluent/native level is mandatory.
* Comfortable traveling within the UAE and across the Gulf region as required for business needs and client engagements.

**Ideal Candidates Will Also**

* Have worked on a variety of complex data orientated projects for financial services, government, and telco clients.

**Our perks and quirks.**
What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Competitive salary & Company bonus
* 22 days annual leave, plus national holidays + your birthday off!
* Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover
* Regularly bench-marked salary rates
* Well-being days
* Volunteer Day off
* Work from Home Equipment
* Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app
* Continuous Training and Development
* Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy
* Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

**Our mission.**
We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.
  
  
**It’s All About You.**
We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you
*Q*
. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible.
**If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.**
No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.
