Title: Technical Project Manager
Description:
**Job Description**
**What We’re All About.**
It isn’t often you get to be part of a tech company that, since 2016, has been innovating the data analytics market in ways no-one else can. Our technology started out in FinTech, helping tackle serious criminal activity. Now, its potential is virtually limitless.
  
  
Working at Quantexa isn't just intellectually stimulating. We’re a real team. Collaborating and constantly engineering better and better solutions. We’re ambitious, we think things through and we’re on a mission to discover just how far we go. Nearly half of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We’re made up of people from 47 nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.
  
  
If our incredible culture sounds like you, we’d love you to join us.
  
  
**The opportunity.**
As a Technical Project Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution and successful end-to-end delivery of implementation projects to our clients. You will join a wider Delivery team of engineers, analysts, data scientists and architects focused on achieving the best outcomes for our clients.
  
  
You will be part of the Project Management practice, a global network of project and programme management professionals within Quantexa, a group designed to support your career development and ensure you fulfil your full potential.
  
  
As well as working with some of the largest and most prestigious organisations in the world, you will also be working hand in hand with our delivery partner network, which includes the big four consultancies as well as major systems integrators.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* You will take full ownership of the delivery of Quantexa projects end-to-end, putting your arms around all aspects, actively mitigating risks and issues, driving high standards of quality and best practice and being in full control of the costs, timelines and scope.
* You’ll drive successful outcomes - delivering projects in the most optimal way that realise maximum value to our clients.
* Managing the commercial and financial aspects of your projects, working with our clients to agree contracts for professional services, using both Time and Materials (T&M) and Fixed Priced constructs.
* Coaching and mentoring your technical teams to ensure they have the skills and capabilities necessary to produce high quality deliverables to our clients.
* Working and learning with a high degree of autonomy with minimal supervision, seeking and knowing when to engage the rest of the Quantexa organisation for support.
* You will devise critical strategies to successfully manage your project stakeholders, both from the client as well as Quantexa leadership.

**What You’ll Bring.**

* You are an accomplished project management professional with strong leadership skills and a track record of delivering complex projects with excellent outcomes.

* You are adept at operating in complex multi-team environments where you harness your skills and knowledge to influence other teams to deliver the best overall outcome.
* You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, critical thinking and the ability to devise delivery solutions to address client challenges.
* Exhibit strong technical communication skills with demonstrable experience of working in rapidly changing client environments.
* Have an excellent appreciation of what makes a high quality, operationally stable system and how to streamline all areas of development, release, and operations to achieve this.

* Proficiency in speaking Arabic at a fluent/native level is mandatory.
* Comfortable traveling within the UAE and across the Gulf region as required for business needs and client engagements.

* Have worked on a variety of complex data orientated projects for financial services, government, and telco clients.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

* Competitive salary & Company bonus
* 22 days annual leave, plus national holidays + your birthday off!

Title: PMO Manager
Description:
**Job Title:**
PMO Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
  
  
**Duration:**
ASAP – 28 February 2028
  
  
**Role Summary**
Employment Type: Fixed-Term, Project-Based Contract
  
  
Work Arrangement: Full-Time, On-Site
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and highly organised PMO Manager to lead and oversee Project Management Office (PMO) functions within a large-scale, complex operational environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing and maintaining effective project governance frameworks, overseeing project planning and performance monitoring, coordinating multiple workstreams, and ensuring that projects are delivered in line with approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and strategic objectives. This role requires a strong understanding of PMO methodologies, project controls, risk management, resource planning, reporting, and stakeholder engagement. The PMO Manager will work closely with senior leadership, department heads, and project teams to provide visibility on project performance, identify potential challenges, and drive effective decision-making.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* PMO Governance & Framework Management
* Establish, implement, and maintain PMO policies, procedures, governance frameworks, and project management standards.
* Ensure consistency in project management methodologies, processes, documentation, and reporting across all workstreams.
* Develop and maintain project governance structures, approval workflows, escalation procedures, and decision-making frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with established project management standards and organisational requirements.
* Continuously review and improve PMO processes to enhance efficiency, accountability, and project delivery.
* Project Planning & Performance Monitoring
* Oversee the development, consolidation, and monitoring of integrated project plans and master schedules.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, critical paths, and key deadlines.
* Monitor progress against approved project plans and identify deviations, delays, and potential delivery risks.
* Coordinate with project managers and workstream leads to ensure timely execution of activities.
* Ensure project objectives, deliverables, and timelines remain aligned with overall strategic priorities.
* Monitor project performance through KPIs and other relevant performance indicators.
* Reporting & Management Information
* Lead the preparation and consolidation of regular project status reports, executive dashboards, and management presentations.
* Provide senior management with accurate and timely visibility of project progress, performance, risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Develop reporting templates, tracking tools, and performance measurement systems.
* Analyse project data and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of information reported across different departments and workstreams.
* Prepare progress summaries and highlight critical matters requiring management intervention.
* Risk, Issue & Change Management
* Establish and maintain project risk and issue registers.
* Identify potential project risks, operational challenges, and delivery bottlenecks.
* Coordinate the development and monitoring of mitigation and contingency plans.
* Ensure risks and issues are escalated through the appropriate governance channels.
* Monitor project changes, assess their potential impact on scope, timelines, resources, and budgets, and ensure appropriate approvals are obtained.
* Track corrective actions and ensure accountability for their timely resolution.
* Resource & Budget Oversight
* Monitor resource allocation and utilisation across projects and workstreams.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to identify resource gaps and potential capacity constraints.
* Support project budget tracking, expenditure monitoring, and financial performance reporting.
* Identify potential budget variances and highlight areas requiring corrective action.
* Ensure resources are aligned with project priorities, operational requirements, and delivery timelines.
* Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination
* Act as a central coordination point between senior management, project managers, department heads, and key stakeholders.
* Facilitate project review meetings, governance meetings, and progress discussions.
* Ensure clear communication of project priorities, responsibilities, decisions, and action items.
* Follow up with workstream leads to ensure agreed actions and deliverables are completed within established deadlines.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and support the resolution of cross-functional challenges.
* Ensure alignment between different departments and project teams.
* Documentation & Project Controls
* Oversee the maintenance of comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, reports, risk registers, action logs, and decision records.
* Ensure appropriate document control, version management, and reporting processes are followed.
* Maintain centralised project trackers and ensure information is regularly updated.
* Monitor project deliverables against agreed scope, quality requirements, and timelines.
* Ensure proper records are maintained to support project reviews, audits, and management decisions.

**Required Skills**

* PMO Governance: Strong understanding of PMO structures, project governance frameworks, methodologies, and standard operating procedures.
* Project Planning & Scheduling: Ability to develop, review, consolidate, and monitor integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, and dependencies.
* Project Controls: Knowledge of project performance tracking, progress measurement, schedule management, and variance analysis.
* Risk & Issue Management: Ability to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate project risks and operational issues.
* Reporting & Data Analysis: Strong ability to consolidate complex information into clear management reports, dashboards, and actionable insights.
* Budget & Resource Monitoring: Understanding of project budget tracking, resource allocation, utilisation, and cost control.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to coordinate across multiple departments, manage expectations, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Change Management: Understanding of scope management, change requests, impact assessments, and approval processes.
* Documentation & Controls: Strong knowledge of project documentation, reporting standards, action tracking, and document control.

Software & Tools
  
  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Microsoft Project or equivalent project scheduling tools.
* Power BI or similar reporting and dashboard platforms.
* Primavera P6 would be an advantage.
* Microsoft SharePoint, Teams, and other project collaboration tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Management, or a related discipline.
* Fluency in both Arabic and English is mandatory.

**Experience Requirement**

* Minimum 8-10 years of relevant professional experience in project management, PMO, project controls, or programme management.
* Demonstrated experience in managing or leading PMO functions within large-scale, complex, or multi-stakeholder environments.
* Proven track record in establishing PMO governance frameworks, reporting structures, project controls, and performance monitoring processes.
* Strong experience coordinating multiple projects, departments, or workstreams simultaneously.
* Experience working with senior management and providing executive-level reporting and project performance insights.
* Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, risk management, change control, and resource management.
* Experience in large-scale events, major programmes, infrastructure, government, or complex operational environments would be an advantage.

**Location / Work Mode**
Saudi Arabia | Full-Time, On-Site | Contract Duration: ASAP - 28 February 2027

Title: Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Role: Major Incident Manager**

**Location: Houston, TX - Remote**

**Job Description:**

**Major Incident Manager**

• 5+ years of hands-on Major Incident Management experience in complex enterprise technology environments.

• ITIL Foundation certification required.

• ITIL 4 Practitioner: Incident Management certification preferred.

• Additional advanced ITIL certifications related to Incident Management, service operations, or service management preferred.

• Demonstrated experience leading high-impact, business-critical technology incidents through mitigation and service restoration.

• Demonstrated experience operating in a high-volume Major Incident environment, including managing multiple Major Incidents concurrently.

• Extensive experience leading technical and management bridge calls involving multiple technical teams, SI partners, and support organizations.

• Proven ability to drive teams toward service restoration while maintaining urgency, accountability, organization, and focus in high-pressure situations.

• Strong management and stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical situations into clear and concise business communications.

• General technical understanding of enterprise application and infrastructure architecture, including applications, servers, databases, networks, cloud services, integrations, and service dependencies.

• Strong understanding of Major Incident Management practices, including impact, urgency, prioritization, escalation, communications, and service restoration.

• Strong decision-making, analytical, and organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and multiple technical workstreams simultaneously.

• Experience working in complex multi-provider or SI environments preferred.

• Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise service management platform.

• Ability to work effectively with the SMO Global Process Owner, SI Major Incident Managers, SI partners, technical teams, and management stakeholders.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate Major Incidents from declaration through mitigation or service restoration, maintaining urgency and focus on minimizing business impact.

• Lead technical and management bridge calls, ensuring the appropriate SI partners and technical resources are engaged and focused on service restoration.

• Drive SI Major Incident Managers and technical teams to maintain urgency, accountability, clear ownership, and progress throughout the incident.

• Manage multiple concurrent Major Incidents while prioritizing activities based on business impact, urgency, and service criticality.

• Coordinate troubleshooting activities across application, infrastructure, network, cloud, database, and other technical teams while maintaining focus on service restoration.

• Establish and track actions, owners, escalation points, and next steps throughout the Major Incident lifecycle.

• Identify and escalate technical, resource, ownership, or organizational barriers that are delaying service restoration.

• Provide timely, accurate, and concise Major Incident communications to management, stakeholders, and affected organizations.

• Ensure SI partners follow established Major Incident response, escalation, communication, and contractual SLA requirements.

• Work with the SIAM team to identify and address SI partner performance issues, recurring concerns, coordination gaps, and areas requiring follow-up or corrective action.

• Maintain accurate Major Incident timelines, actions, decisions, communications, mitigation activities, and restoration information.

• Support post-incident activities and ensure relevant information is captured for Problem Management, follow-up actions, and continual improvement.

• Work with the SMO Global Process Owner to identify opportunities to improve Major Incident Management execution and SI partner performance.

• Work with the SMO Global Process Owner to identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve Major Incident Management, including documenting business requirements and supporting the development and adoption of new capabilities.

• Ensure Major Incident activities are executed in accordance with established processes, procedures, escalation paths, and governance requirements.

The Project Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating project governance, testing activities, cutover planning, business readiness, Hypercare support, and operational transition activities for Oracle Cloud ERP implementations and enhancements. * Lead day-to-day project management activities throughout Release, Go-Live, Hypercare, and Evolve phases.

* Workstream reviews
* Steering Committee meetings
* Go/No-Go decision meetings
* Hypercare governance meetings
* Manage project risks, issues, actions, decisions, assumptions, and change requests.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify schedule, resource, and dependency risks.
* Prepare executive dashboards, status reports, and stakeholder communications.

**Testing and Quality Coordination**

* Plan and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.
* Manage UAT schedules, resources, environments, test execution, and approvals.
* Coordinate defect triage sessions and resolution tracking.
* Oversee regression testing activities and ensure business-critical processes are validated.
* Track testing metrics, defect aging, completion rates, and readiness indicators.

**Risk, Issue, and Defect Management**

* Maintain consolidated RAID and defect logs.
* Facilitate issue-resolution and defect-management processes.
* Escalate critical risks, blockers, and decisions through governance channels.
* Monitor remediation plans and ensure timely closure of issues.

**Cutover and Go-Live Management**

* Develop and manage integrated cutover plans.
* Coordinate business, technical, integration, data-conversion, reconciliation, and support activities.
* Track cutover execution and manage escalation of missed tasks or production risks.
* Support Go-Live readiness assessments and stakeholder approvals.

**Business Readiness and Training**

* Coordinate business readiness activities across affected departments.
* Monitor user-training completion and readiness milestones.
* Support stakeholder communications and change-management activities.
* Track readiness sign-offs and deployment prerequisites.

**Hypercare and Operational Transition**

* Lead Hypercare governance and stabilization activities.
* Coordinate Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 support teams during post-production support.
* Monitor incident resolution, ticket trends, and service levels.
* Provide executive visibility into operational stability and business impact.
* Drive transition from Hypercare to steady-state support operations.

**Vendor and Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate activities across:
* Business stakeholders
* Oracle
* System Integrators
* AMS providers
* Technical teams
* Third-party vendors
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communications.
* Facilitate decision-making and issue resolution across cross-functional teams.

**Knowledge Transfer and Handover**

* Coordinate knowledge transfer sessions and operational handoffs.
* Ensure support teams receive required documentation and training.
* Validate operational readiness before ownership transfer.

The Toronto Transit Commission (TTC), North America's third largest transit system and recognized as one of the top places to work in the GTA has introduced its new 2024-2028 TTC Corporate Plan - Moving Toronto, Connecting Communities which continues the TTC’s legacy of delivering service to hundreds of millions of customers a year. The TTC’s new vision and mission statements also help promote the many environmental, social equity and economic benefits that the TTC provides:

  

**Vision:** Moving Toronto towards a more equitable, sustainable, and prosperous future.

  

**Mission:** To serve the needs of transit riders by providing a safe, reliable, efficient, and accessible mass public transit service through a seamless integrated network to create access to opportunity for everyone.

  

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------

Join the TTC’s Marketing and Communications team during an exciting period of growth and transformation. We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Manager, Special Events, Rewards and Recognition Programs to lead a diverse portfolio of high-profile events, public engagement initiatives and employee recognition programs.

This role provides strategic leadership and oversight of programs that enhance the TTC’s reputation, strengthen employee engagement, foster meaningful stakeholder relationships and support the organization’s broader business objectives.

The successful candidate will be an experienced leader who excels at managing complex, high-profile initiatives, building collaborative relationships and balancing competing priorities in a dynamic, public-sector environment. They will bring strong financial and business acumen, sound judgment and a passion for creating impactful experiences that connect employees, customers and communities with the TTC.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Reporting to the Head of Marketing and Communications, you will provide strategic direction and operational oversight for the TTC’s Special Events and Rewards and Recognition Programs portfolio. You will lead a team responsible for the planning, development and delivery of internal and external events, employee engagement initiatives and recognition programs that support the TTC’s strategic objectives and corporate reputation.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for a diverse portfolio of special events, public activations, corporate initiatives, stakeholder engagement activities and employee programs, ensuring alignment with TTC priorities and organizational objectives.
* Lead the development, planning and execution of high-profile events and public engagement initiatives, including press conferences, public forums, launch events, corporate initiatives and major stakeholder events.
* Oversee the delivery and continuous improvement of employee engagement and recognition initiatives, including Long Service, Retirement, Safety and Awards programs, ensuring programs remain relevant, impactful and aligned with TTC’s organizational culture and values.
* Provide strategic oversight of major corporate and employee engagement events and programs, including corporate celebrations, employee recognition events, accessibility initiatives and seasonal events.
* Oversee the TTC Subway Musicians Program and other initiatives that enhance the customer experience and contribute to a positive public perception of the TTC. In 2027, support the auditions and licensing of new musicians.
* Manage a complex departmental operating budget, including financial planning, forecasting, monitoring, variance analysis, and reporting. Ensure effective financial stewardship, accountability, and alignment with departmental priorities.
* Oversee the development and management of individual event and program budgets, ensuring appropriate resource allocation, cost control, financial reporting, and adherence to approved budgets.
* Manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects and competing priorities, providing direction on resource allocation, project planning, risk mitigation and issue resolution.
* Oversee procurement activities, contracts and vendor relationships, ensuring value for money and compliance with TTC policies, procedures and financial controls.
* Establish appropriate governance, accountability and performance measurement frameworks to evaluate program effectiveness, identify opportunities for improvement, and support informed decision-making.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal departments, executive leadership, government partners, community organizations, external stakeholders, and service providers.
* Anticipate and mitigate operational, reputational, accessibility and safety risks associated with events and programs, ensuring appropriate planning, approvals and contingency measures are in place.
* Lead, coach and develop a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear priorities, fostering collaboration, and building the capacity required to deliver a complex and evolving portfolio.
* Serve as Ex-Officio for the TTC Recreation Council.
* Foster an inclusive, respectful and accessible workplace by supporting TTC’s commitments under the Ontario Human Rights Code, Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and related policies.
* Participate in the TTC Customer Service Ambassador Program.

**What Qualifications Do You Bring?**
-------------------------------------

* University degree or college diploma in Business Administration, Hospitality, Communications, Public Relations, Marketing or a related field, or a combination of education and relevant experience.
* Extensive experience in special events management, corporate events, marketing, communications, employee engagement, stakeholder relations or related program management.
* CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) designation is considered an asset.
* Demonstrated experience providing strategic leadership and oversight of complex programs and projects involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities and interdependent timelines.
* Proven experience developing, managing and monitoring complex operating budgets, including financial planning, forecasting, variance analysis and financial reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple event and program budgets, allocate resources effectively, exercise financial controls and ensure accountability for expenditures.
* Experience with procurement processes, contract administration, vendor management and financial stewardship.
* Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams, establish priorities, allocate resources and foster a collaborative and accountable work environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage high-profile initiatives, anticipate and mitigate risks, resolve complex issues and exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional relationship management, interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance strategic planning with operational oversight.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, SharePoint and related software tools; familiarity with graphic design applications is an asset.
* Experience managing programs, projects, budgets, or teams within a large, complex or unionized organization is considered an asset.
* Knowledge of, or the ability to quickly acquire, expertise in the Ontario Human Rights Code, accessibility legislation, disability accommodation requirements and related workplace obligations.
* Valid Ontario Class G driver’s licence for event set up and related activities.

**Skills**
----------

* Apply analytical skills
* Manage projects
* Communicate in a variety of mediums
* Plan and organize activities / projects to meet section and organizational goals
* Use office technology, software and applications

* Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities to assess complex issues and develop practical solutions.
* Experience balancing multiple priorities and delivering results in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.
* Ability to identify opportunities for operational improvements and implement effective business practices.
* Sound judgment and decision-making skills to address sensitive, high-impact, or emerging issues.

* Ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with staff, management, corporate partners, and stakeholders.

**People & Culture Leadership & Operations**

* Act as the second-in-command of the People & Culture department, supporting the People & Culture Manager in managing all departmental functions.

* Provide professional HR guidance and operational support to department heads and management.

* Represent the People & Culture department in operational meetings when delegated.
* Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of HR policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Identify operational challenges and recommend effective solutions to enhance HR service delivery.
* Ensure a professional, confidential, and service-oriented approach across all People & Culture activities.

**Pre-Opening People & Culture Management**

* Support the execution of the resort's People & Culture pre-opening critical path and manpower mobilization plan.

* Oversee pre-opening recruitment coordination, employee onboarding, and joining formalities.

* Monitor recruitment progress, hiring timelines, and manpower requirements.
* Partner with department heads to identify recruitment priorities and workforce needs.
* Review employment offers, contracts, and joining documentation for accuracy and compliance.
* Maintain recruitment reports and provide regular hiring updates to the People & Culture Manager.
* Support workforce planning, internal mobility, and talent development initiatives.

**Employee Relations & Labor Law Compliance**

* Provide guidance on employee relations matters, workplace policies, and Saudi Labor Law requirements.
* Support grievance handling, disciplinary procedures, workplace investigations, and conflict resolution.
* Ensure employee relations processes are conducted fairly, consistently, and in accordance with applicable regulations.
* Advise department heads on appropriate HR procedures and employee management practices.
* Monitor employment contract compliance, probation periods, resignations, and termination procedures.
* Coordinate with Government Relations on employment-related regulatory requirements.
* Support Saudization monitoring and compliance with applicable workforce localization requirements.
* Maintain accurate documentation of employee relations matters and compliance activities.

**Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Oversee the preparation and verification of monthly payroll inputs in coordination with Finance.
* Review attendance records, overtime, leave balances, allowances, deductions, and payroll adjustments.
* Ensure accuracy of employee data within HR and payroll systems.
* Coordinate employee benefits administration, medical insurance, and employment-related entitlements.
* Review end-of-service benefit calculations, final settlements, and separation documentation.
* Ensure payroll administration and employee entitlements comply with applicable Saudi Labor Law requirements.
* Identify payroll discrepancies and coordinate timely corrective actions.

**Performance Management & Heartist Development**

* Support the implementation of performance management processes, probation reviews, and annual appraisals.
* Guide department heads on performance documentation and employee development procedures.
* Coordinate with the Training Supervisor on onboarding, mandatory training, and development initiatives.
* Support talent identification, succession planning, and career development programs.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional development.

**Heartist Engagement & Workplace Culture**

* Promote Accor's Heartist philosophy and foster a positive, inclusive, and engaging workplace environment.
* Support employee engagement, recognition, welfare, and well-being initiatives.
* Coordinate internal communication activities and employee events.
* Act as a trusted point of contact for Heartists seeking HR guidance and support.
* Monitor employee feedback and recommend initiatives to improve engagement and retention.
* Support a workplace culture that reflects the resort's luxury hospitality values.

**HR Systems, Reporting & Compliance**

* Oversee the accuracy and maintenance of employee records within HR information systems.
* Prepare and review HR reports covering headcount, turnover, recruitment, attendance, leave balances, and Saudization.
* Ensure employee personnel files, employment contracts, and regulatory documentation are complete and updated.
* Support HR audits, compliance reviews, and internal reporting requirements.
* Monitor HR-related deadlines and ensure timely completion of required actions.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and compliance with applicable data protection requirements.
* Perform additional People & Culture management responsibilities as assigned by the People & Culture Manager.

**Education & Professional Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–4 years of progressive Human Resources experience, preferably within the hotel or hospitality industry.
* Previous experience within luxury hotels, resorts, or internationally recognized hospitality brands is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to independently manage daily HR operations and provide professional guidance to department heads.
* Strong practical knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, employment regulations, and Saudization requirements.
* Demonstrated experience in employee relations, recruitment, payroll coordination, performance management, and HR administration.
* Previous hotel or resort pre-opening experience is a strong advantage.
* Hands-on familiarity with Saudi government platforms, including Qiwa, GOSI, and Mudad.
* Experience using HRIS, payroll systems, and recruitment platforms.
* Familiarity with Accor People & Culture systems and SmartRecruiters is an advantage.

Title: Assistant Operations - Process Manager
Description:
**Job Description**

**Contract (ie Perm/FTC/Part-Time): Permanent**

**Team: KSA Operations - Process Improvement, Quality Assurance & Controls**

**Reporting To: Senior Manager - Process Improvement**

**Office Location: Riyadh – Saudi Arabia**

**The role:**

The Assistant Manager, Quality Assurance & Controls will establish, implement, and manage the KSA Quality Assurance & Controls function. This role is responsible for developing a structured framework that promotes operational excellence, quality consistency, compliance, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement across the practice.

The role will provide an independent and objective view of operational quality by assessing adherence to established standards, identifying root causes of defects and control failures, monitoring effectiveness of corrective actions, and providing actionable insights to leadership.

Working closely with Case Managers, Case Workers, Subject Matter Experts, and the Senior Manager, Process Improvement, the Assistant Manager will play a key role in strengthening operational controls, enhancing service quality, improving employee capability, and embedding a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

*What your day will look like:*

1. Quality Assurance & Controls Framework Design and Governance

2. Process Quality Mapping and Control Management

3. Quality Assurance Reviews and Assessments

4. Quality Performance Monitoring and Reporting

5. Defect Management and Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA)

6. Coaching, Capability Building and Calibration across different teams and business verticals

7. Lead Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence

**The team:**

The KSA practice delivers immigration, mobility, corporate, and destination services to a diverse portfolio of clients, including multinational corporations, and key institutions across the Kingdom. Our Case Management team is responsible for managing end-to-end immigration and related service requirements while ensuring regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and a consistently high standard of client service.

The team is structured across multiple levels, comprising a Director, Case Managers, Assistant Managers, Senior Immigration Consultants, Immigration Consultants, and Junior Consultants. The Quality Assurance & Controls function, partners closely with these teams to establish and maintain quality standards, strengthen operational controls, identify improvement opportunities, and support the delivery of consistent, high quality services across the practice.

This newly established function sits within the Process Improvement team and plays a key role in promoting operational excellence through quality assurance, controls governance, coaching, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**What we are looking for:**

*Essential criteria:*

* 5 to 8 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Internal Controls, Audit, Risk Management, Compliance, Operational Excellence, or a related discipline, including experience establishing or leading quality governance frameworks.

* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Quality Assurance & Controls frameworks, including quality pillars, process quality maps, Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) requirements, control points, review methodologies, and defect classification frameworks.

* Strong experience conducting structured case, file, process, or compliance reviews and assessing adherence to quality standards, controls, policies, and procedures.

* Proven Quality/Audit experience identifying control gaps, process weaknesses, quality defects, and operational risks, and translating findings into practical improvement initiatives.

* Strong experience in root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) management, and continuous improvement tracking.

* Proven ability to analyse quality, controls, and operational performance data and present meaningful insights, trends, risks, and recommendations to management and senior leadership.

* Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, errors, control weaknesses, and potential risks while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and objectivity.

* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the confidence to provide constructive feedback, challenge appropriately, and drive change without direct authority.

*Preferred skills:*

* Experience within professional, immigration, mobility, or legal services, or other similar regulated environments.

* Quality Management (QMS framework) , Lean Six Sigma (Green belt), Project Management, Audit, Risk, or Compliance certification.

* Experience developing quality standards, SOPs, process documentation, and operational controls.

* Experience using reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

* Experience delivering training, coaching, or quality calibration sessions.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Fluent English communication, Arabic language skills would be advantageous.

**What we offer:**

A career at Fragomen will provide you with the opportunity to work in an exciting environment for a broad range of clients, where no two days will be the same. You will face interesting challenges, and will work with dedicated, friendly and ambitious people, where providing exceptional client service is at the core of what we do. We are extremely proud of our diverse workforce at Fragomen, and we are fully committed to providing equal opportunities.

At Fragomen, we value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package that supports your well-being and professional growth. Our **Saudi Arabia** offerings include:

* **Competitive Salary:** We offer salaries that reflect your skills and experience

* **Health and Wellness:** Private medical insurance including dental cover, and free Headspace membership
* **Lifestyle and Family Support:** Ticket allowance, advance housing policy and children’s education policy
* **Time Away from Work:** 22 days annual leave + public holidays, volunteering leave and long service leave
* **Professional Development:** Access to our e-learning platform, mentoring schemes, and training bursaries (where applicable)

**What to expect:**

* Once you have submitted your application, our Talent Acquisition team will review your skills and experience. If these match the requirements of the position, a member of our team will contact you to schedule an initial phone call.

* If shortlisted, you will be invited to participate in our interview process, which will consist of at least two stages, one of which will be conducted in-person. Depending on the role, you may also be required to complete a written assessment.

* After the interviews, we will carefully evaluate all candidates and make our final decision. You will be notified of the outcome and feedback will be provided.

* At Fragomen, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace for all applicants and employees. If you require any specific accommodations or support during the interview process, please let us know, and we will consider what reasonable adjustments are possible to meet your needs

**Who we are:**

At Fragomen, we are more than a global immigration services provider – we are pioneers shaping the future of mobility. With a passion for navigating the complexities of immigration, we help individuals and businesses transcend borders, unlocking opportunities around the world. As a diverse, forward-thinking, global business, we combine deep expertise with innovative technology to craft solutions that not only simplify the immigration process but also drive strategic success for our clients. Whether it is assisting multinational companies or helping people start new chapters in their lives, we are driven by the belief that global movement is the key to unlocking a world of possibilities.

We are proud of our team spirit, and we like to reflect this in the way that we work and everything we do. Our Responsible Business Practices (“RBP”) prioritise Fragomen’s social responsibility through a cohesive strategy covering five key focus areas of Wellbeing, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, CSR, Pro Bono and Sustainability. Our RBP initiatives offer great opportunities for everyone at Fragomen to feel included, get involved and shape thoughtful initiatives and activities. For more information, please visit our website - https://www.fragomen.com/about/responsible-business-practices.html

Title: Investor Services - Operations Client Service, Assistant Vice President
Description:
**Why this Job is important to us**
State Street provides asset owners and asset managers access to financial information and tools essential for effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration, shareholder recordkeeping, and performance, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate. Our services help our clients make better investment choices and generate wealth for their customers and beneficiaries.
  
  
****Who We Are Looking For****
Join our Client Services team as Sales and Service - Client Services, AVP and collaborate with some of the top asset manager and institutional organizations. Under the direction of his/her Manager, the Assistant Vice President is accountable for the oversight of day-to-day operations and managing of client relationships, ensuring a high level of client satisfaction. This person will act as an escalation point on client inquiries and requests, which includes the coordination of services for fund/product start-up/conversions, restructures and interacting with all internal departments for the overall service delivery for their clients. Responsibilities also include managing internal operational risk and compliance matters pertaining to assigned client relationships, as well as coordinating with internal departments for any required client specific reporting. This person will provide project leadership for training, designing client-specific reporting and supporting RFP activity.
  
  
****What You Will Be Responsible For****
As Client Service Assistant Vice President you will be:
  
  

* Responsible for managing clients of different sizes and supporting Vice Presidents or Senior Vice Presidents with the larger/more complex relationships within business unit.
* Managing a team officers and associate level staff, overseeing/directing activity and providing experienced guidance.
* Managing daily service delivery to meet or exceed Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators. Ensure superior client satisfaction by proactively identifying client needs, and potential internal issues impacting client. Manage and escalate issues accordingly and ensure client issues are satisfactorily resolved. Coordinate activity for rendering timely reporting to clients.
* Works closely with internal teams and clients. Facilitates communication between Client Services & other business units to ensure an effective operating environment. Identify and implement consistent operational best practices.
* Coordinating the implementation of new funds, systems and processes. Ensures fee schedules are properly implemented and receivables are collected in a timely manner.
* Manage client conversions and other client projects. Coordinate market entry, liquidations, and other major fund events.
* Provide overall project management for client and systems initiatives. Acts as a liaison between operational units to ensure successful implementation. Manages internal and client expectations. Obtains required operational documentation, as appropriate.
* Playing a role on strategic aspects of maintaining and growing long-term relationships. Keeps senior management keeping informed of new developments, service issues, and new business/cross sell opportunities. May be responsible for client retention and revenue expansion through existing services and cross sell. Identifies potential barriers to exit through strategic value-added services. Assist with new business development efforts as needed. Make presentations to potential client companies.
* Assist with compliance/fiduciary reviews and audits.
* Coordinate client training on using State Street interfaces (i.e. MySS.com).
* Serve on committees. Help define and implement new company initiatives.

****What We Value****
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Must possess superior leadership and managerial skills.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills in both verbal and written forms.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize assignments under tight deadlines.
* Attention to detail.
* Experience in relationship management, strong verbal and written communications skills, and some experience with presentations a must.
* Knowledge of securities markets, language and products as well as legal and regulatory requirements.
* Solid understanding of operational functions within both custody and fund accounting is preferred
* Good knowledge of computer systems, financial operations and related industries a plus.

****Education And Preferred Qualifications****

* BS/BA degree required, with preference of Business degree.
* Minimum of 6-8 years related financial services or investment operations experience with 4-5 years of management responsibility.
* Experience in relationship management strong verbal and written communications skills and some experience with presentations a must.
* Knowledge of computer systems financial operations and/or mutual fund and related industries a plus.
* MBA desirable.
* Ability to travel up to 25%.

****About State Street****
**What we do.**
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow**
. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
  
  
**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.**
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.
  
  
****Salary Range:****
$91,000 - $140,500 Annual
  
  
The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.
  
  
****About State Street****
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

Title: Assistant General Manager - Bon Air Juvenile Corrections
Description:
**SUMMARY**

The Assistant General Manager (AGM) partners closely with the General Manager to oversee all aspects of the culinary and dining program, ensuring seamless daily operations, team performance, and compliance with company and regulatory standards. The AGM serves as the acting site leader in the General Manager's absence, providing consistent management presence across all locations and maintaining the continuity of service, safety, and financial accountability. This role requires a working knowledge of applicable health and food safety regulations, and demands strong interpersonal skills, operational discipline, and a commitment to developing people and programs; the AGM is expected to spend the majority of their workday on-site, observing, coaching, and supporting the team in real time.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS, RESPONSIBILITIES, AND DUTIES**

**Operations & Financial Oversight**

* Supports the General Manager in managing location operations within established budgetary guidelines; assists in the preparation of financial forecasts, P&L analysis, and variance reporting, and ensures accurate documentation of all financial components.

* Assists in maintaining systems and procedures for the ordering, receiving, storing, preparing, and serving of food products; supports menu planning and development in accordance with company-approved systems and applicable nutritional standards.

* Monitors and assists in controlling all location expenses — including food cost, labor cost, and operating costs — while upholding exceptional service standards and supporting corrective action when targets are not met.

* Assists with recurring inventory counts and maintains accurate records in compliance with company, government, and accrediting agency standards; supports the purchasing and documentation of food products and supplies.

**Team Leadership & Workforce Development**

* Assists in recruiting, hiring, onboarding, training, and retaining team members using company-required systems, procedures, and policies; ensures all team members understand and consistently follow company and account guidelines.

* Supports the motivation, coaching, and day-to-day management of team members by modeling equitable, consistent leadership; helps identify the tools, resources, and training needed for the team to perform at a satisfactory level.

* Maintains a positive, productive, and harmonious working environment by demonstrating respectful and consistent conduct in accordance with company policies and promptly addressing performance or interpersonal concerns.

* Spends a minimum of 80% of the workday on-site across assigned locations to actively observe operations, support team members, address service issues in real time, and ensure standards are met at every level.

**Food Safety, Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensures compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local health regulations, sanitation ordinances, food handling standards, and labor laws; maintains location readiness for state or local board of health inspections at all times.

* Implements and reinforces requirements for appropriate sanitation and safety levels in all operational areas; verifies that all team members are adequately trained and that documentation is current and audit-ready.

* Assists in preparing the location for internal QA audits using company-required tools; supports the General Manager in achieving and sustaining required audit scores and driving year-over-year improvement.

* Stays current with applicable health department regulations and any state or local licensing requirements for residential dining operations; ensures that menus, production processes, and documentation consistently meet regulatory standards.

**Resident Experience, Marketing & Client Relations**

* Acts as the primary client liaison and on-site manager in the absence of the General Manager, maintaining service continuity, addressing escalated concerns, and upholding the client relationship with professionalism.

* Ensures that all marketing promotions, merchandising materials, and signage are in place, current, and effectively displayed at all times in accordance with the company marketing calendar.

* Participates in monthly or bi-monthly client and District Manager communications alongside the General Manager, contributing operational updates, participation data, and financial information as requested.

* Supports the identification and introduction of new products, services, and resident engagement opportunities that strengthen client relationships, grow participation, and contribute to program revenue goals.

$60,000 - $65,000

Requirements:

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND COMPETENCIES**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent with concentration or certificate in food and nutrition, food service management, dietetics, family and consumer sciences, nutrition education, culinary arts, business, or a related field; OR

* Associate's degree or equivalent with concentration in food and nutrition, food service management, dietetics, family and consumer sciences, nutrition education, culinary arts, business, or a related field AND at least one year of relevant food service management experience; OR

* High School diploma AND at least five (5) years' experience in food service management.

**Experience**

* 3 years' experience in Food Service Management as a Manager/Assistant Manager required.

* Minimum 1 year experience in residential dining, senior living, or hospitality operations preferred; strong interest in residential dining program development.

**Certifications**

* ServSafe mandatory – local food safety certification if required in jurisdiction of employment; must be knowledgeable of all local health and food safety ordinances.

**Technical Proficiency**

* Strong knowledge of dining operations, point-of-sale (POS) systems, and reservation management software such as OpenTable.

* Proficiency in budgeting, financial reporting, cost analysis, and understanding of profit margins and revenue optimization strategies.

* Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) for scheduling, payroll, reporting, and communication.

* Understanding of labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance requirements related to employee management and workplace safety.

**Other Qualifications**

* Culinary background required – must have a passion and an interest in food.

* Working knowledge of cooking procedures and recipe adherence and scaling.

* Bilingual Spanish highly desirable.

**Core Competencies**

* Operational Support & Execution: Assists in managing all aspects of daily location operations — production, food safety, inventory, and service delivery — with consistency, reliability, and attention to detail.

* Financial Awareness & Cost Accountability: Understands and actively monitors location financials, including food cost, labor cost, and operating expenses, to support budget adherence and sound financial decision-making.

* People Leadership & Team Development: Motivates and develops team members through hands-on coaching, consistent on-site presence, and a commitment to creating a positive, high-performing work environment.

* Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance: Maintains working knowledge of HACCP standards and applicable health codes to ensure continuous compliance across all operational areas.

* Client & Resident Relations: Represents the program professionally in the General Manager's absence, building trust with clients and residents through responsive communication and consistent service quality.

* Adaptability & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Thrives in a dynamic, multi-site environment by supporting the General Manager across all functions — financial, operational, and administrative — and stepping into leadership as needed.

* Quality & Continuous Improvement: Actively contributes to audit readiness, operational standards, and program quality by identifying gaps, reinforcing training, and supporting sustainable improvement over time.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT AND OTHER DETAILS**

**Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time exempt position. The role requires availability during all operational hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays. As an exempt position, the Team Member is expected to devote whatever time is necessary to accomplish the goals and responsibilities of the role, which may require extended work hours beyond standard shifts to ensure operational excellence.

**Travel Requirements**

Travel may be required for training, conferences, or multi-location coordination. The role requires daily on-site presence at operational location(s) to manage operations and staff effectively. All approved travel and related expenses will be covered by Whitsons. These expectations may evolve based on business needs.

**Physical Demands of the Job**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to stand and walk for extended periods (up to 8–10 hours), with frequent bending, reaching, and lifting. Lift and carry up to 50 pounds occasionally, and up to 25 pounds frequently.

Title: Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager
Description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager, you will help deliver the core infrastructure behind Microsoft's online services, including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Azure. Our infrastructure spans over 200 datacenters and 1 million servers, supporting more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses worldwide. With a focus on environmental sustainability, we continue to grow and evolve to meet changing business demands, maintaining Microsoft's position as a world-class cloud provider.

Data Center Operations Construction (DCOC) delivers complex construction and retrofit programs inside live, operational datacenters. The work spans capacity additions, mechanical and electrical equipment replacement, end-of-life remediation, network and deployment enablement, and first-of-kind retrofits, all executed without interrupting the customer availability the sites exist to provide.

The Principal Field Operations Construction Program Manager owns the Operations Construction portfolio across a group of assigned metros. Where metro program managers deliver the projects in front of them, this role decides what that portfolio contains: which work advances, which is deferred, which is stopped, and in what order, across metros competing for the same capital, outage windows, vendor capacity, and site operations bandwidth. Accountability sits with the health of the multi-metro portfolio as a whole rather than with any single project inside it.

The role leads the program managers and contract construction and safety managers working across those metros, and is measured on their capability and consistency as much as on delivered projects. It carries the most complex work in its portfolio, including first-of-kind retrofits in live space where no established execution method exists, and converts that work into standards and practice the wider program adopts. Reporting to the Director of Operations Construction, this position represents DCOC to site leadership, engineering, commissioning, and enterprise customer programs.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Lead portfolio strategy and prioritization across assigned metros, translating capacity, availability, sustainability, and business objectives into executable construction plans while balancing capital, resources, outage windows, vendor capacity, and operational constraints.
* Own portfolio delivery and governance across safety, scope, schedule, budget, commercial performance, and risk, including forecasting, change management, project controls, commissioning readiness, operational turnover, and closeout.
* Exercise independent judgment on complex, high-impact programs, assessing project viability, investment trade-offs, emerging risks, and delivery confidence, and personally leading the most complex, first-of-kind, or highest-risk initiatives when warranted.
* Lead and develop program capability across the portfolio, providing direction, coaching, and technical leadership to program managers and contract construction and safety teams while building workforce capacity, bench strength, and consistent execution practices.
* Develop and scale construction standards and program practices, establishing execution methods for first-of-kind work and translating lessons learned, root cause findings, project controls, and performance data into repeatable standards and playbooks adopted across metros and regions.
* Influence senior stakeholders and delivery partners across site operations, engineering, commissioning, supply chain, security, legal, and enterprise programs, presenting portfolio performance, investment needs, forecasts, and risk in terms that enable clear business decisions and resolve competing priorities.
* Model and champion a safety-first, accountable culture while embodying Microsoft’s culture and values, holding internal teams and external partners to high standards for safety, security, availability, operational excellence, and responsible delivery.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* High School Qualification or equivalent AND 10+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale environments OR equivalent experience

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field AND 15+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 17+ years' experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR equivalent experience.
* Applicable certifications: Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications.
* 12+ years of experience in construction management, datacenter operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or program management
* 6+ years of experience managing complex project or program portfolios across multiple sites, metros, or regions
* Experience delivering construction in live, mission-critical environments while maintaining operational availability
* Experience leading first-of-kind, accelerated, or high-risk projects with accountability for safety, cost, schedule, and risk
* Experience leading and developing teams, including employees, contractors, and cross-functional resources
* Experience managing portfolio governance, commercial performance, vendors, project controls, KPIs, and executive reporting
* PE, PMP, CCM, DBIA, LEED, CQM, ITIL, or equivalent certification preferred

This is not a formal people management role and does not include employee performance management, disciplinary authority, or approval responsibilities.
  
  
What Youll Do
  
  

* Investigate and resolve complex customer enquiries, complaints, appeals, and escalated service issues across calls, emails, and written correspondence.
* Act as the primary operational and technical escalation point for cases requiring advanced research, coordination, policy interpretation, or procedural guidance.
* Interpret policy provisions, benefits, procedures, and operational requirements to determine appropriate solutions and escalation pathways.
* Maintain end-to-end ownership of escalated cases, ensuring timely resolution, accurate documentation, proactive follow-up, and clear customer communication.
* Support service recovery activities by managing customer expectations, coordinating corrective actions, and ensuring customer concerns are effectively addressed.
* Collaborate with Health Plans, Claims, Approvals, Service Centres, Providers, IT, and other stakeholders to facilitate prompt resolution of customer issues.
* Build effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders while supporting a seamless customer experience.
* Monitor service queues, pending inventories, backlogs, ageing cases, and service-level risks, escalating concerns appropriately to the Customer Service Supervisor.
* Support workload coordination and operational prioritisation based on customer impact, service commitments, and business requirements.
* Ensure effective shift handovers through accurate communication of priority cases, unresolved issues, and operational updates.
* Assist with the preparation of operational updates, service-level reports, escalation summaries, workload status reports, and risk visibility reporting.
* Identify recurring service issues, root causes, process gaps, and customer experience challenges, providing recommendations for improvement.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives, onboarding activities, refresher training sessions, process enhancements, and quality improvement programmes.
* Support quality assurance reviews, compliance activities, audits, and operational governance requirements.
* Maintain accurate customer records and ensure all activities comply with company policies, regulatory requirements, confidentiality obligations, information security standards, and data privacy requirements.
* Continue supporting core customer service activities during periods of high contact volumes, operational peaks, and business-critical events.

**Why HSBC**

**The Role**

As a Regional Head of Islamic Finance, you’ll help develop and execute the Islamic finance agenda across the HBME MENAT region, based in the UAE. Working as a subject matter expert, you’ll support business growth through transaction origination, structuring, execution and Shariah governance. You’ll partner with relationship managers and product teams to deliver Shariah-compliant financing solutions that meet client needs while maintaining regulatory, risk and control standards. The role also covers launching new Islamic products across the CIB platform, from due diligence through to implementation. Success means delivering scalable Islamic structures, progressing opportunities from concept to closing and supporting consistent practices across jurisdictions. You’ll bring market awareness and practical judgement to help keep our propositions relevant and well governed.

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Shape and execute the Islamic finance agenda across the HBME MENAT region
* Partner with relationship managers and business heads to identify and convert Islamic financing opportunities across GCC and wider MENAT
* Structure and execute Islamic finance transactions across bilateral and syndicated financing, structured finance and asset-backed transactions
* Draft and review Islamic term sheets, indicative proposals, transaction structures and approval papers
* Coordinate Shariah adviser engagement and governance forum approvals to resolve Shariah-related matters
* Oversee transaction progression through credit approval, Shariah approval, documentation, conditions precedent, closing and post-closing requirements
* Develop and launch new Islamic finance products across the CIB platform including due diligence, manuals, processes and client materials
* Strengthen risk, controls and conduct outcomes by identifying execution risks early and ensuring appropriate reviews and auditability

**What we're looking for**

  

* Bring substantial experience in Islamic finance gained within a bank, financial institution or relevant market participant
* Demonstrate deep GCC experience with proven exposure to the UAE market
* Show a track record of originating, structuring and executing Shariah-compliant financing transactions
* Evidence collaboration with relationship managers and coverage teams to progress opportunities from origination to execution
* Apply proven capability across bilateral financing, syndicated financing and structured finance

* Show experience supporting or delivering new Islamic product launches including operational implementation with internal stakeholders

The scope spans complex transactions, new product delivery and close partnership with coverage teams and control functions. If this matches the work you’ve done and the impact you want to have, we’d like to hear from you.

3. Own SWIFT trade messaging: MT7xx (LC/guarantee), MT4xx (collections), MT798 corporate-to-bank, and related MT/MX payment messages, including annual SWIFT Standards Release impact and ISO 20022 readiness.
4. Write and review Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for data fixes, reconciliations, MIS and regulatory reporting; tune performance.
5. Lead version upgrades, patches and environment builds (DEV, SIT, UAT, pre-prod, prod, DR) with infrastructure and the vendor.
6. Evaluate and help deliver roadmap items: Eximbills Microservices/cloud, digital trade, supply chain finance platform integration, trade-based money laundering (TBML) controls, vessel and shipment checks.

Description:
