Consistently recognized in Fortune Magazine's Top 25 World's Best Workplaces in partnership with Great Place to Work®, TP empowers enterprise technology partners to scale strategic go-to-market and partner success operations seamlessly across premier global markets.

**Our Work Culture**

At TP, we remain true to our core values of integrity, respect, professionalism, innovation, and commitment:

* **Autonomous:** We encourage and trust your independent judgment to prioritize high-leverage interventions across your portfolio.
* **Progressive Work Environment:** Clear vertical and horizontal growth pathways backed by structured coaching and tier-readiness programs.
* **Flexible & Impact-Driven:** We emphasize tangible outcomes, commercial retention, and partner health over activity volume.
* **Innovative:** Every idea matters—we empower operators to build new 0-to-1 playbooks and optimize operational workflows.
* **Inclusive:** A collaborative global culture where diverse perspectives are celebrated and everyone wins together.

**About the job**

As a Partner Customer Success Manager (PCSM), you are the dedicated post-sales commercial owner and strategic platform advisor for a high-value portfolio of 150–250 accounting firms, bookkeepers, and fractional CFOs. Within our partner GTM model, this segment represents highly defensible recurring revenue and the foundation of end-client subscription adoption. In this role, you protect the partner book against competitor migration, accelerate multi-product adoption (including Core Accounting, Payroll, Payments, Expense Management, Time, and Accountant Suites), and empower advisory firms to scale their practices efficiently.  
  
You operate through a proven Scaled Success motion—pairing an annual scheduled value cadence with real-time, signal-triggered 1:1 interventions and digital 1:many leverage. This is a high-impact role combining consultative account stewardship, data-driven prioritization, and authentic domain credibility.

***Competitive annual base salary, 95,000 Annual CAD and French BIL premium 4000 Annual CAD, commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive performance-based incentive programs tied to portfolio retention, expansion ARR, and partner health metrics with an annual OTE of up to 10%.***

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

The Partner Customer Success Manager executes across four strategic pillars to drive partner health, revenue retention, and ecosystem expansion:

* **Scaled Portfolio Management & Cadence:** Own and manage a designated portfolio of 150–250 accounting, bookkeeping, and advisory firms as their primary post-sales point of contact; execute structured annual value reviews supported by automated mid-year health check-ins.
* **Signal-Triggered Rapid Intervention:** Monitor CRM health metrics, engagement indicators, and platform telemetry in real time; proactively intervene 1:1 whenever risk triggers fire (e.g., stalled client onboarding, platform usage drops, or competitor migration signals).
* **Revenue Defense & Churn Prevention:** Protect whole-book partner relationships to prevent silent attrition of entire underlying client subscriptions, developing proactive recovery playbooks for accounts showing disengagement or decline.
* **Client Book Migration & Multi-Product Attach:** Partner with firm principals to migrate additional client books onto the cloud platform; drive organic expansion and cross-sell across ecosystem solutions including Payroll, Payments, Corporate Cards/Expense Management, Bill Pay, and Accountant Suites.
* **Practice Onboarding & Tier Progression:** Lead structured onboarding from initial introduction to accelerate time-to-first-value; coach accounting professionals through certification programs (e.g., ProAdvisor) and tier progression milestones.
* **Campaign Targeting & Digital Leverage:** Deploy pre-built expansion toolkits, educational webinars, and digital 1:many campaigns targeted at qualifying client segments across the portfolio to drive self-serve adoption.
* **Dedicated Partner Escalation Route:** Serve as the trusted, authoritative single point of contact for complex partner operational inquiries; coordinate with Technical Support, Approvals/KYB, and Risk teams to deliver industry-leading response resolution.
* **Voice of the Partner Channel:** Act as internal partner champion by surfacing recurring workflow bottlenecks, data-mapping gaps, and product enhancements directly to Product, Engineering, and RevOps leadership.

**Job Requirements (Minimum skills and technical requirements)**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree, College diploma, or equivalent professional experience.
* **Experience:** 3+ years in Customer Success, Partner Success, Account Management, or B2B Client Engagement within B2B SaaS, FinTech, or Cloud software (candidates with 1+ years in a high-volume, scaled CS motion demonstrating exceptional commercial results are strongly considered).
* **Domain Knowledge:** Demonstrated working understanding of accounting and bookkeeping fundamentals, compliance workflows, and practice management operations.
* **Portfolio Management at Scale:** Proven track record managing a large book of business (150+ accounts) using smart prioritization, automated triggers, and digital leverage rather than unsustainable blanket high-touch.
* **Commercial Track Record:** Demonstrated success in driving product adoption, expanding recurring revenue (ARR/NRR), and safeguarding retention within a matrixed enterprise organization.
* **Tooling & Data Literacy:** Proficiency with enterprise CRM and CS tooling (Salesforce, ChurnZero, Gainsight) and analytics platforms; adept at interpreting health scores, telemetry data, and task queues to guide daily outreach.
* **Bilingual Communication preferred (Canada Hires):** Exceptional professional verbal and written communication skills in both English and French (minimum CEFR C1 proficiency required).

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Commercial Acumen:** Balances consultative advocacy with strong commercial instincts to identify cross-sell opportunities, run business reviews, and articulate ROI to firm owners.
* **Data-Driven Prioritization:** Ability to filter signal from noise across large datasets to invest high-touch effort where it drives maximum retention and growth impact.
* **Influence Without Authority:** Skilled at motivating external partner principals to adopt new workflows while coordinating internal cross-functional partners (Sales, Product, Support, Approvals) to resolve blockers.
* **Accountability & Resilience:** Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ownership over commercial outcomes; maintains composure, focus, and empathy under high-volume demands.
* **Adaptive & Solution-Oriented Communication:** Smoothly transitions between strategic advisory conversations with firm leaders and practical, technical workflow troubleshooting with operational staff.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Accounting Certifications:** Foundational qualification in accounting or bookkeeping (e.g., CPA, CA, CFA, ACCA, ICB, CIPP) or official ProAdvisor certification.
* **Platform Experience:** Hands-on experience with QuickBooks, Float, Xero, or comparable financial management, spend management, and ERP software ecosystems.
* **Scaled CS Methodology:** Direct experience in pooled, digital-first, or automated customer success delivery models within global BPO or high-growth tech environments.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Structured career advancement pathways supported by self-assessments, virtual training, and guided leadership curriculum.
* Comprehensive paid 4-week product and onboarding training, plus generous paid annual leave.
* Continuous professional learning through progressive, tenure-specific certification and enablement programs.
* Competitive base salary complemented by performance-based incentive and quarterly reward structures.
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, plus Employee and Family Assistance Programs (EFAP).
* Vibrant, collaborative workplace with dedicated Rewards & Recognition celebrations.

**Schedule**

Fixed schedule: Monday to Friday, 9-hour shift (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM local time). No weekend or overnight rotations required.

**Location**

TP Toronto Office (75 Eglinton Ave. East, Toronto) – Onsite

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

TP is home to a global family with diverse backgrounds, cultures, and lived experiences. We embrace diversity and never discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other protected grounds.  
  
Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: We may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI) tools, to assist with candidate sourcing, resume evaluation, and interview scheduling. These tools augment our recruitment team and do not replace human judgment. All hiring decisions are made thoughtfully by our recruitment and leadership teams in full alignment with human rights and privacy legislation.  
  
Accessibility & Accommodations: Teleperformance welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all stages of the assessment and interview process.

It is our mission to always provide an environment where our employees feel valued, inspired, and supported, so that they can bring their best selves to work every day. We believe that when employees are happy and healthy, they are more productive, creative, and engaged. We are committed to providing a workplace that is conducive to happiness and a healthy work-life balance. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion and diversity, where everyone feels welcome and valued. Teleperformance is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Senior Food Programs Manager
Description:
**ABOUT BEZOS ACADEMY**

At Bezos Academy, we believe all children deserve the great start that excellent early education provides, including in under-resourced communities. Our mission is to nurture the potential in every child to become a creative leader, original thinker, and lifelong learner by inventing the solutions needed to scale early childhood education. We are a unique organization that realizes our mission in two ways. First, we operate a multi-state network of schools in under-resourced communities, offering quality Montessori-inspired preschool at no cost to families. Second, we create tools, products, technology, and other solutions designed to reach young children and their caregivers well beyond the walls of our schools. We aspire to have a profound, large-scale impact on children ages zero to five.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As the Senior Food Programs Manager at Bezos Academy, you will own the design, execution, and ongoing improvement of our multi-state preschool network's food programs spanning onsite food preparation, vendor-provided service, and funding through the federal Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP). In this role, you will ensure all students are nourished through a compliant, scalable, and financially optimized program that generates meaningful reimbursement revenue across the network whether the preschool is using vendor-supplied meals and snacks or cooking food from scratch on site. You will set up the metrics by which meal quality, food safety, and cost are measured and help develop training so school staff deliver strong results. You will lead improvements, from vendor procurement to new site launches, that keep food service standardized, compliant, and cost-effective as the network matures. You bring to this role the judgment to balance nutrition, compliance, and cost without compromising on any of them, and the operational rigor to ensure that every child in a Bezos Academy classroom eats nutritional high-quality food across states and sites.

**LOCATION**

* Arizona, Florida, Kentucky, Texas, or Washington and within two hours' drive to multiple Bezos Academy preschools (please see our website for school locations); Seattle, WA preferred.
* Relocation support is available for those willing to relocate to Seattle, WA.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* This is a full-time, benefits-eligible, exempt (salaried) position.
* **The full salary range for this position, across all applicable United States geographies, is $113,000 - $216,000 per year.** The upper portion of the salary range is typically reserved for employees who have been in the role for multiple years and have demonstrated strong performance over time. Starting salary will vary by location, qualifications, and prior experience; during the interview process, candidates will learn the starting salary range applicable for their location.
* This role includes 15 paid days of vacation, 4 days of paid personal time off, 9 paid days of sick (care) time, 9 paid holidays, 5 paid days off for an organization-wide winter break, and additional time off if required by applicable law. Benefits for this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, a 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution match, paid parental leave, an employer-matched flexible spending account for dependent care, and more. Please see here for details.

Title: Pathways Operations Manager Intern – Summer 2027 (Canada-Wide Opportunities)

---------------

Join Amazon's Pathways Operations internship and tackle real-world operational challenges at one of our dynamic facilities. Your days will involve collaborating with operations teams to identify process improvements, analyze workflows, and implement solutions that enhance efficiency. You'll participate in cross-functional meetings, gather data to support your projects, and present findings to leadership. Beyond your core project work, you'll have opportunities to shadow different departments, learn how various teams interconnect, and understand how your contributions fit into Amazon's broader operations network.
  
  

* This program is open to external candidates only; current Amazon employees are not eligible to apply. The role appears on Amazon's internal portal solely for employee referral purposes.
* Candidates should be currently enrolled in an MBA or Master's program, and be able to commit to a 12-week summer 2027 internship.

* Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA internship roles will only be selected to interview for one.

  
PROGRAM OVERVIEW: Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership. Full-time participants gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies — collaborating with cross-functional teams, taking on progressively greater responsibilities, and building a network of peers who become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon.
  
  
THE INTERNSHIP: As a Pathways intern, you'll spend 12 weeks embedded in one of Amazon's fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. You'll split your time between hands-on operations exposure — shadowing managers, leading gemba walks, and participating in business reviews — and owning a strategic project that you'll develop into a white paper and present to senior site leadership. This is your opportunity to experience Amazon's operations firsthand and demonstrate your leadership potential. Successful interns may be considered for a return offer into the full-time Pathways program.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and implement strategic operational improvements
* Lead data-driven projects that optimize supply chain processes and enhance the customer and associate experience
* Analyze complex business challenges and develop scalable, innovative solutions
* Engage in cross-functional teamwork to drive continuous improvement initiatives
* Contribute to operational efficiency and strategic decision-making processes

  
A day in the life  
Your day will be fast-paced and hands-on, immersed in a live operations environment. You'll engage in site-specific projects, analyze operational challenges, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that directly enhance customer experiences. You'll work alongside operations leaders and frontline associates, gaining valuable experience in managing a dynamic workforce.  
  
About the team  
You'll join a site operations team that drives results 24/7 to deliver for our customers. Our site teams include Area Managers, Operations Managers, Safety and HR, and front-line associates, all working together to achieve operational excellence. Your site leadership team will mentor you in Amazon's culture of ownership and innovation, while providing opportunities to lead real process improvements. Title: Marketing Operations Manager
Description:
Deep Knowledge Group · MarTech Department · Reports to the Head of MarTech

**The role**
------------

Deep Knowledge Group runs a portfolio of longevity and health-tech websites and platforms. Today the website tracking, the application analytics, the CRM and the campaign reports each work on their own. You will connect them: set up tracking, run the analytics and CRM systems, and make sure enquiries and reports reach the people who act on them.

**What you will own**
---------------------

### **Tracking and measurement**

* Create and run the company’s Google tag / GA4 account, install tags across Wix, custom-HTML and application sites, and remove the legacy tags that would double-fire.
* Verify sites in Search Console, submit sitemaps and keep reporting access working.
* Implement advertising pixels and conversion events with consent handling.
* Test that events actually arrive, with source, consent and duplicate checks, and keep a coverage record per site.

### **Analytics platform (PostHog)**

* Define a small shared event set, source and campaign fields, and how an anonymous visitor becomes a known contact.
* Run PostHog: projects, access, cost, identity handoff between domains, and event-based dashboards that update without manual spreadsheets.

### **CRM and automation (HubSpot)**

* Map form submissions, sources and outcomes into CRM contacts, with duplicate handling.
* Repair and maintain inbound email classification and routing, so every actionable enquiry reaches a named owner.
* Build audience segments with clear entry, exit and suppression rules, and run one follow-up workflow with the BisDev team.

### **Reporting and process**

* Keep dashboards labelled with data freshness and alert on collection failures.
* Document the setup so another person can run it: procedures, event definitions and a record of every automation and its owner.

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* Weeks 1–4: take over the new Google tag account, verify the priority sites in Search Console, and record a baseline of what tracks and what doesn’t.
* Weeks 5–8: agree the event and identity rules, and install tracking on the pilot sites in a way that survives page changes.
* Weeks 9–13: connect forms to the CRM, fix enquiry routing, and publish the first automatically updated dashboard.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, marketing analytics or a similar hands-on role.
* Hands-on with Google Tag Manager, GA4 and Search Console, including consent and debugging.
* Experience with a CRM and marketing automation, ideally HubSpot (we also have Zoho in use), including forms, workflows and routing.
* Experience with an event analytics tool such as PostHog, Mixpanel or Amplitude, including user identity.
* Comfortable reading page source and network requests to confirm that tracking works.
* You write clearly and document what you build.

### **Helpful**

* Experience with Wix and custom or application sites, and Cloudflare.
* Server-side tracking or conversion APIs.
* Basic SQL or scripting.
* Experience with GDPR or similar consent rules.
* Fluent Russian.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* Web development: page templates, the scheduled checking worker and site fixes belong to a web engineer.
* Content and SEO writing, which belongs to the editor.
* Commercial follow-up, which BisDev owns. You build the routing and fields; they run the conversations.

**How you will work**
---------------------

You will work with the Head of MarTech, the web operations specialist (forms, publishing and web edits), the BisDev team, Front-end and Product. Tools include Google Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console, PostHog, HubSpot, Slack and Google Workspace. Working hours are flexible, with overlap with UK time (our team works roughly 8:00–18:00 UK).

Title: Senior Procurement Manager
Description:
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Senior Procurement Manager leads strategic aspects within key Indirect Categories such as IT, Logistics, Marketing, and Human Capital across divisions on a global level. The purpose of the role is to develop and maintain organizational structures and necessary alignments to ensure an effective procurement process while providing high-value external solutions to support business projects in Saudi Arabia. This position acts as the primary procurement business partner for Business Units in KSA, ensuring alignment with budgets, strategy, productivity, and margin expansion initiatives. Success in this role involves designing and delivering comprehensive procurement strategies, fostering relationships with stakeholders, and maintaining operational compliance and governance.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Business Engagement & Demand Forecasting**

  
  

* Develop a deep understanding of business unit strategies, operational plans, and upcoming requirements across all KSA divisions.
* Lead structured demand planning and forecasting cycles to ensure accurate visibility of procurement needs.
* Maintain a rolling procurement pipeline for KSA, updated monthly and shared with regional category and sourcing teams.
* Facilitate early engagement between stakeholders and procurement to ensure timely planning and alignment with category strategies.
  

  

#### **Compliance, Governance & Policy Adherence**

  
  

* Ensure all procurement activities within KSA adhere to corporate policies, procedures, and delegated authority frameworks.
* Monitor compliance levels across business units and implement corrective actions where gaps are identified.
* Conduct periodic training and awareness sessions for local stakeholders on procurement processes, systems, and compliance expectations.
* Support internal and external audit requirements by providing documentation, clarifications, and process insights.
  

  

#### **Coordination with Regional Category & Sourcing Teams**

  
  

* Act as the primary interface between KSA stakeholders and category/sourcing teams based in UAE and Egypt.
* Translate business needs into clear category briefs and sourcing requests to enable efficient remote support.
* Track progress of sourcing activities and ensure timely delivery of outcomes (RFPs, supplier evaluations, negotiations, contracts).
* Escalate bottlenecks or misalignments and drive resolution to maintain service levels.
  

  

#### **Procurement Planning & Execution Support**

  
  

* Support the execution of sourcing events, supplier onboarding, and contract finalization in coordination with regional teams.
* Ensure procurement requests (PRs) are complete, accurate, and aligned with approved budgets and category strategies.
* Monitor contract lifecycle milestones and support renewals, amendments, and performance reviews.
  

  

#### **Stakeholder Relationship Management**

  
  

* Build strong, trust-based relationships with business leaders, project managers, finance, and operations teams across KSA.
* Provide proactive guidance on procurement timelines, market insights, and sourcing options.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to stakeholders, helping them optimize cost, quality, and risk outcomes.
  

  

#### **Supplier Performance & Issue Resolution**

  
  

* Support supplier performance monitoring by gathering feedback from KSA stakeholders and sharing insights with category managers.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier issues, disputes, or service failures in collaboration with regional teams.
* Contribute to supplier review meetings and ensure local performance data is captured and acted upon.
  

  

#### **Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

  
  

* Deliver regular reporting on procurement pipeline, compliance metrics, sourcing progress, and savings achievements for KSA.
* Identify opportunities to streamline local procurement processes and enhance stakeholder experience.
* Contribute to regional procurement improvement initiatives and support implementation within KSA.
  

  

#### **Local Market & Regulatory Awareness**

  
  

* Maintain awareness of KSA-specific regulatory requirements, local content rules, and market dynamics.
* Ensure procurement activities reflect local legal and compliance obligations.
* Provide insights to category teams to help shape regional strategies with KSA-specific considerations.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and financial modeling tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to execute projects successfully and deliver external solutions timely, within budget, and meeting quality standards.
* Understanding of Procurement KPIs related to market insights, price and demand development, and performance metrics.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* University/Advanced degree needed.
* Master's Degree or other advanced degree preferred.
* CIPS (or equivalent) qualification.
* 10+ years of relevant business experience, preferably in Procurement, Automotive, Retail, or Real Estate industries.

**Mission:** To serve the needs of transit riders by providing a safe, reliable, efficient, and accessible mass public transit service through a seamless integrated network to create access to opportunity for everyone.

  

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------

Looking to lead high-value, strategic procurements that support TTC's critical operations and capital programs? We are seeking a Lead Procurement & Category Specialist to manage complex procurements across areas such as Construction, Major Projects, Professional Services, Information Technology, Specialized Engineered Equipment, and Revenue Vehicles.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end procurement activities, including sourcing strategy, competitive and negotiated procurements, contract development, stakeholder engagement, supplier negotiations, and contract award. You will act as a trusted advisor to internal clients, providing expert guidance on procurement strategy, market conditions, risk management, commercial terms, and procurement best practices.

As a subject matter expert, you will oversee high-profile and high-risk procurement initiatives, develop category strategies, support continuous improvement initiatives, and provide mentorship and guidance to procurement staff. You will partner with internal stakeholders to develop sourcing strategies, procurement plans, evaluation methodologies, contract structures, and commercial approaches that align with business objectives and procurement best practices.

  

You will lead competitive and negotiated procurement processes, including RFPs, NRFPs, RFBs, RFIs, ACANs, prequalification initiatives, and sole-source procurements. This includes coordinating evaluations, facilitating negotiations, managing bidder communications, preparing award recommendations, and supporting approvals through TTC governance processes.

  

You will serve as the procurement lead and subject matter expert for your assigned category, providing strategic advice on procurement approaches, contract terms, risk management, market conditions, supplier capabilities, and commercial negotiations. You will also support category management activities by conducting market research, evaluating industry trends, identifying sourcing opportunities, and developing long-term procurement strategies.

  

As a senior member of the team, you will mentor procurement staff, contribute to policy and process improvements, lead training initiatives, and support the continuous evolution of procurement practices across the department.

Apply accounting principles and practices

Apply analytical skills

Communicate in a variety of mediums

Create, document, and manage information and records

Demonstrate knowledge of the industry and / or sector

Demonstrate specialized expertise and knowledge in the assigned field

Use office technology, software and applications

**Position Overview**

The Property Manager is responsible for the financial administration, day-to-day operations and long-term management of the assigned property portfolio. * Review monthly and annual operating expense financials, including variance analysis, with the external Account Manager and participate in the mandatory monthly and quarterly reviews.
* Review & Approve Tenant refund payments in accordance with established approval processes.
* Oversee insurance claims through resolution, coordinating with external service providers, insurers and internal stakeholders, and track all related expenses to ensure they are properly documented in the Trial Balance.

Accounts Receivable & Tenant Credit Management

* Monitor accounts receivable, rental arrears, identifying risks and coordinating appropriate follow-up actions.
* Participate in monthly accounts receivable meetings and bad debt provision reviews.
* Collaborate with Asset Management and Legal to address delinquent accounts and coordinate default notices.

Tenant Relations & Property Coordination

* Build and maintain strong tenant relationships through regular engagement, including quarterly touchpoints with anchor tenants.
* Review tenant sales performance, provide quarterly updates to the AVP and coordinate sales reporting and processing.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external service providers to address tenant matters and support portfolio operations.

Procurement & Vendor Management

* Review and approve scopes of work, bid analyses and vendor recommendations submitted by external service providers.
* Provide oversight of procurement activities to ensure alignment with portfolio requirements and financial objectives.

Capital Planning & Project Management

* Collaborate with Technical Services on capital projects, including reviewing plans, participating in site inspections, and monitoring project progress.

* Liaise with Leasing and Development regarding on-site tenant requests and coordinate tenant improvement allowances and landlord’s work in accordance with lease obligations and established responsibility matrices.

* Minimum five (5) years’ experience in Property Management.

Title: Retail Operations Manager
Description:
Retail Operations Manager – Kids Toys retail brand

**Job Summary**

Client is looking for an experienced and commercially driven **Retail Operations Manager** to oversee the operations and business performance of all Client's retail stores.

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, improving store profitability, managing inventory, overseeing buying and merchandising activities, developing supplier relationships and ensuring an excellent customer experience across all locations.

This role requires a hands-on retail leader with strong commercial awareness, analytical skills and the ability to lead teams, identify business opportunities and translate performance insights into practical actions.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Retail Operations & Sales Management**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of all Client's stores, ensuring consistent operational standards and efficient store management.
* Drive sales performance by setting, communicating and monitoring store and individual sales targets.
* Review daily, weekly and monthly sales results, identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions.
* Conduct regular store visits to monitor operational standards, customer service, sales performance and overall store execution.
* Ensure stores maintain attractive layouts, effective product displays, proper visual merchandising and a positive shopping environment.
* Identify opportunities to improve store productivity, sales conversion and customer experience.

**2. Inventory, Merchandising & Buying**

* Oversee stock management across all stores, ensuring optimal inventory levels and product availability.
* Monitor fast-moving, slow-moving and ageing stock and implement appropriate actions to improve stock turnover and sell-through.
* Plan replenishment and stock transfers between stores based on sales trends, inventory levels and customer demand.
* Oversee product buying and ordering activities, ensuring purchasing decisions are aligned with sales forecasts, market demand and business objectives.
* Analyze product and category performance to identify buying opportunities, reduce excess inventory and improve stock investment.
* Identify new products, brands and emerging toy trends to strengthen the company's product range and drive additional sales.
* Ensure new products and brands are effectively introduced, displayed and promoted across stores.

**3. Supplier & Market Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, brand principals and product representatives.
* Negotiate competitive pricing, payment terms, promotional support and other commercial arrangements to improve profitability.
* Follow up on purchase orders, deliveries, product availability and supplier-related issues.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, product offerings and pricing through regular market visits and industry engagement.
* Identify new suppliers, brands and business opportunities that can enhance the company's product portfolio and competitive position.

**4. Financial Performance & Profitability**

* Monitor sales, gross margins and overall profitability across all Client's stores.
* Review store and business P&L performance, identify key financial drivers and take action to address underperformance.
* Improve gross margins through effective buying, supplier negotiations, product selection and pricing strategies.
* Monitor discounts, promotions and promotional activities to drive sales while protecting profitability.
* Identify opportunities to control operating expenses, improve operational efficiency and maximize store profitability.
* Ensure effective stock investment and inventory turnover to support healthy cash flow and business returns.

**5. Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach and develop Store Managers, Supervisors and retail teams to achieve business and operational objectives.
* Monitor individual and store team performance, providing regular feedback, guidance and support.
* Improve team capabilities through training in product knowledge, selling techniques, customer service and store operations.
* Ensure clear communication of targets, responsibilities and operational expectations across all stores.
* Address performance gaps and operational challenges in coordination with Human Resources and relevant departments.

**6. Business Development & Reporting**

* Identify and recommend opportunities to improve store performance, expand product categories and enhance the customer experience.
* Oversee store improvement, renovation and development initiatives in coordination with relevant departments.
* Work closely with Finance, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain and Human Resources to ensure effective retail operations.
* Prepare regular management reports covering sales, profitability, inventory, buying, supplier performance, store operations and key business opportunities.
* Present business insights and recommendations to senior management to support commercial and operational decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in retail management, sales operations, merchandising, buying or multi-store operations.
* ***Experience in managing multiple retail locations, preferably in toys, children's products, specialty retail*** or a similar consumer retail environment.
* Proven ability to manage sales targets, inventory, customer experience and store profitability.
* Strong understanding of retail buying, merchandising, stock management, supplier relations and commercial negotiations.
* Experience reviewing sales reports, gross margins, stock movement and P&L performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Commercially minded, results-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following key areas:

* **Sales Performance:** Achievement of sales targets and overall retail growth.
* **Profitability:** Gross margin improvement, P&L performance and operating cost control.
* **Inventory Management:** Stock turnover, sell-through, product availability and ageing stock reduction.
* **Buying & Merchandising:** Effective purchasing decisions, product range development and supplier performance.
* **Operational Excellence:** Store standards, customer experience and operational efficiency.
* **People Development:** Team performance, productivity, training and staff development.

Work Schedule & Conditions

* Full-time position following retail operational and business requirements.
* Two days off per week, in accordance with the company's work schedule.
* Regular visits to all Client's stores are required.
* Occasional market visits, supplier meetings and business-related travel may be required.

Pay: QAR17,000.00 - QAR20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

The Director establishes, implements, and enforces comprehensive safety and security policies, procedures, and operational standards consistent with Pyramid Global Hospitality (PGH) expectations and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

  
  

This position oversees the daily operations of the Safety & Security Department, including staffing, training, investigations, emergency response coordination, incident reporting, access control, and risk mitigation.

  
  

As a member of the resort's leadership team, the Director collaborates with executive leadership and departmental leaders to promote accountability, regulatory compliance, proactive risk prevention, and a culture of safety.

  
  

The Director serves as a primary liaison with local law enforcement, fire departments, emergency medical services, and other public safety agencies.

  
  

Through professional leadership, sound judgment, and a People First approach, the Director ensures that safety and security remain essential priorities in the overall guest and Curator experience.

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Public Safety, Emergency Management, Security Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant training and professional experience may be considered.
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive leadership experience in security, law enforcement, public safety, or a related field, preferably within a large hotel, resort, entertainment venue, or hospitality operation.

* Relevant certifications in CPR, First Aid, life safety, or emergency response.
* Strong knowledge of investigative procedures, incident documentation, report writing, evidence preservation, and corrective action recommendations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, security management systems, surveillance technology, and electronic reporting platforms.
* Working knowledge of fire protection systems, access control, surveillance equipment, keyless entry systems, and emergency communication procedures.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold team members accountable while maintaining a positive and professional working environment.
* Knowledge of applicable OSHA requirements and federal, state, and local safety regulations.

**Leadership & Performance Standards**
--------------------------------------

### **1. Strategic Safety & Security Leadership**

* Provide executive-level direction and oversight of the resort's Safety & Security Department.
* Establish and maintain comprehensive security procedures designed to protect guests, Curators, resort assets, and property.
* Develop and implement preventive security measures to identify, assess, and reduce operational risks.
* Maintain a visible leadership presence throughout the resort, promoting safety awareness, professionalism, and operational accountability.
* Collaborate with resort executive leadership to evaluate security needs, operational challenges, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Ensure departmental practices align with Pyramid Global Hospitality policies, operating standards, and organizational values.

### **2. Emergency Preparedness & Crisis Management**

* Direct the development, implementation, and continuous evaluation of the resort's emergency response procedures.
* Coordinate emergency preparedness activities, including fire drills, evacuation exercises, alarm testing, and emergency response simulations.
* Maintain effective working relationships with law enforcement, fire departments, emergency medical services, and other public safety partners.
* Provide leadership and coordination during emergencies, critical incidents, and situations requiring immediate protective action.
* Ensure timely notification and escalation of significant incidents to resort executive leadership and other appropriate stakeholders.
* Evaluate emergency response outcomes and recommend procedural improvements to strengthen operational readiness.

### **3. Incident Management & Investigations**

* Oversee the timely and accurate documentation, investigation, and reporting of guest and Curator incidents, accidents, complaints, and security concerns.
* Conduct or direct internal and external investigations within the scope of departmental authority and in coordination with Human Resources and executive leadership when appropriate.
* Ensure investigative records are factual, objective, confidential, and maintained according to company procedures.
* Review Security Officer daily activity reports, incident reports, and investigation findings to identify trends and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with Human Resources on employee-related investigations, workplace conduct concerns, and disciplinary recommendations.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and communication concerning incidents that may present legal, financial, operational, or reputational risks.

### **4. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Prevention**

* Support compliance with applicable OSHA standards, life safety requirements, fire prevention procedures, and other relevant regulatory obligations.
* Participate in safety committee activities, hazard identification initiatives, inspections, and workplace accident prevention programs.
* Identify unsafe conditions and ensure timely reporting, corrective action, and appropriate escalation.
* Maintain accurate departmental records involving inspections, licenses, certifications, and applicable service contracts.
* Partner with Human Resources, Engineering, and resort leadership to support workplace injury prevention and workers' compensation risk reduction.
* Evaluate existing safety and security programs and recommend improvements to minimize incidents and operational exposure.

### **5. Departmental Operations & Asset Protection**

* Direct the daily operations of the Safety & Security Department to ensure effective coverage and operational readiness.
* Oversee security patrols, surveillance activities, facility access, key control, and the protection of resort assets.
* Establish and maintain appropriate security staffing for resort functions, special events, and operational demands.
* Ensure security equipment, technology, supplies, and departmental resources are properly maintained and operational.
* Oversee lost-and-found security procedures in collaboration with Housekeeping and other relevant departments.
* Review staffing schedules, payroll hours, departmental reports, and resource utilization.
* Support responsible financial management while maintaining appropriate security standards.
* Maintain the ability to perform essential departmental functions when operationally necessary.

### **6. People Leadership & Curator Development**

* Lead the recruitment, selection, onboarding, training, supervision, and professional development of Safety & Security personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and hold team members accountable for consistently meeting departmental and company standards.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations, coaching discussions, and departmental meetings.
* Administer progressive disciplinary actions in partnership with Human Resources and in accordance with PGH policies.
* Promote a People First leadership culture that values professionalism, fairness, collaboration, and respect.
* Develop supervisory talent through mentoring, cross-training, and succession planning.
* Address workplace concerns promptly, professionally, and consistently.
* Foster a positive working environment that supports employee engagement, retention, and service excellence.

### **7. Guest Experience & Professional Standards**

* Ensure Security personnel provide professional, respectful, and timely assistance to guests and Curators.
* Maintain a calm, approachable, and reassuring presence when addressing sensitive or challenging situations.
* Resolve security-related guest concerns while protecting the safety and interests of all involved parties.
* Uphold company standards regarding appearance, attendance, punctuality, confidentiality, and professional conduct.
* Collaborate with operational departments to support a seamless guest experience without compromising safety requirements.

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

**Constantly**

* Direct and oversee effective daily Safety & Security Department operations.
* Conduct or oversee security patrols throughout the resort.
* Enforce established safety, security, and emergency response procedures.
* Maintain effective access control and key management programs.
* Review daily Security Officer shift reports and significant incident documentation.
* Monitor unsafe conditions and ensure timely reporting and escalation.
* Provide leadership, direction, and operational support to departmental personnel.
* Maintain professional communication with resort leadership regarding significant safety and security concerns.
* Ensure proper departmental staffing, training, supervision, and accountability.
* Promote Curator empowerment, professionalism, and operational excellence.

**Frequently**

* Investigate incidents, complaints, accidents, and security concerns.
* Attend executive leadership and departmental meetings.
* Conduct departmental briefings, coaching sessions, and performance evaluations.
* Review payroll hours, staffing schedules, and operational reports.
* Coordinate security support for resort events and special functions.
* Partner with Housekeeping on lost-and-found procedures.
* Complete administrative reports, investigative documentation, and departmental records.
* Evaluate security procedures and recommend operational improvements.
* Provide safety and security training to resort personnel.

**Occasionally**

* Participate in emergency response exercises, fire drills, and alarm testing.
* Conduct internal and external investigations as needed.
* Develop or revise departmental security policies and procedures.
* Perform additional duties assigned by resort executive leadership.

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------

The position requires the ability to perform administrative and operational responsibilities throughout a large resort environment.

* **Sitting:** Occasionally, while completing reports, reviewing documentation, and conducting interviews.
* **Standing and Walking:** Constantly, including security patrols across resort grounds and facilities, potentially up to ten miles per day.
* **Crouching, Kneeling, and Stooping:** Occasionally or rarely, as required for inspections and operational duties.
* **Climbing:** Occasionally, including stairs and ladders.
* **Twisting and Reaching:** Occasionally, during surveillance, inspections, and assistance activities.
* **Handling and Grasping:** Occasionally, when operating equipment, tools, doors, and security devices.
* **Pushing and Pulling:** Occasionally, with an average weight of approximately 35 pounds and a maximum of 75 pounds.
* **Lifting and Carrying:** Occasionally, with an average weight of approximately 35 pounds and a maximum of 75 pounds.
* **Equipment Operation:** Occasionally, including authorized resort vehicles and security-related equipment.

Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

**Communication & Sensory Requirements**
----------------------------------------

* Communicate frequently with guests, Curators, law enforcement, and members of the public.
* Utilize telephones, two-way radios, and emergency communication systems.
* Observe and assess conditions throughout the resort and surrounding premises.
* Review reports, surveillance information, and electronic documentation.
* Recognize and appropriately respond to safety concerns, alarms, and environmental hazards.
* Maintain effective situational awareness during routine operations and emergency circumstances.

**Mental & Professional Requirements**
--------------------------------------

* Demonstrate sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism when addressing sensitive or challenging situations.
* Manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to changing operational demands.
* Maintain attention to detail when reviewing investigations, incident reports, and safety conditions.
* Exercise flexibility regarding work schedules, emergency coverage, and business needs.
* Remain composed and decisive during emergencies and high-pressure situations.
* Balance guest satisfaction, operational efficiency, Curator engagement, and safety responsibilities.
* Maintain confidentiality regarding investigations, personnel matters, and sensitive resort information.
* Demonstrate leadership accountability and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

The Director of Safety & Security performs duties throughout an active resort and indoor waterpark environment, including administrative offices, guest areas, operational facilities, outdoor grounds, and designated security locations.

The position may involve exposure to varying temperatures, humidity, noise, dust, cleaning products, maintenance materials, and other conditions commonly associated with hospitality and recreational facilities.

The Director must adhere to Pyramid Global Hospitality safety standards and utilize appropriate protective equipment when required.

The position may require varied work schedules, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and emergency response availability based on operational needs.

**Organizational Expectations**
-------------------------------

As a Director within OKANA Resort & Indoor Waterpark, this leader is expected to demonstrate the highest standards of integrity, accountability, professionalism, and ethical decision-making.

The Director must establish a culture in which safety concerns are promptly addressed, employees are appropriately trained, operational risks are proactively managed, and all Curators understand their individual responsibilities for maintaining a safe environment.

The Director is expected to partner effectively with Human Resources, Engineering, Waterpark Operations, Rooms, Food & Beverage, and executive leadership to ensure consistent safety practices across the resort.

**The Director of Safety & Security plays a critical role in protecting the people, property, operations, and reputation of OKANA Resort & Indoor Waterpark while supporting Pyramid Global Hospitality's People First philosophy.**

Title: Regional Sales Manager - Cross Border Trading & Imported Building Material
Description:
***About Us***
--------------

Backed by top regional and global VCs, **BRKZ is Saudi Arabia's fastest-growing construction-tech startup**. Our web platform, mobile apps and WhatsApp channels give contractors instant access to 7,000+ building-material SKUs from 1,100+ vetted suppliers, with quotes in minutes and buy-now-pay-later financing built in. In just two years we have on-boarded 850+ contracting companies, supported giga-projects such as **NEOM** and **King Salman Park**, and scaled RFQs to $350 million while keeping positive unit economics.

You can read more about BRKZ's latest news on Forbes, TechCrunch & Wamda.

  

**Job Summary:**
----------------

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven **Regional Sales Manager – Cross-Border (X-Border)** to lead and scale our international sales operations for imported building materials with extended lead times. The ideal candidate will combine deep regional market expertise with strong commercial leadership, excelling at navigating cross-border trade dynamics, managing client expectations around shipping durations, and structuring advance payment terms. This role requires a proactive leader who can build high-performing regional channels, align closely with Procurement and Logistics teams, and drive revenue growth across key international markets.

**What You will do (Responsibilities) :**
-----------------------------------------

* **Regional Expansion:** Identify, develop, and execute go-to-market strategies to capture new business opportunities across target cross-border territories in the construction and building materials sector.
* **Channel & Key Account Leadership:** Establish, manage, and scale strategic partnerships with major regional retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and contractors.
* **Cross-Border Advisory:** Educate regional partners on the value proposition of imported materials, international lead times, Incoterms, and cross-border logistical considerations.
* **End-to-End Supply Chain Alignment:** Collaborate closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, and Customs/Logistics teams to ensure smooth cross-border transit, accurate shipment tracking, and on-time project delivery.
* **Commercial Proposals & Tenders:** Oversee the preparation and presentation of commercial quotations, regional proposals, product specifications, and samples to high-value accounts.
* **High-Stakes Negotiation:** Negotiate multi-tier pricing, volume commitments, and advance payment terms (including LCs/TT) to maximize regional profitability and market competitiveness.
* **Regional Demand Forecasting:** Partner with Procurement to analyze regional demand signals, optimize inventory allocation, and manage stock levels across markets.
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor regional economic shifts, regulatory/tariff changes, competitor activities, and global pricing fluctuations to adjust commercial strategy proactively.
* **Escalation Management:** Act as the senior point of escalation to resolve complex cross-border customer inquiries, customs delays, or order-related issues efficiently.
* **Executive Reporting:** Track regional sales pipelines, prepare comprehensive market feedback reports, and present actionable territory insights and growth forecasts to senior leadership.

  

**Who You are (Qualifications & Experience) :**
-----------------------------------------------

  

* **Experience:** Minimum 5–8+ years of B2B sales and regional management experience in building materials, construction supplies, or international trade.
* **Cross-Border Expertise:** Strong working knowledge of international trade regulations, Incoterms, import/export logistics, customs clearance, and cross-border supply chain management.
* **Lead-Time Mastery:** Proven track record of managing extended shipping lead times and aligning client expectations on large-scale or complex orders.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Demonstrated success in high-value B2B negotiations, structuring advance payment terms, and managing multi-country distributor networks.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Arabic.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) or Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides), alongside CRM and pipeline reporting tools.
* **Leadership & Autonomy:** Entrepreneurial, target-driven, and capable of operating independently to build out new territories from the ground up.
* **Mobility:** Willingness and ability to travel frequently across the region for key client meetings, trade shows, and site visits.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* Great opportunity to be part of a start-up with a lot of responsibility and independence early on and where you will have an impact on the entire business
* Attractive compensation package (Competitive base salary + commission structure)
* Product first mindset
* The best idea wins; we are all ears when it comes to ways to do things better
* Exciting stock options
* Career growth opportunities within a fast-growing company.

If you are passionate about **sales, construction materials, and international trade**, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team!

Title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
Canonical is hiring exceptional Sales Operations leaders and experienced analysts to grow and manage our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. Our Sales Operations teams analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.
  
  
You will partner with Canonical’s executive team across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal and provide a focal point to drive improvements. This position requires leadership, initiative and an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to drive continuous improvements in processes, systems, governance and data quality. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and the opportunity to design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
  
  
**Location:**
*These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA, Americas regions.*
The role entails
  
  

* Delivering precise, scalable revenue operations for business through direct, indirect or online channels
* Leading and developing a team of revenue operations analysts in developing policies, driving processes and providing daily operational support and enablement to sales teams and partners
* Driving Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement/Data Enrichment, Customer Relationship Management, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
* Instrumenting, measuring and improving policies and processes across teams covering the entire revenue operations spectrum
* Delivering metrics and reporting to monitor and improve revenue operations effectiveness, including new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals.
* Using data to drive insight, manage territories and channels, improve productivity, and agree and implement actionable change with executive management through regular sales and business reviews.
* Overseeing our sales technology and processes, driving automation and process improvements and partnering with our commercial systems engineering team to continuously improve business systems and integration
* Leading the introduction of new products, pricing, packaging and bundling through systems that are easy for sales and partners to navigate and quote
* Driving data quality, through order processing, new hire training, process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
* Leading and enhancing our commercial review process for evaluating and steering sales and alliance opportunities
* Owning the commission plan and leading the process for setting goals, evaluating and paying against that plan

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* Experience operating in a leadership Revenue Operations role, driving effectiveness of direct, channel and alliance partnerships
* Data-driven and analytical approach with a high attention to detail
* Track record of providing insight through robust CRM and other Revenue Operations technology platforms, data, analytics, compensation systems and processes to deliver excellent revenue operations
* An energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, a problem solver with skill in measuring, identifying and delivering systems and processes that ensure repeatable, scalable outcomes
* Comfort with commercial pressure, and the ability to put revenue teams under appropriate performance pressure
* Organisational skills and the ability to interact and work with stakeholders within all levels of the organisation
* Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
* Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills
* Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
* Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills
  
  

* Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
* Deep understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including driving a team based remotely in multiple time zones
* Experience in mentoring and coaching team members on technical and soft skills, directly contributing to their professional development and performance improvement.

What Canonical offers
  
  
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
*We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.*

Title: Business Growth/Sales Manager
Description:
### **About Jeeny**

Jeeny is a mobile application that eases daily commuting and transportation. Founded in 2012, Jeeny is one of the region’s leading ride-hailing platforms operating across the Middle East, delivering reliable, affordable, and innovative mobility solutions. At Jeeny, we foster a collaborative and fast-paced environment where employees are empowered to make an impact and grow professionally.

We are looking for a high-performing Business Growth/Sales Manager to join our Jeeny for Business (J4B) team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Reporting directly to the Director of Commercial, you will drive the strategic expansion, commercial growth, and operational execution of our end-to-end B2B corporate mobility solutions across the Kingdom.

In this role, you will build long-term client/enterprise partnerships, identify untapped market opportunities, and launch specialised corporate mobility products with smart go-to-market strategies, positioning J4B as the primary transport platform for companies of all sizes.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* B2B Pipeline & Enterprise Acquisition:
* + Build, manage, and execute a strong commercial pipeline across KSA, targeting client segments ranging from high-growth SMEs to multinational Regional Headquarters (RHQs), government bodies, and giga-project contractors.
  + Lead end-to-end sales cycles from initial outreach and high-level client presentations to negotiating and closing long-term corporate mobility agreements.
* Tenders & RFPs:
* + Lead the preparation, commercial structuring, and submission of formal RFPs (Requests for Proposals) and government tenders across public sector entities and giga-project developers.
* Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy & Product Rollout:
* + Develop localized GTM strategies to launch and scale new J4B products, customised corporate packages, and specialised service tiers (including employee commuting, event logistics, and executive chauffeur solutions).
  + Identify untapped market gaps in Saudi Arabia’s corporate transport sector and translate client feedback into actionable product/tech road-map.
* Account Management & Volume Growth:
* + Partner closely with client HR, Finance, and Corporate Travel Managers to ensure smooth on-boarding onto the J4B portal.
  + Monitor account health, drive platform adoption across client employees, and upsell new transport solutions to maximise monthly ride volume and lifetime value (LTV).
* Pricing Framework:
* + Structure competitive corporate rate cards, volume discounts, and customised credit terms while safeguarding healthy unit economics.
* Cross-Functional & Operational Alignment:
* + Collaborate directly with BizOps Manager(s) to ensure corporate SLA compliance, driver fulfilment rates, and quality standards across corporate executive rides.
  + Work alongside Finance teams to ensure timely corporate invoicing, payment collections, account reconciliation, and credit limit management across all J4B accounts.
  + Work alongside Product/Tech teams to translate client feedback and market gaps into scalable portal features, enhanced reporting tools, and seamless enterprise tech integrations.

* + Track and report on core performance metrics, including Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), corporate active users, and pipeline health.
  + Deliver weekly commercial updates, revenue forecasts, and strategic market insights.

  
**Requirements**  

* At least 5 years of proven experience of fast-paced B2B sales or business development experience in KSA, with a strong track record of selling services to SMEs, enterprises, and public sector clients.
* A proven ability to source, negotiate, and successfully close high-value corporate deals while consistently exceeding ambitious revenue targets.
* Fluent in both Arabic and English and excel at building strong, long-lasting relationships with client decision-makers and internal stakeholders.
* Comfortably partners across Operations, Finance, and Product/Tech teams to ensure seamless client onboarding, contract compliance, and service delivery.
* Demonstrates high initiative, proactively solve operational and commercial challenges, and take complete ownership of your work and results.

Preferred

* An existing network among corporate travel, admin, and procurement decision-makers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
* Experience responding to government tenders or giga-project procurement processes.
* In compliance with local labor regulations and Saudization requirements, this role is reserved exclusively for Saudi Nationals.

  
**Benefits**

### **Why Join Jeeny?**

* Be part of one of the leading mobility platforms in the region.
* Work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
* Opportunity to lead impactful finance initiatives and process improvements.
* Career growth and professional development opportunities.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV, highlighting their B2B sales achievements, experience in the Qatar market, and relevant professional background

* Develop and execute an annual business plan in accordance with IHG market segmentation and reporting standards.
* Set and review sales revenue targets by market segment and develop strategies to achieve identified outcomes for short stay transient and extended stay business.
* Manage key corporate, extended stay, leisure and MICE clients.
* Maintain effective business relationships with key decision makers and influencers.
* Conduct regular sales team meetings to review month-to-date and year-to-date performance against forecast.
* Conduct regular revenue meetings to forecast demand and set appropriate rate strategies.
* Set and direct channel management strategies, both on line and via the GDS.
* Represent voco® Doha West Bay Suites in all sales activities including travel trade shows, site inspections, client sales calls, and product training.
* Implement strategies to create effective lead generation internally as well as externally.
* Identify opportunities to foster partnerships with complementary businesses that deliver mutual benefit.
* Maintain contacts with relevant industry associations deemed beneficial to voco® Doha West Bay Suites.
* Manage relationships with key business partners including GDS representation, General Sales Agents, third party websites, and travel management companies (TMC’s).
* Prepare and submit a monthly sales report on time that reflects consolidated information from sales team activities, market intelligence and any necessary adjustments to the business and marketing plans.

**MARKETING**

* Implement effective promotional activities that support business plan objectives using social, print, on line, consumer direct and B2B channels.
* Direct public relations strategies that deliver positive media coverage, generate editorial content, brand profiling, industry awards other associated activities beneficial to voco® Doha West Bay Suites.
* Position the property in all sales and marketing collateral, advertising, editorial content, sales contacts and direct marketing activities as a ‘Deluxe’ classification serviced residence (5 star hotel equivalent) in the GCC market, and ‘Gold Standard’ serviced apartment in accordance with IHG brand guidelines.
* Ensure all marketing communications, collateral production and branded promotional items comply with the IHG brand guidelines.
* Consult with and direct designers, printers, photographers, cinematographers and other external creative providers to develop marketing and collateral concepts that support the brand positioning in accordance with the business plan.
* Liaise with regional sales on all sales and marketing initiatives deemed beneficial to voco® Doha West Bay Suites
* Take a leadership role in developing customer service initiatives and recognition programs that strengthen client relationships.

**What we need from you**

**RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS**

* In consultation with the General Manager, prepare the annual business plan, revenue and financial budget.
* Ensure expenses for sales activities, promotions and functions are managed within budgeted guidelines and in accordance with stated policies and procedures.
* Actively manage and optimize revenues across all income streams of the property.
* Submit expense claims on a regular or monthly basis, or as soon as possible after returning from sales trips in the required format.
* Facilitate the smooth running of the department through adequate supply of materials and equipment.
* Observe and comply with the company’s requisition and purchase order system.

**PEOPLE**

* Engage with the sales team and all direct reports to assist them to align individual and department goals and targets with those of the hotel.
* Conduct ongoing performance appraisal reviews in line with company guidelines for all direct reports.
* Develop the sales team to become motivated by goal setting and achievement, and be results oriented.
* Ensure the completion of timesheets and requests for personal leave for all direct reports are managed in accordance with company policies and procedures.
* Identify appropriate training and development needs for the sales team.
* Demonstrate leadership by setting a positive and professional example.
* Be prepared to give and receive feedback on all matters pertaining to the performance and the conduct of the team, individuals and self.
* Manage the welfare of the sales team with a view to developing a positive and harmonious work place.
* Actively observe all workplace OHS requirements and report any issues to the relevant department manager without delay.

**GENERAL**

* Communicate effectively with all other operating departments of the property.
* Attend daily operations and sales briefings, weekly sales meetings, revenue/yield meetings, department head meetings, workplace safety meetings, monthly financial meetings and any other required meeting.
* Attend and deliver presentations to the owner, owner’s appointed representative and/or senior IHG executives as required.
* Actively contribute to and manage the Balanced Scorecard relative to the sales department function.
* Identify opportunities to innovate service delivery and product offerings to meet and exceed client expectations.
* Attend sales conferences and be available to travel on pre-arranged assignments.
* Develop a tactical marketing plan that successfully targets identified market segments.
* Set and review sales team performance. Ensure appropriate sales targets established with accountability for achieving all required activities to achieve goals.
* Effective implementation of the business plan. Review and update as and when required.
* Achieve budgeted revenue targets across all revenue streams eg: rooms, banquets and events.
* Manage and control department expenses in accordance with the budget guidelines.
* Achieve budgeted RevPAR.
* Achieve above fair market share within voco® Doha West Bay Suites identified competitor set. Aim for No. 1 rank.
* Effectively promote and position voco® Doha West Bay Suites to its target market.
* Establish team sales goal and ensure the sales team meets individual and collective KRA’s.
* Manage key corporate, leisure (wholesale, DMC) and MICE Clients.
* Innovate and identify opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
* Implement effective and accurate demand forecasting using BI tools to set appropriate rate strategies to optimize revenues.
* Co-ordinate close frequent and open communications between Regional Director of Sales & Marketing (Corporate Sales) and the property.
* Lead, manage and motivate an effective team of sales professionals to drive the department to achieve individual and collective goals.

**SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE**

* Prior experience in Qatar hotel/serviced residence market (Upper upscale segment) at Director of Sales and Marketing level. Minimum 3 years in role of DOSM in an internationally branded property with a track record of progression and achievement.
* Formal qualifications at tertiary level in sales and marketing or a related hospitality field
* Revenue focused. Emphasis on quality and high value outcomes. High achiever.
* Able to take appropriate action with minimal guidance
* Ability to conceptualize and execute strategies for self and team, clarify and assign tasks and seek commitment of others.
* Focus on achieving successful outcomes by engaging others in the process.
* High degree of proficiency in English language (written and spoken), able to deliver effective presentations to small-medium sized groups, principled negotiator, able to share ideas and enlist the support of others.
* Effective leadership and coaching skills, hands on, leads by example, supports others.
* Able to adapt to rapidly changing environment, responsive to the needs of the business and stakeholders
* Seeks to learn and adopt new technologies and techniques, open to suggestion, inquiring mind
* Inspired thinker with a keen understanding of design and lifestyle, travel and tourism, new media and with an eye to the future.
* Customer first outlook. Engaging and human. Genuine.
* Executive presence. Standard bearer. Ability to coach and enhance skillset of others.
