Title: Channel Sales Director - Canada
Description:
### **About Us**

At Versa Networks, we're revolutionizing the way businesses connect, secure, and optimize their networks. Our mission is to secure anywhere, anytime access to anything. As a leader in Secure SD-WAN, SSE (Secure Service Edge), SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and Next-generation Managed Services, we are empowering organizations across the globe to transform their IT infrastructure for the modern cloud era. Our innovative products enable enterprises to deliver a seamless, scalable, and secure digital experience, no matter where their users, devices, or applications are located. Founded by industry veterans and backed by premier venture capital firms, Versa is a market leader driving innovation and growth as it positions itself for a future IPO.

We believe in fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals dedicated to driving the future of networking technology. We encourage creativity, offer opportunities for growth, and provide a dynamic environment where our people can thrive and make an impact.

At Versa Networks, we don’t just build products – we build relationships, elevate businesses, and shape the digital future. Join us and be part of a fast-paced, cutting-edge company that's making a real difference in how the world connects and communicates.

### **Job Summary**

Versa Networks is seeking an accomplished, highly motivated Director of Channel Sales – Canada to drive the expansion of our Service Provider, Managed Service Provider (MSP), and Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) business across the Canadian market.

This is a strategic, revenue-generating role responsible for developing and expanding relationships with Canada's leading Tier 1 telecommunications providers, including Rogers Communications and Bell Canada, while identifying, recruiting, and enabling high-potential MSP and MSSP partners throughout the country.

The successful candidate will be responsible for building a scalable partner ecosystem, driving adoption of Versa's networking and cybersecurity solutions, and generating sustainable recurring revenue through partner-led go-to-market strategies.

This position requires an entrepreneurial, hands-on sales leader with strong executive relationship skills, deep knowledge of the Canadian telecommunications and managed services landscape, and a demonstrated track record of developing new business.

The role is remote and must be based in Eastern Canada, preferably within Ontario or Quebec, to facilitate engagement with strategic partners and their leadership teams

### **Responsibilities**

Strategic Service Provider Account Development

* Own and execute Versa's channel sales strategy for Canada's Tier 1 telecommunications and service provider market, with particular emphasis on Rogers Communications, Bell Canada, and other strategic providers.
* Establish and expand executive-level relationships across partner product management, managed services, cybersecurity, network engineering, sales, and business development organizations.
* Identify opportunities to integrate Versa's SD-WAN, SASE, SSE, and security technologies into partners' managed networking and cybersecurity portfolios.
* Develop joint business plans, technology roadmaps, and go-to-market strategies with strategic service provider partners.
* Navigate complex partner organizations, commercial negotiations, procurement processes, and long-term technology evaluations.
* Drive strategic agreements and commercial commitments that create sustainable recurring revenue for Versa.

MSP & MSSP Ecosystem Development

* Identify, recruit, and develop high-potential MSP and MSSP partners across Canada.
* Prioritize partners with established enterprise and midmarket customer bases and the ability to deliver managed networking and security services.
* Develop relationships with partner executive leadership, sales organizations, and technical decision-makers.
* Build and execute partner business plans with defined revenue targets, pipeline commitments, and joint sales activities.
* Drive partner onboarding, technical enablement, sales readiness, and go-to-market execution.
* Expand existing partner relationships through additional Versa solutions and new managed service offerings.
* Establish a scalable and productive partner ecosystem focused on measurable revenue contribution.

Revenue Generation & Pipeline Management

* Own and deliver assigned annual bookings and Annual Contract Value (ACV) targets for the Canadian Service Provider, MSP, and MSSP business.
* Proactively generate new business opportunities through strategic partner development and joint selling.
* Build, maintain, and accurately forecast a qualified pipeline of partner-led opportunities.
* Collaborate with partners to identify and pursue enterprise and midmarket customer opportunities.
* Drive opportunities through technical validation, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.
* Establish measurable quarterly business objectives and conduct regular partner business reviews.
* Maintain strong accountability for pipeline conversion, partner productivity, and recurring revenue growth.

Solution Positioning & Go-to-Market Execution Position Versa's integrated networking and cybersecurity portfolio, including:

* Networking Solutions
* + Secure SD-WAN and Advanced SD-WAN
  + Software-Defined LAN (SD-LAN)
  + Secure routing and network transformation
  + Branch and distributed enterprise connectivity
  + Network segmentation and infrastructure modernization
* Cybersecurity Solutions
* + Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
  + Security Service Edge (SSE)
  + Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
  + Secure Web Gateway (SWG)
  + Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
  + Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW)
  + DNS Security and Filtering
  + Advanced Threat Protection and Data Loss Prevention
* Translate these capabilities into compelling managed service offerings that help partners differentiate, increase recurring revenue, improve customer retention, and expand their addressable markets.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Versa's North American Service Provider leadership, solution engineering, product management, marketing, and customer success organizations.
* Coordinate executive engagement and strategic partner initiatives with Versa's senior leadership.
* Collaborate with internal teams to support partner technical evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and solution launches.
* Partner with channel marketing to develop joint campaigns, partner events, demand-generation initiatives, and sales enablement programs.
* Provide market intelligence and competitive insights to influence Versa's Canadian go-to-market strategy.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, channel sales, telecommunications, networking, or cybersecurity.
* Minimum 5 years of experience working with Service Providers, MSPs, MSSPs, or managed services organizations.
* Demonstrated success developing strategic partnerships and generating net-new revenue through indirect sales channels.
* Established relationships within the Canadian telecommunications, MSP, or MSSP ecosystem, preferably including Rogers, Bell Canada, or other major service providers.
* Strong understanding of SD-WAN, SASE, SSE, Zero Trust, and enterprise cybersecurity architectures.
* Proven experience developing partner business plans, building qualified pipelines, and exceeding sales quotas.
* Ability to engage credibly with senior executives, product leaders, technical stakeholders, and partner sales teams.
* Experience managing complex sales cycles, commercial negotiations, and strategic partner agreements.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate independently in a remote environment.
* Must reside in Eastern Canada and be willing to travel regularly throughout Canada and occasionally to the United States.
* Preferred Qualifications
* + Existing executive relationships within Rogers Communications, Bell Canada, or other major Canadian telecommunications providers.
  + Experience building or scaling an MSP/MSSP partner ecosystem in Canada.
  + Background selling networking and cybersecurity solutions through service providers.
  + Familiarity with competitive technologies from Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, HPE/Juniper, and other SASE or SD-WAN providers.
  + Experience launching managed networking or security offerings with telecommunications providers.
  + Bilingual proficiency in English and French is an asset, particularly for engagement with Quebec-based partners.

Location: Toronto, Canada

 **Benefits**  

### **Why Versa?**

At Versa Networks, we believe in taking care of our people – both professionally and personally. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being, growth, and work-life balance of our employees. When you join our team, you can expect:

* Competitive Salary & Incentives: We offer a competitive compensation package with and pre-IPO equity to reward your hard work and dedication.
* Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans to ensure you and your family stay healthy and covered.
* Paid Time Off (PTO): Enjoy a generous PTO policy that includes vacation days, sick leave, and paid holidays to recharge and take care of personal matters.
* Flexible Work Environment: We understand the importance of work-life balance. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work, and hybrid option to create the work schedule that works best for you.
* Professional Development: We believe in continuous learning. Access to training, certifications, and educational resources to help you grow in your career and stay ahead of industry trends.
* Employee Recognition: We celebrate achievements both big and small, with regular recognition programs and awards that highlight your contributions to our collective success.

* **Employee engagement and development**: staff retention and performance.

Title: Store Manager
Description:
**It’s your time, make it matter.**
===================================

At Cresco Equipment Rentals and Peterson, we partner with our customers to build the future. For over 90 years, our peoples’ work has shaped the communities where we live, where we raise our families, and where we thrive. Peterson’s legacy permeates every aspect of our communities. From roads and bridges, back-up power at hospitals, fire-fighting, concerts and moving goods; we are everywhere you look. At Cresco Equipment Rentals and Peterson, you don’t just have a career, you have a purpose.

Our family-oriented environment is built on safety, winning, growth, and professional achievement. **Hiring and developing exceptional people is critical to our continued success.** We have high standards for a good reason: our people represent Peterson, our family, our brand, and our values.

You have high expectations too. **You are exceptionally motivated, have outstanding skills, and want your work to matter.** Cresco Equipment Rentals and Peterson offers competitive wages, generous benefits, and promotional opportunities at a family-owned and operated business. It’s time to use your skills and passion to do work that matters! Cresco has 20 locations throughout Northern California, and serves large and small contractors along with do-it-yourselfers with the tools and equipment they need for both commercial and residential projects. We attribute our longevity and continued success to personalized customer service, honesty, integrity, hard work, social responsibility, cutting edge equipment solutions, and most importantly, our people.

**Job Description**

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign the functions to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. Job functions include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Manage, direct, and oversee store personnel and operations to ensure:
* Maximum service delivery, technical accuracy, employee engagement, and satisfaction of all internal and external customers.
* Initiatives and activities align with company goals, operational priorities, and manufacturer standards.
* Improvement opportunities are identified and acted upon.
* Adherence to company policies, legal and regulatory requirements, and ethical standards.
* A culture of collaboration and teamwork is maintained across departments and with all other internal and external stakeholders.
* Escalated issues are resolved decisively, promptly, and professionally.
* Manage and oversee the operating statements for the store.
* Work with marketing to develop a comprehensive territory marketing strategy to support the product line, attracting potential opportunities.
* Manage and control the store’s inventory to ensure financial and utilization metric benchmarks are achieved.
* Establish, enhance, and maintain superior customer service principles; follow up with customers to ensure their needs have been met; and intercede to solve problems and disputes.
* Maintain relationships with local 3rd party vendors to receive the value proposition that is best for Cresco.
* Oversee facility security. File police reports for missing/stolen inventory, as needed.
* Monitor and coordinate branch safety program. Assist in the coordination and actively participate in the store safety committee; ensure store personnel attendance at weekly/monthly safety meetings; participate in shop inspections and safety committee meetings as required; and ensure that certified first aid personnel are available and have updated certifications.
* Monitor and coordinate store facility, equipment, and crane maintenance and inspections; ensure inspections are up to date.
* Collaborate with Safety personnel to maintain and train employees on the store’s emergency action plan contents and procedures.
* Travel up to 20% of the time to visit customers, develop territory, and attend meetings, training, and other events. Operate company or personal vehicle as needed.
* Maintain punctual, regular, and predictable attendance.

**JOB SCOPE**

This position serves in the capacity of the Store Manager to provide direction and leadership to direct reports and fulfill company needs through this job function. General discretion and judgment are exercised routinely in the execution of job duties. If errors in judgment or professional execution of responsibilities are made, the consequences to the department can be severe.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of all employees at the store, which may include but is not limited to Mechanics, Drivers, Rental Coordinators, Dispatchers, Yard Attendants, and Assistant Store Managers. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and implementing corrective action with employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems. When work deficiencies are identified takes prompt and effective measures to correct areas needing improvement.

**INTERPERSONAL CONTACTS**

Internal contacts consist of all levels of positions in the company from senior executives to entry positions. The position regularly deals with sensitive, personal, and confidential information involving specific employee situations, requests, and investigations as well as strategic business plans involving operations, acquisitions, sales, and restructuring. Extreme sensitivity is required in dealing with such information and decisions concerning the release or sharing of that information. External contacts may consist of lawyers, government representatives, applicants, customers, vendors, and consultants. This position involves an extremely high level of personal contact with individuals frequently holding adversarial views and expecting that their demands or requests will be satisfied.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily, safely and in alignment with Peterson’s core values. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Strong understanding of the equipment rental industry required
* Strong organizational, communication, and multi-tasking skills required.
* Effective leadership and motivational skills required.

The pay range for this position is: $104,410 - $127,329 (Starting wage will depend on experience and education. We also offer a total compensation package in addition to base salary).

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

Cresco Rental is committed to equal employment opportunity and affirmative action. Minorities, females, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. A drug screen and background check is required.

***About Makers***

At Shop Makers, we’re redefining retail by offering a curated experience of the finest locally crafted, handmade goods. With 27 locations across BC, Alberta, Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Ontario, and plans to expand to 30+, we are proud to be Canada’s largest retailer of handmade products.

Our mission is simple yet bold: empower local artisans by giving them a platform to grow. We believe in nurturing community, sustainability, and creativity, and that starts with our people.

***Why This Role Matters***

As the Area Manager, you will oversee your home store as well as provide day-to-day escalation support for 2+ other stores within your district. Your role ensures that each store understands process and procedure, and coach on people leadership and performance management. The Area Manager adheres to company policies, ensuring a consistent and outstanding customer experience through regular store visits and store audits.

The Area Manager acts as a crucial link between the stores and Regional Managers; they will communicate new initiatives, provide feedback on what's working, operational pain points, and customer insights.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* *Multi-Store Performance & Accountability:*
* Oversee the day-to-day performance of 2-5 retail locations within a defined geographic area.
* Act as the in-between liaison for stores and Regional Managers; first point of escalation.
* Drive key business results, including sales performance, KPIs, labour budgets, and operational efficiency.
* Analyze store-level data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and translate insights into clear action plans.
* Partner with Store Managers to ensure company goals and initiatives are executed consistently at the store level.
* Maintain accountability for margin performance, inventory accuracy, and loss prevention.
* *Store Leadership & Talent Development:*
* Directly lead, coach, and support Store Managers, building strong leadership capability across the area.
* Provide regular performance coaching focused on people leadership, operational excellence, and results delivery.
* Support Regional Manager in Store Manager hiring, onboarding, and development.
* Identify and develop high-potential leaders and build succession plans for key roles.
* Address performance concerns proactively and fairly, partnering with People & Culture as needed.

* Ensure a consistent, high-quality customer experience across all locations.
* Uphold and reinforce brand standards related to visual merchandising, service, and store presentation.
* Act as the primary brand steward in the field, modelling company values and expectations.
* Conduct regular store visits, audits, and reviews to ensure compliance with company policies and operational standards.
* Support Store Managers in maintaining safe, welcoming, and compliant retail environments.
* *Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication:*
* Serve as the key connection between head office and retail teams, ensuring clear, timely, and effective communication.
* Cascade corporate initiatives, programs, and updates to stores in a way that drives understanding and adoption.
* Gather and share feedback from stores related to operations, customer needs, and team experience.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners including People & Culture, Retail Operations, Merchandising, and Marketing to support store success.
* *Growth, Change & Special Projects:*
* Support and lead aspects of new store openings, renovations, relocations, and closures within the area.
* Play an active role in rolling out new systems, tools, and operational processes.
* Ensure change initiatives are implemented smoothly and consistently across all stores.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and performance as the business grows.

***RETAIL SALES SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:***

* Proven experience in retail management (4+ years), preferably in a multi-unit or district management role.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and support a team.
* Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
* Ability to analyze and interpret sales data and other performance metrics.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to manage conflicts effectively.
* Proficient in using retail management software and tools.
* Easy access to transportation or transit required. Position requires travel at least 1x per month to assigned locations.

***SCHEDULE***

* This role requires frequent travel between store locations within the region.
* The Area Manager may be required to work outside of regular business hours to address urgent issues or during peak business periods.

**The Position:**  
Reporting to the VP, Finance and Manager, Finance, the Accounting Coordinator will provide day-to-day administrative support to the Operations of the Finance department.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  
Daily Operations
  

* You will process invoices and accounts payable by coding, inputting, and processing investment income tax credits, and uploading transactions to Oracle NetSuite ERP, the accounting software system.

Education and Experience.

Organization

* It is required that you have flexible availability to work mornings, days, afternoons, evenings, and even weekends, as required, and that you have access to reliable transportation.

Title: Storekeeper cum Buyer
Description:
**Job Summary**

The Store Keeper cum Buyer is responsible for managing the hotel's inventory, receiving, storing, issuing, and purchasing of goods and materials required for daily hotel operations. The position ensures that all items are procured at competitive prices, maintained at appropriate stock levels, and delivered in accordance with the hotel's quality standards and operational requirements.

The role involves coordinating with various departments, suppliers, and the Finance Department to ensure efficient stock control, timely procurement, cost management, and compliance with hotel purchasing procedures.

**Key Responsibilities1. Store & Inventory Management**

* Receive, inspect, and verify all incoming goods against purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices.
* Ensure all received items meet the hotel's quality and quantity requirements.
* Maintain proper storage, handling, and organization of goods in designated storage areas.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure adequate inventory is maintained.
* Issue goods to various hotel departments against approved requisitions.
* Conduct regular stock counts and participate in monthly inventory checks.
* Maintain accurate records of stock receipts, issues, transfers, and balances.
* Monitor expiry dates and ensure proper stock rotation using FIFO (First In, First Out).
* Report damaged, expired, or slow-moving items to the concerned department.

**2. Purchasing & Procurement**

* Source products and materials based on approved purchase requests from hotel departments.
* Obtain quotations from suppliers and compare prices, quality, and delivery terms.
* Prepare purchase orders in accordance with the hotel's procurement procedures.
* Follow up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of ordered goods.
* Negotiate with suppliers to obtain competitive prices and favorable payment terms.
* Maintain good professional relationships with suppliers and service providers.
* Ensure purchased items comply with the hotel's quality standards and specifications.
* Identify alternative suppliers and cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
* Coordinate with the Finance Department regarding invoices, quotations, and payment documentation.

**3. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, quotations, delivery notes, and invoices.
* Ensure all purchasing and inventory transactions are properly documented.
* Prepare monthly stock reports and inventory summaries.
* Monitor stock consumption and report unusual variations.
* Ensure proper filing and documentation for internal and external audits.
* Follow hotel purchasing policies, financial procedures, and internal control standards.

**4. Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate with all hotel departments to understand their purchasing and stock requirements.
* Communicate with suppliers regarding product availability, pricing, and delivery schedules.
* Work closely with the Finance, Cost Control, and operational teams.
* Respond promptly to urgent departmental requirements while following approval procedures.
* Maintain effective communication with the Director of Finance and Purchasing Manager.

**5. Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Maintain cleanliness, hygiene, and safety standards within all storage areas.
* Ensure proper storage of food, chemicals, equipment, and other materials.
* Follow hotel health and safety policies and applicable UAE regulations.
* Ensure restricted and hazardous materials are stored and handled appropriately.
* Maintain confidentiality of supplier pricing, contracts, and purchasing information.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Purchasing, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in storekeeping and purchasing, preferably within the hospitality industry.
* Previous experience in hotel stores, procurement, and inventory management is an advantage.
* Knowledge of inventory control, purchasing procedures, and supplier management.
* Familiarity with hotel operating systems and inventory software.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Good negotiation and supplier management skills.
* Strong organizational and inventory control abilities.
* Good numerical and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and email correspondence.
* Knowledge of FIFO and stock management procedures.
* Honest, reliable, and committed to maintaining company standards.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of stock records and inventory reports.
* Timely procurement and delivery of requested items.
* Effective inventory control and reduction of unnecessary stock.
* Cost savings through competitive supplier negotiations.
* Compliance with purchasing and inventory procedures.
* Minimization of stock shortages, wastage, and expired items.

**General Responsibilities**

* Perform any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or Management.
* Demonstrate the Accor values and uphold the Heartist culture.
* Maintain professional conduct and support teamwork across all hotel departments.
* Contribute to delivering operational excellence and guest satisfaction.

**Location:** Mercure Hotel Suites & Apartments, Barsha Heights, Dubai, UAE

**Reports To:** Assistant Purchasing Manage/Purchasing Manager

Pay: AED2,250.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Trans Cost & Productivity PM, ACES TREX
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Transportation Excellence (TREX) team in AMET (Middle East, Turkey and Africa) is looking for a Program Manager to drive cost and productivity improvements across our Last Mile delivery network. The team is the single owner of labor cost optimization and productivity across the region. We work with Operations, Finance, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Science teams to deliver great service at the lowest cost per shipment.  
  
You'll be based in Dubai and own a portfolio of cost and productivity programs in one or more AMET countries (UAE, KSA, Egypt and Türkiye). You'll find inefficiencies in route productivity, fleet utilization against paid hours, DSP capacity and channel mix. You'll measure the opportunity and lead launches from pilot to regional scale. You'll build and own weekly and monthly reporting and run deep dives on cost per shipment (CPS) and productivity drivers. You'll also present results in business reviews and help shape annual operating plans (OP1/OP2) with clear, data-backed targets.  
  
This role suits a builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and can move between detailed data analysis and leading teams that don't report to them. You'll be encouraged to use automation and AI tools to scale how we plan and optimize, and to raise the bar on how the network runs. Your work will directly affect the cost structure and customer experience of one of Amazon's fastest-growing regions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Own and deliver cost and productivity programs end to end: find the opportunity, build the business case, pilot, launch and sustain
* Track and report key metrics and explain what's driving changes
* Work with Operations, Finance, DSPs, Tech and Science teams to launch process and tool improvements
* Help set annual planning targets and track progress against plan
* Write clear narratives and status updates for senior leadership

  
About the team  
Transportation Excellence (TREX) is the central team that improves how Amazon's Last Mile network runs across the Middle East, Turkey and Africa (AMET). We work closely with the operations teams in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Türkiye. We own the programs that cut cost, raise productivity and improve the delivery experience across the region.  
  
Inside TREX, the Cost & Productivity team is the single owner of Last Mile labor cost and productivity for AMET. We look at the whole picture: route planning, fleet use, partner capacity and how the network is set up. We find where money is being lost and fix it in ways that last and work at scale. We work with Operations, Finance, Delivery Service Partners, Science and Tech teams. We also work side by side with the other TREX teams, such as Customer Experience & Escalations and Line Haul, so that savings never come at the cost of the customer.  
  
We're a small, senior team based in Dubai. We're hands-on, we rely on data, and we're always building. Everyone on the team owns their programs end to end, from the first analysis to launch across the region. You'll get exposure to senior leaders through our weekly and monthly business reviews. We're also early users of automation and AI tools in how we plan, report and make decisions. If you like hard problems, fast-growing markets and seeing your work directly change the business, you'll fit in well here.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
* Experience in lean or six sigma methodologies for operational, process, and performance improvement projects including process mapping and process re-design
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in Arabic

Title: AWS Commissioning, ACx Amazon Commissioning
Description:

---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. To meet the growing demand for AWS cloud computing capacity in EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer to join the team.
  
  
Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning?  
  
As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centres, Hybrid Colo's, Single Tennent Colo and Multi Tennent Colo builds . The AWS Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You will be responsible for supporting vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:  
  

* Medium and low voltage power systems
* Generators
* UPS
* HVAC
* Chilled Water Systems
* Building Management systems (BMS)
* Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
* Testing and balancing
* Pumps and Hydronic systems

  
The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning, the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects.
  
  
A day in the life  
The CxE's daily focus is to ensure the commissioning quality and progress meet AWS's high standards by:  
Developing commissioning standards.  
Reviewing, comment on, and creating commissioning scripts L1-L5.  
Organize and attend meetings highlighting AWS requirements and tracking overall build and commissioning progress and blockers.  
Performing site walks to identify installation and testing deficiencies and maintain observation logs.  
Manage on-site 3rd-party commissioning vendors to ensure coverage of all Cx-activities.  
Gather, organize, and review design and commissioning documentation.  
Work with AWS partner teams to resolve coordination and delivery issues and report on project health and completion.
  
  
About the team  
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCCD organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

------------------------

* 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
* 4+ years of commissioning experience
* Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
* Bachelor's degree or above in civil engineering, structural engineering, or architectural engineering from an ABET accredited program
* PE (Professional Engineer) or SE (Structural Engineer) Engineering license
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
* Knowledge of building codes, regulations, and standards including IBC (International Building Code) and ASCE (American Society of Civil Engineers)
* Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
* Experience in commissioning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
* Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance

Title: Assistant Golf Course Superintendent, Belfair
Description:
**Belfair**, located in **Bluffton, SC**, is pleased to announce an excellent career opportunity for a Full-Time **Assistant Golf Course Superintendent**! We are seeking a driven individual who is eager to learn, contribute, and grow within a fast-paced hospitality-focused property organization. As part of Troon, you will contribute to a global leader in golf and community management.

**Salary Range:** $70,000 to $75,000 per year (Depending on Experience)

**About Belfair**

Belfair is a premier private golf community located in Bluffton, South Carolina, featuring two Tom Fazio-designed championship golf courses, a state-of-the-art Learning Center, and a commitment to exceptional golf and hospitality. As a Troon-managed property, and recognized for its high standards and member experience, Belfair offers an opportunity to be part of a progressive golf operation in the Lowcountry, conveniently located near Hilton Head Island, Savannah, and Beaufort.

**Position Overview**

Belfair is seeking a motivated, forward-thinking Assistant Golf Course Superintendent who wants to grow as an agronomist, develop as a leader, and build a career in golf course management. This position works closely with the Golf Course Superintendent and Director of Agronomy to lead daily maintenance operations across Belfair’s golf courses.

We are committed to modern golf course management, using technology, data, and sound agronomic practices to make better decisions and continually improve playing conditions. The successful candidate will bring initiative, curiosity, strong communication skills, and a willingness to take ownership. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to expand their responsibilities and prepare for the next step toward becoming a Golf Course Superintendent.

**Innovation & Technology**

Belfair is committed to staying at the forefront of golf course management through innovation and the practical use of technology. Our team works closely with Greenkeeper and utilizes advanced tools, including GPS-guided spray application technology, to improve application accuracy, manage inputs responsibly, and support data-informed decisions. We expect our leaders to be comfortable with technology, open to new ideas, and interested in finding better ways to manage our courses and resources.

***Key Responsibilities***

**Golf Course Operations & Agronomy**

* Assist in planning, organizing, and executing daily golf course maintenance operations to deliver consistent, high-quality playing conditions.
* Monitor course conditions and turf health, identify emerging issues, and communicate recommended adjustments to maintenance practices.
* Help develop and implement agronomic programs for Bermudagrass, including fertility, irrigation and moisture management, pest management, seasonal transitions, cultivation, and topdressing.
* Assist with irrigation system operation, troubleshooting, scheduling, and water management.
* Apply fertilizers and pesticides in accordance with product labels, regulatory requirements, and department safety procedures; maintain accurate application records.
* Use GPS-guided application equipment, Greenkeeper tools, and other technology to improve efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making.
* Support equipment, materials, and resource planning to ensure work is completed safely and efficiently.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Help lead daily maintenance operations, including morning meetings, work assignments, scheduling, and follow-up.
* Train, coach, and develop team members while setting clear expectations for quality, productivity, safety, and accountability.
* Build a team environment centered on communication, initiative, collaboration, and pride in the work.
* Provide feedback and support employee development, helping identify and prepare future department leaders.
* Lead by example and maintain a professional, respectful, and solutions-oriented approach.

**Financial & Administrative Responsibilities**

* Assist with managing labor, materials, equipment, and other resources responsibly.
* Support chemical and fertilizer inventory management, purchasing, and accurate record keeping.
* Contribute to budget planning, operational reporting, and resource forecasting.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary spending, and limit waste.

**Safety & Environmental Stewardship**

Title: Principal (IT/Digital) | BCG Platinion
Description:
**Locations**
: Doha | Saudi Arabia
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
The Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
**About BCG Platinion**
BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale.
  
  
**Practice Area**
BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.
  
  
We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management & financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Principal IT/Digital in the Energy Practice, you will work closely with our client's leadership teams to understand their key challenges, define IT strategies, win buy-in for your recommendations and lead fellow BCG case team members to transform client potential into performance with high-impact assignments. You will deploy customized IT strategies, digital platforms and architecture in order to leverage the digital potential of our customers in order to deliver long lasting value. You will evaluate and coach our clients' technology teams, manage quality and risk while maintaining client expectations and escalations. Besides the functional guidance of the project team you will also be operationally responsible for the execution and management of the solution. Together with our clients you will develop convincing IT strategies, concepts and solutions that have a lasting impact on the organization, operating model, digital, and/or data landscape.
  
  
You will manage diverse teams of consulting talent. Your role will be to help those teams flourish by provoking thought, team mentoring, knowledge sharing, giving frequent feedback and creating opportunities for team members to learn and grow. You will also personally develop and grow by being exposed to new and complex challenges daily.
  
  
Clients will also seek your advice as a thought leader on business issues that extend beyond the immediate scope of you project work. Finally as a Principal you will contribute to the Practice Area development and help to strengthen the BCG Platinion brand as a AI and digital leader.
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Driving results in complex environments
* Solving business and technology problems
* Building strong client relationships
* Leading and developing teams
* Communicating complex topics clearly
* Collaborating across teams

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 8–12+ years in IT consulting or digital transformation
* Experience in Energy sector (e.g., Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals)
* Track record in IT transformation delivery
* Expertise in IT/ Digital architecture, cloud, data & AI topics
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management
* Excellent academic degree
* Excellent English communication skills, Arabic is a plus.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work in a collaborative environment with continuous development opportunities, growing toward Director-level roles while deepening expertise in Energy and IT/ digital transformation.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

Title: LABORATORY HSE OFFICER
Description:
**Job Summery**

  

The Laboratory HSE Officer is responsible for supporting and implementing Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) programs across laboratory and research facilities. The role ensures compliance with applicable HSE regulations, university policies, and international standards while promoting a proactive safety culture. The incumbent will oversee risk assessments, inspections, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, training programs, and regulatory compliance activities to ensure a safe environment for staff, students, researchers, contractors, and visitors.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**HSE Program Development and Compliance**

  

* Support the Research Safety Manager in developing, implementing, and maintaining laboratory HSE policies, procedures, and programs.
* Ensure laboratory operations comply with applicable local and international HSE regulations and standards.
* Monitor regulatory developments and update policies, procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as required.
* Collaborate with laboratory managers, facilities teams, HSE focal points, and other stakeholders to integrate HSE requirements into daily operations.
* Promote continuous improvement in laboratory health, safety, and environmental performance.
  

**Technical Support and Project Contribution**

  

* Conduct and oversee chemical, biological, radiological, and environmental safety assessments across laboratories and research facilities.
* Support the development and delivery of safety programs related to laboratory operations.
* Provide technical guidance on HSE matters to faculty, researchers, staff, and contractors.
* Assist in planning and allocating resources required for HSE initiatives and projects.
* Act as a technical resource for environmental, health, and safety management activities.
  

**Risk Assessment and Risk Management**

  

* Conduct workplace inspections and risk assessments to identify hazards and associated risks.
* Develop and implement appropriate risk control measures.
* Monitor the effectiveness of risk mitigation actions and recommend improvements where necessary.
* Maintain risk assessment records and ensure periodic reviews are completed.
* Support institutional risk management initiatives related to laboratory activities.
  

**Training and Awareness**

  

* Develop and deliver HSE induction programs, awareness campaigns, and specialized laboratory safety training.
* Ensure employees, students, researchers, and contractors understand HSE policies and emergency procedures.
* Maintain training records and monitor compliance with mandatory HSE training requirements.
* Promote a positive safety culture through regular communication and engagement activities.
  

**Incident Investigation and Reporting**

  

* Investigate incidents, accidents, near misses, hazardous occurrences, and environmental events.
* Collect evidence, interview relevant personnel, and determine root causes.
* Prepare detailed investigation reports with recommendations and corrective actions.
* Monitor implementation and effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident records and statistics.
  

**Inspections, Audits, and Compliance Monitoring**

  

* Conduct and coordinate routine laboratory inspections, safety audits, and fire risk assessments.
* Monitor compliance with legislation, university requirements, and management systems.
* Identify non-conformities and coordinate corrective actions with relevant departments.
* Support external audits, regulatory inspections, and compliance reviews.
* Prepare inspection reports and communicate findings to management.
  

**Emergency Preparedness and Response**

  

* Support the development, review, and testing of emergency response plans.
* Participate in emergency drills and evaluate emergency preparedness effectiveness.
* Serve as part of the HSE emergency and spill response team.
* Assist in responding to laboratory emergencies involving chemical, biological, or radiological hazards.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and recommend preventive measures.
  

**Operational Support**

  

* Monitor laboratory operations and recommend improvements to enhance safety and operational efficiency.
* Support implementation and maintenance of HSE Management Systems aligned with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards.
* Provide expert guidance on HSE risks, controls, and mitigation strategies for projects and operational activities.
* Assist the Research Safety Manager in monitoring HSE performance indicators and reporting requirements.
* Exercise authority to recommend suspension of activities that pose an immediate threat to health, safety, or the environment.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
  

**Documentation and Reporting**

  

* Maintain accurate HSE records, registers, permits, and documentation.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual HSE reports.
* Develop presentations and reports for management review meetings.
* Maintain records of inspections, audits, incidents, training activities, and corrective actions.
  

**Communication and Working Relationships**

  

**Research Safety Manager**

  

* Provide reports on safety compliance, risk assessments, incidents, inspections, and corrective actions.
* Present HSE performance metrics and recommendations for improvement.
* Support budget planning and resource allocation for HSE programs.
  

**UFSS Director**

  

* Collaborate on HSE strategy development and implementation.
* Provide guidance on risk management and regulatory compliance matters.
  

**HSE Team**

  

* Coordinate audits, inspections, investigations, and training activities.
* Share best practices and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  

**Employees, Researchers and Students**

  

* Deliver HSE training and awareness programs.
* Communicate safety requirements, alerts, and emergency procedures.
* Promote compliance and a strong safety culture.
  

**Facilities Management Personnel and Contractors**

  

* Coordinate safety requirements for maintenance and operational activities.
* Support compliance with HSE standards and corrective action implementation.
  

**Regulatory Authorities and External Stakeholders**

  

* Support regulatory inspections and compliance reviews.
* Coordinate responses to external audit findings and recommendations.
* Maintain effective relationships with external agencies and professional networks.
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

**Education**

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, Industrial Hygiene, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA, or equivalent are preferred.
  

**Experience**

  

* Minimum of **3 years of experience** in Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE), preferably within academic, laboratory, research, healthcare, or scientific environments.
* Experience in conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, audits, inspections, and compliance monitoring.
* Experience with chemical, biological, radiation, and environmental safety management is preferred.

Title: FACILITIES MAINTENANCE & CONTRACTOR SAFETY OFFICER
Description:
**Job Summery**

  

The Facilities Maintenance & Contractor Safety Officer is responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of facility maintenance activities while managing contractor safety performance across the organization. The role focuses on maintaining a safe work environment, ensuring compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements, and supporting the effective delivery of maintenance and facility management services.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Facilities Maintenance Management**

* Coordinate facility inspections, audits, and preventive maintenance activities.
* Ensure compliance with local building regulations, safety standards, and organizational requirements.
* Support the implementation of energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives within facility operations.
* Monitor facility conditions and recommend corrective or improvement actions.
  

**Contractor Safety Management**

* Develop, implement, and enforce contractor safety policies and procedures.
* Conduct contractor pre-qualification assessments to evaluate safety performance, certifications, and compliance records.
* Review and approve Permit-to-Work (PTW) documentation, risk assessments, and method statements before work commences.
* Ensure hazards are identified and appropriate control measures are implemented.
* Conduct contractor inductions, safety briefings, and toolbox talks.
* Monitor contractor activities to ensure compliance with safety standards and PPE requirements.
* Maintain accurate PTW records and suspend permits when safety conditions are not met.
  

**Safety Inspections & Compliance**

* Conduct regular workplace safety inspections and facility audits.
* Identify safety hazards and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses to determine root causes and preventive measures.
* Ensure compliance with fire safety requirements, emergency procedures, and hazardous material management.
* Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and related safety documentation.
* Liaise with regulatory authorities and external auditors during inspections and compliance reviews.
  

**Emergency Preparedness & Response**

* Ensure fire protection systems, emergency exits, alarms, and first-aid facilities are properly maintained.
* Develop and coordinate emergency response and evacuation plans.
* Organize and monitor fire drills and emergency exercises.
* Act as a key liaison between facility management, emergency responders, and regulatory authorities during emergencies.
  

**Audits and Inspections**

* Conduct routine HSE inspections, fire risk assessments, and compliance audits.
* Utilize inspection checklists and assessment tools to evaluate workplace safety.
* Document findings and communicate corrective actions to relevant stakeholders.
* Support external audits and regulatory inspections.
  

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain records related to maintenance activities, inspections, permits, audits, incidents, and risk assessments.
* Prepare periodic HSE and facility performance reports.
* Track contractor compliance metrics and monitor adherence to contractual HSE obligations.
* Maintain accurate records in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.
  

**Daily Operational Support**

* Support the Research Safety Manager in implementing HSE and facilities management strategies.
* Monitor compliance with HSE policies, procedures, and standards across operations.
* Ensure subcontractors and service providers comply with organizational HSE requirements.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  

**Operating Environment**

* Work is performed in both office and field environments.
* Travel to various facilities and regulatory agencies may be required.
* Availability to respond to emergencies outside normal working hours is essential.
* Exposure to varying environmental conditions, hazardous materials, chemicals, animals, toxic plants, and specialized equipment may occur.
* Use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required when necessary.
* Physical activities may include standing, walking, climbing, bending, and lifting.
* Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and in challenging environmental conditions.
  

**Communication & Working Relationships**

  

**Research Safety Manager**

* Provide regular updates on compliance performance, risk assessments, incidents, and corrective actions.
* Report daily operational activities and seek guidance when required.
* Present audit findings and improvement recommendations.
  

**HSE Team**

* Collaborate on risk assessments, audits, inspections, and training activities.
* Share best practices and regulatory updates.
* Support emergency response planning and drills.
  

**Facilities Management Personnel & Contractors**

* Coordinate maintenance activities and safety requirements.
* Ensure safe execution of work and compliance with operational procedures.
* Address facility-related hazards and environmental concerns.
  

**Regulatory Authorities & External Stakeholders**

* Submit compliance reports and required documentation.
* Facilitate inspections conducted by regulatory bodies.
* Implement recommendations arising from external audits and reviews.
* Participate in professional forums and industry networks to maintain awareness of best practices.
  

**Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Experience**

  

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Facilities Management, Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
  

**Professional Certifications (Preferred)**

* NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC)
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
* Certified Facilities Manager (CFM)
* Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)
* Construction Health & Safety Technician (CHST)
* Project Management Professional (PMP)
  

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in Facilities Management, Occupational Health & Safety, or Environmental Health & Safety.
* Experience conducting risk assessments, incident investigations, compliance audits, and safety inspections.
* Experience managing contractors and Permit-to-Work systems.
  

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of HSE regulations, facility management principles, and safety management systems.
* Understanding of environmental and occupational safety standards, including OSHA, NFPA, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and relevant Qatar regulations.
* Knowledge of emergency preparedness and incident management.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Power BI, and HSE management software.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management systems.

Title: Telecom OSS Architect / Designer
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
As a
**Telecom OSS Architect / Designer**
, you will be a senior technical authority within our Connectivity & Network Engineering practice, leading the architecture and design of complex OSS solutions for major telecoms clients in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical delivery, working closely with client stakeholders, engineering teams, and vendor partners to define and implement best-in-class OSS ecosystems.
  
  
In this role you will play a key role in:
  
  

* Leading end-to-end OSS architecture and design across Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management domains — defining solution blueprints, integration frameworks, and technical roadmaps aligned to client business objectives and industry best practices such as TM Forum frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID).
* Driving the design and implementation of Network Inventory solutions, including physical, logical, and service inventory modelling, ensuring accurate and real-time representation of network assets across multi-vendor, multi-technology environments (2G/3G/4G/5G, Fixed, IP/MPLS).
* Architecting Performance and Fault Management solutions, overseeing the design of KPI frameworks, threshold management, alarm correlation, and root cause analysis capabilities — enabling proactive network operations and minimising service impact for telecoms operators.
* Engaging directly with senior client stakeholders to gather and translate complex business and operational requirements into detailed technical specifications, solution architectures, and HLD/LLD documentation, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Leading and governing OSS integration design, defining interfaces and APIs between OSS platforms and adjacent systems including BSS, NMS, EMS, and emerging cloud-native network management platforms — ensuring seamless data flows and operational continuity across the network operations ecosystem.
* Providing technical leadership and mentoring to a team of OSS engineers and designers, conducting design reviews, driving quality assurance of technical deliverables, and ensuring architectural consistency and compliance with agreed standards across project workstreams.
* Supporting pre-sales and solutioning activities, contributing to RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, and solution demonstrations — bringing deep domain expertise to help shape and win new opportunities across the KSA and wider Middle East telecoms market.

Your Profile
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced and driven Telecom OSS Architect who combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capability and a collaborative approach.
  
  
Technical Skills & Experience:
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in the telecommunications industry, with a strong focus on OSS architecture, design, and delivery — including proven expertise in at least two of the following domains: Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management systems, ideally in large-scale, multi-vendor operator environments.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of OSS platforms and tools, such as IBM Tivoli Netcool, Nokia NetAct, Ericsson ENM/ENIQ, Huawei iMAC/U2000, Comarch OSS, or similar — combined with strong understanding of OSS/BSS integration patterns, mediation layers, and data modelling techniques for telecoms network domains.
* Strong grounding in TM Forum standards and frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID/ODA) and familiarity with relevant industry standards including 3GPP, ETSI, IETF, and TMN — with the ability to apply these frameworks pragmatically in real-world solution design and architecture.
* Solid experience with integration technologies and APIs including REST/SOAP web services, TMF Open APIs, OSS/J, XML/JSON data formats, and middleware platforms — with the ability to architect robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions between OSS components and broader network management ecosystems.
* Proficiency in producing high-quality architecture and design artefacts, including Solution Architecture Documents, HLDs, LLDs, interface control documents, data flow diagrams, and operational runbooks — with experience presenting these at both technical and executive levels.

**What You'll Love About Working Here**
**Dedicated Innovation Labs**
– We help the world's largest innovators engineer the products and services of tomorrow by leveraging our experts and labs, dedicated to topics such as 5G, 6G, AI, Autonomous Vehicles and Quantum. As a Telecom OSS Architect at Capgemini Engineering, you will be at the heart of this innovation — shaping the next generation of network operations for some of the world's leading operators.
  
  
**Career Acceleration Programs**
– From associate to leaders and beyond, get support in your career at every stage with award-winning programs such as our leadership development program, Connected Manager, to accelerate your growth and develop your expertise. With 12+ years of experience, you'll have access to programmes designed specifically to take senior engineers to the next level.

We help our clients unleash their R&D potential to develop the smart products and services of tomorrow — and you will play a central role in that mission in the KSA market.

Title: Contracts Coordinator
Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented **Contracts Specialist / Coordinator** to support contract administration activities on large-scale data center, mission-critical, and infrastructure projects in KSA. The role will maintain contract records and registers, track obligations, notices, variations, claims, key dates, and payment-related documentation while coordinating closely with project, commercial, procurement, design, construction, planning, commissioning, and document control teams.

The successful candidate will work within Decima's PMC team, supporting the day-to-day contractual administration of projects and helping ensure contractual requirements, deadlines, and records are accurately maintained and followed through.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

* Support contract administration activities for consultant, contractor, subcontractor, and vendor agreements.
* Maintain accurate records of contracts, amendments, purchase orders, warranties, bonds, insurance certificates, and related contractual documentation.
* Maintain trackers for notices, variations, claims, change orders, approvals, contractual obligations, and outstanding actions.
* Review incoming correspondence and identify items requiring contractual or commercial follow-up.
* Assist in preparing contractual letters, notices, meeting minutes, and supporting documentation.
* Track contract deliverables, milestones, key dates, notice periods, expiry dates, and contractual deadlines.
* Monitor RFI and technical submittal turnaround against contractual timeframes.
* Support variation order and change request administration.
* Collect and organize supporting documentation for claims, extensions of time, and commercial assessments.
* Maintain contractual obligations registers throughout the project lifecycle and flag non-compliance to the Senior Contract Administrator or Contracts Manager.
* Maintain records of instructions, RFIs, design changes, delays, and site events with potential contractual impact.
* Support contractor payment application verification against payment schedules, bills of quantities, and approved progress in coordination with relevant project teams.
* Coordinate with project management, cost control, procurement, design, construction, planning, commissioning, and document control functions.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action trackers, and follow-up logs.
* Support long-lead equipment and delivery tracking, including OFCI and CFCI arrangements.
* Prepare regular contract status reports covering notices, variations, claims, approvals, contractual risks, and outstanding actions.
* Support final account preparation, contract close-out, warranties, retention reconciliation, and handover documentation.
* Maintain warranty and defects registers during the applicable defects liability period.
* Support the management of outstanding claims and contractual matters through project close-out.
* Ensure sensitive contractual and commercial information is handled confidentially.

* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to draft clear and factual contractual correspondence.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency in Word and PowerPoint.
* Willingness to work full-time onsite at project locations within KSA.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on data center, mission-critical, industrial, or major infrastructure projects.
* Experience within a PMC, consultant, or Owner's Representative environment.
* Prior experience administering EPC lump-sum contracts.
* Strong working knowledge of a specific FIDIC contract edition.
* Experience supporting construction claims, variations, and extension-of-time assessments.
* Experience with final accounts, retention reconciliation, and contract close-out.
* Commercial or quantity surveying support experience.
* Exposure to long-lead equipment procurement and delivery tracking.
* Experience with OFCI / CFCI arrangements.
* Previous project experience in KSA.
* Experience supporting PIF-affiliated, government-linked, or hyperscale clients.

Title: SRO, Customer Excellence.
Description:
We are looking for a Senior Responsible Owner (SRO) for Customer Excellence to lead Echelon’s Customer Excellence Program and own the customer 360, our single view of each customer. You will set how AI agents and account teams work together, so that everyone who serves a customer works from the same, accurate picture.
  
  
****The role: one view of the customer****
Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you own the customer 360 across our accounts. You work with the CRO’s account teams, the Head of AI Transformation and the deployment strategists, the engineers in the pods, and the leadership team. You bring partner insight into each customer’s view and work closely with the marketing and communications lead on customer engagements.
  
  
****What you’ll do****

* Build the customer 360. One record and one account plan per customer, kept current by AI agents and approved by the account owner: organization and decision makers, systems and data landscape, AI maturity, contracts, projects, pipeline, delivery history and value delivered.
* Own customer data. The quality of customer data in our CRM and delivery tools: what is captured, by whom and when, who can edit it, and how the account teams and pods use it.
* Read the customer. Each customer’s strategy, budgets, AI priorities, leadership changes and buying cycles, briefed to the account teams and strategists before key meetings.
* Measure customer health. Satisfaction and health measures across accounts, feedback after each engagement, and early warnings on accounts at risk.
* Run the cadence. The weekly presence on accounts: account reviews, executive touchpoints, customer events and programs, and their follow-up.
* Inform leadership. A regular customer review for the COO and the leadership team: where we win, where we lose, and what customers ask for that we do not yet deliver.

****What you bring****

* Customer record: 6+ years in customer success, account operations, CRM or customer analytics in a technology or services business.
* Data fluency: At ease with CRM systems, dashboards and imperfect data, and able to make them useful to others.
* Rigour: You keep records accurate and current without being asked, and build simple processes that last.
* Connector: You work across sales, delivery and leadership, and earn trust by being useful.
* AI fluency: You find use cases for AI and turn them into agentic workflows that serve the Customer Excellence Program end to end, and you decide where a person must review their work.

****Strong advantage****

* Sector knowledge: Experience with customers in a sector where Echelon leads, such as government, energy, financial services or healthcare.
* CRM platforms: Hands-on administration of a major CRM platform.
* Arabic: Professional fluency in Arabic.

****Our values****

* Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritize accordingly.
* Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.
* Builds others: You measure yourself by the people you develop and the capability you build with customers.

****How we work****
You start from the customer’s problem and choose the tool to fit it. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.
  
  

* Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves.
