Title: Senior AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic AI
Description:
**Senior AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic AI**

**Company:** Ekshvaku Tech Innovations LLC  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Office-Based  
**Experience:** 5–9 Years (Including 2+ Years of Hands-On Generative AI/LLM Development)

**About ETI**

Ekshvaku Tech Innovations (ETI) is a technology solutions and consulting company operating across the UAE and India, specializing in Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, healthcare technology, insurance technology, and digital transformation.

We develop intelligent, scalable, and production-ready technology solutions for businesses across multiple industries, with a growing focus on healthcare AI, enterprise automation, and Agentic AI.

We are expanding our AI engineering capabilities and seeking a highly skilled Senior AI/ML Engineer who can independently design, develop, and deploy sophisticated AI-powered applications.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on, technically strong Senior AI/ML Engineer with demonstrated experience building production-grade Generative AI, Large Language Model (LLM), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong software engineering fundamentals, applied machine learning expertise, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into reliable AI systems.

This is not a research-only or prompt-engineering position.

**We are looking for an engineer who can take complete technical ownership of AI solutions, from architecture and development to deployment, optimization, monitoring, and continuous improvement.**

The selected candidate will work closely with our technical leadership and engineering teams on AI initiatives across healthcare, insurance, and enterprise technology.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Generative AI & LLM Development**

* Design, develop, and deploy applications powered by Large Language Models.
* Build solutions using commercial and open-source models, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and similar technologies.
* Implement advanced prompting strategies, structured outputs, function calling, and tool integration.
* Develop and optimize LLM-powered APIs and backend services.
* Evaluate model performance, accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.

**2. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Design and implement AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, tool usage, and executing multi-step workflows.
* Build multi-agent systems with appropriate orchestration, state management, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Work with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent technologies.
* Develop intelligent workflow automation integrating AI models with enterprise systems and APIs.
* Implement appropriate safeguards for autonomous and semi-autonomous AI workflows.

**3. RAG & Knowledge Systems**

* Architect and develop production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions.
* Implement document ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embedding generation, and vector indexing.
* Work with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, FAISS, or pgvector.
* Implement semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and context optimization.
* Develop evaluation frameworks for retrieval relevance, groundedness, and response quality.
* Improve the accuracy and reliability of AI responses while minimizing hallucinations.

**4. Applied Machine Learning**

* Develop and integrate machine learning and NLP models for classification, information extraction, summarization, prediction, and decision support.
* Work with Python-based ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and Hugging Face.
* Perform model evaluation, fine-tuning, optimization, and experimentation where appropriate.
* Apply sound statistical and machine learning principles to real-world business problems.

**5. Healthcare AI & Domain Applications**

* Contribute to the development of AI-powered clinical workflows, healthcare automation, and intelligent decision-support applications.
* Build systems capable of processing clinical documents, structured records, and medical terminology.
* Work with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR, where applicable.
* Implement clinical accuracy evaluation, evidence-grounded responses, safety guardrails, and auditability.
* Ensure secure handling of sensitive healthcare information and support HIPAA-aligned technical controls.
* Collaborate with domain specialists to improve clinical relevance and workflow reliability.

**6. Backend Engineering & System Integration**

* Develop scalable Python-based backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI.
* Design and integrate REST APIs, asynchronous workflows, databases, and external services.
* Build reliable integrations between AI systems and existing enterprise applications.
* Apply software engineering best practices, including modular architecture, testing, documentation, and code reviews.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across AI models, application services, and infrastructure.

**7. Cloud Deployment, MLOps & LLMOps**

* Deploy AI applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Work with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployment architectures.
* Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and performance optimization.
* Develop automated testing and evaluation pipelines for AI applications.
* Optimize infrastructure costs, model inference latency, and overall system reliability.

**8. Technical Ownership & Collaboration**

* Independently lead technical implementation of assigned AI initiatives.
* Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making.
* Collaborate with frontend developers, backend engineers, QA teams, DevOps engineers, and project managers.
* Review code, mentor junior engineers, and establish engineering best practices.
* Maintain technical documentation and ensure knowledge sharing across the AI engineering team.
* Engage in technical discussions and demonstrations with customers when required.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Programming & Backend**

* Advanced Python programming.
* FastAPI or equivalent backend frameworks.
* REST API development and asynchronous programming.
* SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Strong understanding of software architecture and engineering fundamentals.

**Generative AI & LLMs**

* Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs and open-source models.
* Prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, and model evaluation.
* Experience implementing production LLM applications.

**RAG & Search**

* Embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval pipelines.
* Document processing, hybrid search, reranking, and grounded response generation.
* Experience evaluating retrieval quality and reducing hallucinations.

**Agentic AI**

* Practical experience with agent frameworks or custom agent orchestration.
* Tool calling, workflow state management, multi-step execution, and human oversight.

**Machine Learning**

* Strong understanding of ML fundamentals and NLP.
* Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or Hugging Face.

**Cloud & Deployment**

* Experience with at least one major cloud platform.
* Docker, CI/CD, production deployment, logging, and monitoring.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 5–9 years of relevant software engineering and AI/ML experience.
* At least 2 years of hands-on experience delivering Generative AI or LLM-based applications.
* Experience building and maintaining production AI solutions used by real customers.
* Experience in healthcare AI, clinical NLP, healthcare interoperability, or medical software applications.
* Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, RxNorm, or similar healthcare standards.
* Experience implementing AI safety, evaluation pipelines, audit logging, and enterprise security controls.
* Exposure to multi-agent architectures, model fine-tuning, or advanced retrieval techniques.
* Experience with enterprise customers and distributed engineering teams.

**What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

* **Strong Hands-On Engineering:** Able to build working AI systems rather than simply explain AI concepts.
* **Technical Independence:** Capable of owning complex solutions with minimal supervision.
* **Production Experience:** Understands how to make AI applications reliable, scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* **Problem-Solving Ability:** Can investigate and resolve complex model, retrieval, integration, and application issues.
* **Architectural Thinking:** Makes sound technical decisions based on business needs and engineering trade-offs.
* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of delivery commitments and technical outcomes.
* **Collaboration:** Works effectively with engineering teams, stakeholders, and customers.
* **Continuous Learning:** Keeps pace with advances in AI while applying technologies pragmatically.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on advanced Generative AI, Agentic AI, and enterprise automation projects.
* Exposure to complex healthcare and enterprise AI use cases.
* Direct collaboration with experienced technology leadership.
* Opportunity to take technical ownership of meaningful AI initiatives.
* Career growth opportunities as ETI expands its AI engineering practice.
* Collaborative working environment focused on engineering quality, innovation, and measurable outcomes.

**Selection Process**

Shortlisted candidates should be prepared for:

* Technical discussion covering AI/ML fundamentals, LLM architectures, RAG, and Agentic AI.
* Hands-on coding and system design assessment.
* Discussion of production AI applications personally developed and deployed.
* Technical architecture and problem-solving interview with engineering leadership.

**Apply Now**

Please submit your CV highlighting your Generative AI, Agentic AI, and production deployment experience.

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 5–9 years of relevant software engineering and AI/ML experience?
* Do you have at least 2 years of hands-on experience developing Generative AI or LLM-based applications?
* Have you developed and deployed production-grade RAG applications using vector databases and retrieval pipelines?
* Do you have practical experience building Agentic AI or multi-agent systems using LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks?
* Are you currently based in Dubai or willing to relocate, and available for full-time, office-based work in Dubai?

The FPGA Designer plays a key role in designing and delivering complex FPGA-based systems for Fidus clients. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus teams to define architectures, implement RTL, integrate IP, run simulations, close timing, and support lab bring-up and debug.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with new FPGA families and tools, is comfortable moving between different application domains (video, communications, storage, signal processing), and takes pride in producing high-quality, well-documented designs.

**Make an Impact with US:**

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Work with our clients and other Fidus Employees to develop complex FPGA and/or CPLD based systems, including architecture, custom development, integrated IP, simulations, and timing analysis and closure.
* Design FPGA based systems using Xilinx and Intel based devices and tools
* Participate in design reviews (hardware-software interface, input-outputs etc.) to ensure Fidus quality standards and customer requirements are being adhered to
* Perform lab testing, debug of prototypes and supporting hardware/software engineer, as needed
* Perform customer prototype demonstrations and author test plans, design description and user documentation
* Provide technical insight to customers during the pre-sales and implementation phase of projects
* Provide technical support to the Business Manager and Sales team by providing detailed estimates on project scope, schedule, and deliverables and to present the technical aspects of Fidus proposals to the client

**Who You are:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience designing using RTL/Verilog/VHDL on FPGAs.
* Experience with video systems and specification standards, video algorithms, and high-speed memory and bus interfaces, communications protocols, and DSP or processor instantiations.
* Created designs using Xilinx or Altera FPGA families and have a solid understanding of tool flow
* Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus, and/or ModelSim
* RTL design and verification including test benches, functional simulations, and timing closure
* Exhibit strong communication skills, are fluent in English, have great customer interaction presence, and quickly learn new technologies and processes
* Proven techniques and habits that lead to high quality design
* Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit
* Degree as a B.A.Sc., B.Eng. or equivalent
* As AMD Embedded Premier Partner, you will be certified to highest level of FPGA qualification – this will be your first “to-do” item upon joining us.

**Location and travel:** Position is based in Canada. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.

This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates will be required to complete background checks and security screening under Canada's Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and may also be required to obtain a security clearance under the Contract Security Program (CSP) administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC, formerly PWGSC).

This role is an evergreen position.

Annual base salary ranges from $125,000 to $160,000. The final offer within this range takes into account the variations in knowledge, skills, experience, and market conditions, and with consideration to internal equity.

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching GRSP contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

**About Fidus & Why Work Here**

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

Title: Field CISO
Description:
**Onwards Together!**
---------------------

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

**Our Team's Vision:**
----------------------

Illumio is the breach containment company. Built on Zero Trust principles, the Illumio platform combines real-time visibility with segmentation and AI-powered detection and response, helping organizations stop the spread of breaches and ransomware across hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments before they become disasters. Illumio Segmentation contains attackers by stopping lateral movement across the enterprise, and Illumio Insights delivers AI-driven visibility and detection across hybrid cloud environments.

Illumio was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Microsegmentation Solutions, Q3 2026, earning the highest scores in current offering and strategy of any vendor evaluated, and is recognized as a Customers’ Choice in Gartner Peer Insights for Network Security – Microsegmentation. Global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, energy and utilities, government, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications trust Illumio to reduce cyber risk and build resilience.

**Our Values**
==============

Our values reflect how we work together in practice — not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you’ll likely feel at home here.

* **Bring Your Best:** We hold ourselves to a standard of excellence for our customers and each other, regardless of circumstance.
* **Build Trust:** We act with integrity, transparency, and follow-through, earning trust in every interaction.
* **Seek Truth:** We pursue facts over assumptions, stay curious, and remain open to being wrong.
* **Onwards Together:** We move forward as one team, supporting each other through challenges and wins alike.
* **Leverage Differences:** We treat diverse perspectives and backgrounds as a source of strength and better decisions.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Field CISO, Zero Trust Segmentation is a newly created, specialized role within the Global Solutions Engineering team, chartered to deepen Illumio’s credibility and category leadership within the CISO community. This role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community: we are looking for a security executive — a current or former CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security leader — who brings a proven balance of business acumen, technical depth, and operational experience running a security program, rather than a traditional pre-sales background. This is a hybrid role by design: half executive advisor and evangelist, half hands-on architect.

As Field CISO, this person is Illumio’s most credible external voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment — engaging CISOs and CTOs at strategic accounts as a peer, shaping the category narrative with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms), and representing the company at industry events. This person also personally owns the technical backbone of pre-sales for the category: the Use Case Map, demo environments, POC/POV frameworks, and reference architectures that the rest of the global SE team (AMS, EMEA, APAC) builds on.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategic Field Leadership & Evangelism**

* Serve as Illumio’s foremost executive voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment, in the field and in public — conferences, webinars, analyst briefings, and published content.
* Build and maintain analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms) to shape how the category is defined and evaluated in the market.
* Engage CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders directly on the most strategic opportunities, drawing on firsthand operating experience to act as a peer and trusted advisor alongside regional SE leads and AEs.
* Partner with Sales and GTM leadership to shape go-to-market and revenue acceleration strategy.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Product Management to shape positioning, messaging, and roadmap priorities, informed directly by field and firsthand operator signal.

**Technical Architecture & Enablement Ownership**

* Own and continuously evolve the Use Case Map, Demo Runbook, and reference architectures used across the global SE organization.
* Personally design and build flagship demo environments and POC/POV frameworks, including integration patterns and success-criteria templates.
* Partner directly with product engineering to translate roadmap into sellable, demoable capability, and drive pre-sales enablement to sell-ready status and beyond.
* Maintain deep, current hands-on fluency with the Illumio platform — including segmentation, hybrid cloud detection and response, and broader Zero Trust architecture concepts.

**Enterprise Pre-Sales & POC Execution**

* Lead or co-lead the most strategic and complex opportunities globally, engaging directly alongside AMS, EMEA, and APAC SE teams.
* Architect and execute high-stakes POCs/POVs, including technical prerequisites, integration scoping, success-criteria definition, and executive readout.
* Act as the final technical and executive escalation point for deals across regions, ensuring a consistent, credible narrative in front of customers.

**Team Enablement & Capability Building**

* Design and deliver training curriculum and certification paths for the global SE team.
* Build battlecards, FAQs, and RFP response libraries, keeping the team current against an evolving competitive landscape.
* Mentor SE Leads and SEs on segmentation and breach containment concepts, positioning, and objection handling — bringing an operator’s perspective on how real security teams evaluate and adopt these solutions.

**Product & Market Feedback Loop**

* Serve as a structured, credible voice of the field back to Product Management on roadmap priorities, feature gaps, and competitive intelligence.
* Track and analyze the competitive landscape across microsegmentation, Zero Trust, and cloud detection and response, including new entrants and adjacent incumbents extending into the space.

**Required Qualifications**

* Prior experience as a CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security executive (VP/Director of Information Security) is required — this role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community to bring firsthand business, technical, and operational credibility to the field.
* 10+ years of experience leading enterprise security programs, with direct, hands-on exposure to network segmentation, Zero Trust architecture, incident response and breach containment, or cloud security.
* Demonstrated ability to speak credibly to both engineering and executive/board audiences translating technical risk into business terms and back again.
* Demonstrated track record as an external-facing voice: conference speaking, analyst engagement, published thought leadership, or peer-community leadership (e.g., CISO forums, ISACs).
* Proven hands-on architecture and build capability — this is not a strategy-only role; the person must be able to personally build and demo complex technical environments.
* Demonstrated experience engaging CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders, ideally as a former peer, on strategic, multi-stakeholder decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to move fluidly between deep technical detail and executive narrative.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.
* Willingness and ability to travel 30–50% for customer, analyst, and industry engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior title of CISO, Deputy CISO, Field CISO, or VP/Director of Information Security at an enterprise or mid-market organization.
* Direct operational experience running a segmentation, Zero Trust, or breach containment program.
* Experience with microsegmentation, CNAPP, cloud security posture management, or hybrid cloud detection and response tooling.
* Existing relationships with analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, and others) covering network security, Zero Trust, or security operations.
* Experience integrating or building go-to-market plans around a new or acquired product line.
* Published thought leadership — blogs, whitepapers, podcasts, or conference talks — on breach containment, Zero Trust, or cyber resilience.
* Familiarity with the broader Illumio platform: Illumio Segmentation, Illumio Insights, container/Kubernetes segmentation, OT/ICS environments, and hybrid cloud architectures.

**Our Commitment**

Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.*

Title: Document Controller
Description:
Overview:

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end-to-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.

As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.

We invite you to join us. Why?

When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being through on-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.

  
Responsibilities:

KEO Group is seeking a talented and detail-oriented **Document Controller** to join our **Design team in Saudi Arabia**.

The successful candidate will support the effective management, control and distribution of project and design documentation across multidisciplinary teams. The role requires a highly organised individual who can maintain accurate document registers, coordinate design submissions and ensure that the latest approved information is readily available to project stakeholders.

We envisage success in this role to include:

* Managing and maintaining project documentation in accordance with established document control procedures and project requirements.
* Controlling the receipt, registration, distribution and filing of multidisciplinary design documents, drawings, specifications, reports and correspondence.
* Maintaining accurate **drawing registers, document registers, transmittals and submission trackers**.
* Ensuring appropriate **revision and version control** so project teams are working from the latest approved documentation.
* Coordinating document workflows between **Architecture, Structural, MEP and other design disciplines**, as well as Project and Design Managers.
* Preparing, issuing and tracking document **transmittals and design submissions** to clients, consultants and other relevant stakeholders.
* Monitoring outstanding reviews, approvals and document status and following up with the relevant design teams to support required submission deadlines.
* Performing quality checks on documents before formal issue, including document numbers, revision status, naming conventions, formatting and required approvals.
* Uploading, distributing and maintaining documentation through the applicable **Electronic Document Management System (EDMS)** or Common Data Environment.
* Supporting the Design team with retrieving drawings, reports and correspondence efficiently when required.
* Maintaining structured electronic filing and archiving systems to ensure documents remain secure, traceable and easily retrievable.
* Ensuring superseded documentation is clearly identified and appropriately archived to prevent unintended use.
* Supporting internal reviews and audits by ensuring document-control records are complete, accurate and readily available.
* Liaising with internal teams and external stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and document-control issues.
* Maintaining confidentiality and appropriate access controls for sensitive project information.
* Supporting continuous improvement of document-control processes and workflows.

KEO experience demonstrates the value of DC professionals being comfortable with EDMS platforms such as **Aconex, Autodesk BIM 360, Oracle Unifier and PMWeb**, depending on the project's system

Qualifications:

To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include;

* A Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Engineering Administration, Document Control or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 5 years of relevant Document Control experience, preferably within an architectural, engineering or multidisciplinary design consultancy.
* Demonstrable experience supporting design teams and design deliverables within the architecture, engineering or construction industry.
* Strong understanding of document numbering, revision control, transmittals, document registers, workflows and archiving.
* Experience working with an EDMS/CDE, preferably platforms such as Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360, SharePoint, PMWeb or similar.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
* Experience controlling drawings and deliverables across multiple design disciplines.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain a high level of accuracy while managing a significant volume of documentation.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with Design Managers, architects, engineers, BIM teams and other project stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team environment.

The emphasis on strong English communication, attention to detail, workload management, adaptability and initiative is also consistent with KEO's existing Document Controller criteria

KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.

We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

Title: Business Information Security Officer, Audit & Assurance
Description:
Overview:

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

KPMG Canada is seeking an experienced professional to fulfill the role of Business Information Security Officer (BISO), Audit & Assurance. This role reports to the Firm’s Chief Information Security Officer and operates within the Audit Business Unit, serving as the primary liaison between the central security function and the business.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine client-facing security advisory experience with technology risk and controls expertise, supporting Audit delivery and transformation, including the secure adoption of AI-enabled solutions. KPMG Canada’s Digital Security Group is responsible for governing and overseeing the Firm’s data and information security program.

The BISO will collaborate with Audit, ITS, Risk, Privacy, and Technology teams to assess cybersecurity risks, respond to client security requirements, and apply practical security controls The individual will provide security recommendations that reflect business needs, compliance and regulatory requirements, document and track identified risks, and obtain necessary risk and security approvals.

The ideal candidate brings experience in a large, complex, multi-jurisdictional organization and can explain technology, data flows, and security controls clearly to internal teams and clients. Strong knowledge of application lifecycle practices, security architecture, cloud platforms, Generative AI, API security, and application security standards such as OWASP, along with familiarity with frameworks such as ISO 42001, will support success in this role.

What you will do:

* Serve as the primary information security liaison between Audit and the Digital Security Group, being the first point of contact for client security questions
* Develop a thorough understanding of Audit applications and their security controls, data processing, and data locations, and explain these clearly to internal teams and clients
* Support reviews of security-related client contract conditions in collaboration with the appropriate Risk, Privacy, Legal, and Technology stakeholders
* Lead security-facing coordination for major client assessments, bringing together the broader supporting team and building trusted client relationships on security matters
* Coordinate consistent, proactive client security communications, including responses to emerging security concerns and inquiries
* Translate Firm security policies, procedures, and standards into practical, risk-based controls for the Business Unit technology ecosystem
* Proactively unblock and manage security, risk, and compliance issues by bringing together Audit, ITS, Risk, Security stakeholders, driving decisions, tracking actions, and ensuring issues are worked through to a clear and timely end state
* Monitor compliance with KPMG security policies, standards, and control requirements; identify non-compliance, initiate remediation actions, and track exceptions through formal risk acceptance processes with appropriate compensating controls
* Act as the BU key point of contact to understand security risks related to evolving business requirements for technology and solutions, and apply security-by-design principles to provide proactive, business-focused, guidance aligned with Firm’s security policies and standards
* In coordination with Platform Security team, assess and review business-requested software, tools, and AI capabilities (including SaaS and Generative AI solutions) for security, privacy, and compliance risks; lead intake, risk evaluation, and provide delegated approval or whitelisting where necessary
* Collaborate with Project, Technology, Business, and Risk teams to gather requirements and support the Security Assessment Review (SAR) process, led by Platform Security
* Develop and maintain a business unit Risk Register to track security risks
* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure security requirements are documented and tracked throughout the project lifecycle

Governance

* Maintain a strong understanding of KPMG security policies (e.g., GISP, AUP, ATO), requirements, and guidance from the CISO, Risk Management Partner, and Office of the General Counsel
* Maintain and validate a comprehensive inventory of business applications, tools, and technology assets (on-premises and cloud), ensuring alignment with Firm security standards
* Coordinate implementation and onboarding of new security programs and capabilities as directed by the CISO
* Contribute to annual business planning processes and recommend initiatives to enhance security posture and operational efficiency
* Represent the business unit and provide key metrics in monthly security governance forums

Vulnerability Management and Incident Response

* Own BU–level vulnerability management, including identification, prioritization, and remediation tracking across applications, endpoints, and cloud environments (including CSPM)
* Partner with Technology teams to drive timely remediation of identified vulnerabilities
* Manage responses to security incidents following KPMG’s incident management processes
* Represent the business unit in SEV1 incident response bridges

Monitoring

* Monitor adherence to KPMG security policies and standards
* Review compliance reports generated by security tools and address identified issues
* Perform regular reviews of installed applications to identify prohibited software and initiate remediation actions
* Maintain an accurate and up-to-date inventory of business applications (on-premises and cloud environments including Azure, AWS, and GCP)
* Monitor control effectiveness across all technology assets within the business unit

What you bring to this role:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security or a related field, or equivalent experience·
* 10+ years of experience in application, technology, or solution design, architecture, development, and implementation
* 5+ years of experience in secure design/architecture and project risk assessments across modern cloud and on-premises environments, including SaaS solutions
* 5+ years of experience as a security practitioner in a leadership role
* Experience in large, complex, multi-jurisdictional organizations, including technology environments with data and systems distributed across locations and jurisdictions
* Deep understanding of modern application development ecosystems, open systems, Generative AI, and emerging technologies
* Strong knowledge of information security standards and frameworks (e.g., CSA CCM, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, PCI DSS, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53) and data protection principles
* Experience evaluating modern AI tools and capabilities and applying practical security guardrails to emerging technology and transformation initiatives
* Proven experience in a consulting or advisory role, collaborating with Technology, Project, and Business stakeholders with strong communication and relationship-building skills to address client security questions, assessments, and contract requirements
* Holding any of the following certifications would be considered an asset but not required: CISSP, CISA, CRISC, CISM

This position requires written and oral fluency in English. The successful candidate will be required to support or collaborate with English-speaking colleagues or stakeholders nationally in our English speaking provinces while at KPMG.

Title: Security Officer
Description:
**Job Title:** Security Officer, Dayshift 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM

**Reports To:** Director of Safety and Security

**S****ummary/Objective**

Security Officers will strive to maintain a safe and secure environment at the Emerald Grande/HarborWalk Village. This position is accountable for securing the property, loss prevention, assisting guests and employees, responding to incidents, medical emergencies, and lost and found items.

**Principal Responsibilities:** These include, but are not limited to:

* **Respond to calls**: Respond to calls from on-duty staff, guests, visitors, customers, employees, and tenants. Immediately respond to situations that occur on property. Disperse disorderly individuals. If necessary, call Law Enforcement with all incidents involving criminal activity. Must be able to safely operate a motorized vehicle.
* **Patrols assigned area**: Discourage disruptive or disorderly behavior in a non-aggressive manner. Be aware of hazards to the resort and report them immediately. Foot patrol the entire resort and HarborWalk Village/Marina areas.
* **Perform various public relations activities:** Assists owners, guests, visitors, and employees with any problems within appropriate guidelines. Assisting in locating lost vehicle, missing person(s), provide medical care/assistance up to the appropriate level of training. Providing escorts to vehicle or other locations on property.
* **Performs various tenant relations activities:** Conducts walk through of tenant space to assist in the deterrence of criminal activity, such as shoplifting, walking tenant employee(s) to vehicle. Distribute correspondence to tenants from the various management staff (Association Manger, Marketing). Periodically contact tenant personnel to establish good working relations.
* **Communication of incidents and activities occurring on property:** Immediately notify the Manager of Safety and Security of all major incidents/situations that may cause a negative reflection on the company. Accurately complete various incident, accident, personal injury, and other reports for all situations that occur on property in accordance with policy. Must be able to use a two-way radio properly.
* **Ensures Routine Equipment Maintenance:** Performs proper accountability, safety, cleanliness, and preventive maintenance checks of all equipment.
* **Respond to Request for Support and/or Assistance:** Provide support and/or assistance to all departments, co-workers, owners, guest, visitors, and tenants of Emerald Grande and HarborWalk Village as tasked by management. Contribute 100% to the total team effort to implement projects or special events, and achieve or exceed management's goals.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.

**Mathematical Skills**

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

Description:

**Help Us Change Lives**

We live by the motto that “There is a Student in Front of Everything We Do” and we are very passionate about it. Do you have a passion to work with students? Remember the person who made a difference in your life? Now it’s your turn.

Learn more about us at https://learn4life.org/

**How You Will Make an Impact**

The Teacher Position will plan, organize and implement an appropriate personalized instructional program in a learning environment that guides, supports, and encourages students to develop and fulfill their academic potential, completion of diploma requirements and post-secondary transition plan. This Position will collaborate with other Instructional Staff and school personnel.

**RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES:** This list is *illustrative only* and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of tasks performed by this classification. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

* Develop, review and regularly update personalized academic plans based on students transcripts, assessment data, career pathway planning (CTE), post-secondary goals, and progress towards those goals
* Create and maintain an effective learning environment by modeling positive and respectful behavior, upholding and supporting high academic expectations, and maintaining positive and professional relationships with colleagues, students and parents
* Meet with students at their scheduled appointment dates and times
* Conduct effective student appointments; preparing for and delivering instruction, engaging students in goalsetting, monitoring of progress and preparation for completion of graduation requirements
* Assign appropriate courses of study
* Refer students to core subject area teachers when necessary
* Establish and communicate learning objectives and content standards to be assessed
* Plan, prepare for and deliver instructional activities to facilitate learning experiences
* Provide a variety of learning materials and resources to support independent learning
* Identify and implement instructional strategies and resources to meet students varying needs
* Engage students in academic conversations that elicit critical thinking, creativity, collaboration and communication
* Connect instruction to real-world experiences and students post-secondary goals
* Regularly check for understanding and provide clarifying and/or enrichment information
* Carefully observe, review and evaluate student homework and tests to assess and monitor progress
* Grade course homework, projects, and tests
* Provide students with meaningful feedback to enhance learning and improve achievement
* Encourage and monitor the progress of individual students
* Instruct and monitor student progress in the use of online learning materials and technology
* Provide appropriate accommodations, modifications and interventions for English Learners, students with 504 Plans, and Special Education students
* Model and guide students to develop strategies that foster independent learning skills such as, goal-setting, time management, and accessing/utilizing resources
* Use relevant technology to support instruction
* Administer diagnostic assessments according to guidelines set forth by the Organization and site
* Regularly communicate necessary information to students, colleagues, and parents regarding student progress and student needs
* Refer students to support structures; tutors, intervention programs, labs, counselors, and other wrap around services as appropriate
* Manage student behavior in the Resource Center by enforcing rules and disciplinary systems of the Center
* Prepare for and facilitate positive parent conferences
* Keep updated with developments in subject area curriculum, teaching resources and methods
* Maintain accurate and complete records of student progress and development
* Monitor credit completion rates of students
* Monitor student attendance
* Claim and report daily attendance

* Generate report cards in accordance to Organization/Charter procedures and guidelines
* Document and review student notes and parent/student contacts in Contact Manager
* Update all necessary records accurately and timely as required by law, Organizational policies, school regulations, and independent auditors

The LNA business model has been strategically designed to provide the support, knowledge and resources to improve efficiencies, uptime and overall productivity throughout any operation.

**Title**

Road Technician

Service Manager

The Road Technician will perform maintenance and repairs on various makes and models of forklift trucks and material handling equipment used by our customers. A Road Technician should be highly organized, have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and excellent mechanical repair skills.

Title: Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)
Description:
**Senior DevOps & SRE Engineer (SDE 3)**

**Platform & Reliability Engineering**

Location:
**Dubai, UAE**
|Function:
**Engineering**
| Type:
**Full-Time**
| Experience:
**7–10 years**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building one of the region's most ambitious e-commerce platforms: high-traffic, multi-region, and engineered for scale. Our platform — around fifteen backend services, a web storefront and native mobile apps — handles thousands of orders every day, and every one of them depends on infrastructure that is fast, observable, and always on.

*This is a founding role for our DevOps & SRE function. You will move our platform off a managed commerce PaaS onto infrastructure we own, set the reliability bar for every engineering squad, and build the team that keeps it there.*

**ABOUT THE FUNCTION**

DevOps & SRE sits at the centre of Lulu's e-commerce engineering. We own the platform every squad ships on: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data stores, networking, security and observability. We run on-call and incident response, define SLOs with product squads, and make sure peak sales events are boring. Over the next 12–18 months our biggest goal is migrating our workloads from a vendor-managed platform onto our own cloud footprint. We are deliberately keeping the team lean and AI-first: we expect AI agents and assistants to take on a large share of the toil — writing infrastructure-as-code and pipelines, triaging alerts, drafting runbooks and postmortems — so a small team can run a large platform.

**Core ownership:**
Cloud infrastructure & Kubernetes, CI/CD & release engineering, observability stack, data-store operations, on-call & incident management, platform migration

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

* Lead the migration of our e-commerce platform from a vendor-managed PaaS onto our own cloud infrastructure: discovery, target architecture, migration waves, cutover and decommissioning
* Design and run production Kubernetes for ~15 Python/Django services (DRF, Celery workers and beat), a Next.js storefront and supporting APIs, with Helm and GitOps-based delivery
* Operate and scale the stateful core of the platform: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — HA, backups, point-in-time recovery, upgrades and capacity planning
* Build an open-source observability stack across metrics, logs, traces and profiles (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) that every squad uses day to day
* Define SLIs, SLOs and error budgets with product squads for checkout, order management, delivery promise and storefront APIs, and alert on what customers actually feel
* Modernise CI/CD on Bitbucket Pipelines: build and release standards, progressive delivery (canary, blue-green), automated rollbacks and idempotent release scripts
* Codify everything as infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including networking, IAM, secrets management and environment provisioning
* Prepare the platform for peak events — load testing, autoscaling, capacity reviews and game days — so sale days run without incident
* Run incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive the reliability fixes that come out of them
* Own cloud cost visibility and optimisation (FinOps), making sure we spend where it buys reliability or speed

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Scope & Impact**

* Own multi-quarter, multi-team infrastructure and reliability goals, with the migration programme as the headline deliverable
* Make independent technical decisions on open-ended problems — build vs buy, managed vs self-hosted, which tool and when — grounded in business context and cost
* Drive cross-team initiatives across backend, frontend, mobile and data squads, optimising for the platform as a whole rather than any one team

**Technical Craft**

* Design infrastructure that meets its reliability, security and cost objectives and stays simple enough for a small team to run
* Debug non-deterministic production issues across the stack — kernel, network, container runtime, database, application — that escape less experienced engineers
* Automate toil relentlessly; treat runbooks, dashboards and alerts as code that is reviewed, versioned and tested
* Identify and retire technical risk early: single points of failure, untested backups, unpatched dependencies, end-of-life runtimes
* Champion an AI-first engineering culture — use AI tools and assistants to speed up infrastructure work, incident analysis and documentation

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Build the DevOps & SRE function: define its charter, roadmap and operating model, and how it works with product squads (platform-as-a-product, paved roads, self-service)
* Hire, coach and grow DevOps and SRE engineers; set the hiring bar and run interview loops for the function
* Keep the team lean by design — build automation and AI-assisted workflows that let a small team operate the whole platform, and measure the efficiency gains they deliver
* Design a sustainable on-call rotation with clear escalation paths, severity levels, incident command roles and stakeholder communication
* Establish reliability practices across engineering: SLO reviews, production-readiness reviews, postmortem culture, change management and DR drills
* Measure and report engineering health with DORA metrics, SLO attainment and cost dashboards; present them to engineering and business leadership
* Manage vendor relationships and infrastructure budget, and make the case for investment with data
* Act as a Culture Leader — partner with engineering leadership to set the tone, foster psychological safety and champion inclusive practices

**MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These are non-negotiable. We need engineers who can hit the ground running with our stack and ways of working.

* 7+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading or acting as technical lead for an infrastructure or reliability team
* Expert-level Kubernetes in production — cluster design, networking, ingress, autoscaling (HPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler), upgrades and troubleshooting
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable): VPC design, IAM, load balancing, managed databases and cost optimisation
* Strong infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux)
* Set up end-to-end observability and monitoring from scratch using open-source tools — metrics (Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager), logs (Loki or ELK/OpenSearch), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry with Tempo or Jaeger) and error tracking (self-hosted Sentry) — covering infrastructure, Kubernetes, databases, queues and application code, with dashboards, alert routing and on-call integration that teams rely on
* Practical SRE experience: defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, symptom-based alerting, incident command and blameless postmortems
* CI/CD expertise (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins) with deployment strategies such as canary and blue-green
* Strong Linux, networking (DNS, TLS, CDN, load balancers) and scripting skills in Python, Go or Bash — able to read and debug Python/Django application code
* Experience running Python web services and async workers (Celery or similar) in production, ideally in e-commerce, retail or other high-traffic consumer platforms

**NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

These will set you apart and accelerate your impact, but aren't required on day one.

* Hands-on leadership of at least one production migration between cloud providers (e.g. AWS to GCP, Azure to AWS) or from a managed PaaS to self-managed infrastructure — planning, data migration, cutover and rollback
* Proven experience migrating stateful systems with minimal downtime: PostgreSQL (logical replication, CDC), Kafka (MirrorMaker 2), Elasticsearch (snapshot/restore, reindexing) and Redis
* Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi), PostgreSQL operators (CloudNativePG, Zalando, Patroni) and the Elastic operator (ECK)
* Long-term metrics storage and scale-out observability: Thanos, Mimir or VictoriaMetrics; continuous profiling with Pyroscope; self-hosted Sentry
* Platform security and supply chain: HashiCorp Vault or External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno or OPA Gatekeeper, Falco, image signing and SBOMs
* Chaos engineering and load testing with LitmusChaos or Chaos Mesh, and k6 or Locust
* Cost tooling and FinOps practice: OpenCost or Kubecost, rightsizing, committed-use and spot strategies
* Building an internal developer platform or portal (e.g. Backstage) for service templates and self-service environments
* Familiarity with GCP data services (BigQuery, Pub/Sub) and supporting data-platform workloads
* Certifications such as CKA/CKS, Google Professional Cloud Architect or DevOps Engineer, or AWS DevOps Professional
* Public contributions: conference talks, technical blog posts or open-source maintainership

**TECH STACK**

**Application stack**

Python 3.9–3.12 (Django, DRF), Celery, Next.js / React, React Native

**Data stores**

PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch

**Messaging**

Kafka

**Cloud**

GCP (GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) — target for platform migration; AWS / Azure exposure valued

**Containers**

Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD

**IaC**

Terraform / OpenTofu, Ansible

**CI/CD**

Bitbucket Pipelines

**Observability**

Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, Sentry

**Security**

Vault / External Secrets, Trivy, Kyverno, WAF

To support and demonstrate our NMC Nursing Mission, Vision, and Values:

**Our Nursing Vision:** At NMC Healthcare, we are committed to providing clinical excellence through safe, compassionate, and individualized care to every patient, every time.

* Be open and transparent

* Engage with and contribute to, a learning culture

* Excellence
* Ethics
* Trust
* Collaboration

**Key Accountabilities**

  

These must be upheld in accordance with the Code of Conduct, Scope of Practice, and licensure as per the regulator.

**The post holder will:**

* Always speak up if safety is a concern
* Treat all patients with kindness, respect and compassion.
* Recognize and work within the limits of their own competence
* Take responsibility for their own actions
* Communicate effectively with colleagues to ensure patients receives the safest, most effective care possible.
* Perform additional duties when required

* Maintain up-to-date mandatory training requirements.
* Follow and comply with the NMC Nurse Competency Matrix / Framework, relevant to their role profile **.**

* Support and supervise pre-registration and new nurses and other health care workers when required.

* Participate in Performance Improvement Plans when required.
* Share knowledge and skill with others, to improve patient care and services.
* Ensure they are skilled, trained and competent before using any medical device.
* Involve patients in their own healthcare and recovery through education, awareness and positive reinforcement.

Title: Claims Officer
Description:
**\*\*\*PREFERENCE WILL BE GIVEN TO QATARI CANDIDATES\*\*\***
-------------------------------------------------------------

**Reporting structure**
-----------------------

**Reports to:** Head of Chartering

**Direct Reportees:** None

**Location:** Doha

**Job Summary and Purpose**
---------------------------

Monitor and timely process claims related to Nakilat’s commercially managed fleet, collaborate and align with all related stakeholders internally to get the best possible outcomes via the charterparty terms and/or support in negotiations with the relevant counterparties.

**Key Accountabilities 1**
--------------------------

* Build a well-established knowledge of charter parties and their commercial implications in any regard that may result in exposure to claims.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels against the charter parties and highlight any areas that may result in any demurrage, performance warranty and off-hire claims, as necessary.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels in line with charter party warranties and generate a monthly summary report highlighting any areas of over/underperformance (actual and potential). Further, follow up immediately with the vessels’ technical manager to address any underperformance observations or concerns.
* Recommend actions to resolve performance issues and continuously work towards the performance and efficiency of the fleet of ships.
* Monitor, track, and execute relevant cost reimbursement claims to charterers while liaising with the relevant internal stakeholders, i.e. Insurance, Finance, Fleet, etc.
* Provide relevant documents and information to successfully address any audit (internal and/or external) requirements.
* Support chartering & post fixture activities by ensuring compliance with charter party terms.
* Ensure compliance with proper procedures regarding management and approval of claims with reference to the respective and relevant internal lines of approval.
* Monitor and track the Charterers’ accounts, in collaboration with Finance, from a financial perspective to highlight any areas of concern where transactions would need attention. i.e. Hire, claims, cost reimbursement, etc.
* Facilitate regular meetings with Charterers for business discussions on the topic of claims, as required.

**Key Accountabilities 2**
--------------------------

**Legal and Insurance:**

* Review terms of Charter Party with Legal and Insurance functions and ensure that company’s interests are protected by ensuring necessary insurance coverage is in place, proper defense is arranged through vessels’ P&I Club and finally seek reimbursement of relevant expenses from charterers as per charter party clauses.
* Negotiate TCP claims, seek legal advice and provide recommendations to Head of Chartering.

**Planning:**

* Use all possible means for voyage planning including the use of software tools to monitor and coordinate all activities related to voyage. Also, analyze variance between the voyage plans versus the actual plan, while generating report for the Head of Chartering.
* Support the team in coordinating the periodical meetings with vessels’ technical manager to address any technical/operational issues which could have a commercial impact as well as address any customers’ concerns.
* Support the team in coordinating timely between Charterers and vessels’ technical manager to conduct any Owners’ related matters (e.g., SIRE, Crew change, spares delivery, lube oil supply) with minimum deviation and minimum (target zero) off hire & claim avoidance.

**Generic Accountabilities**
----------------------------

**Quality, Health, Safety, & Environment (QHSE):**

* Adhere to all relevant SHEQ policies, procedures, instructions, and controls so that NAKILAT provides a safe, world class, secure and environmentally responsible service to customers, the public and its own people.
* Track EUETS reports, procure EUAs and seek re-imbursement from charterers.
* Track Fuel EU compliance balance and other environmental regulations related to commercial settlement with charterers.

**Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures:**

* Implement approved policies, processes, and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.
* Recommend updates for the division’s relevant P&Ps for claims, as deemed appropriate to cope with evolving business needs.

**Qualifications, Experience and Job Skills**
---------------------------------------------

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Business/Economics/Technical of Marine Engineering or any other relevant field.
* Diploma in ship management and operations (ICS preferred).
* Diploma in ship chartering (ICS preferred).

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience as a charterer, shipping and commercial operator in a ship-owning company, chartering desk, trading desk, International Oil & Gas Company, or brokerage house.
* Ideally most recent position should involve commercial and post-fixture operations of vessels preferably LNGCs, VLGCs or tankers.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* Experience in contracts and claims negotiation will be an added advantage.
* Good knowledge of Shipping Commercial management – Chartering and Post-fixture Operations.
* Good record of leading and managing claims negotiations and minimizing commercial exposure.

Title: Facility Coordinator
Description:
**Who we are**

At Namaa, we build and operate tech-enabled urban infrastructure that gives consumers fast, reliable access to meals, groceries, and everyday essentials.

Traditional retail models, built around brick-and-mortar locations, often struggle to compete in today's digital-first landscape. Challenges such as cost efficiency per square foot, logistics-optimized locations, and seamless technology integration have made it clear that a new approach is needed.

We believe the future of foodservice and commerce lies in purpose-built infrastructure designed for speed, accuracy, and scalability. That's why Namaa was established—to power the next generation of digital food and quick commerce ecosystems across the Middle East.

Our ecosystem is driven by a portfolio of specialized business units, including **KitchenPark**, **CloudRetail**, and **Profood Properties**, each playing a key role in enabling brands to grow and thrive in an increasingly on-demand world.

  

**About the role**

We are seeking an organized and hands-on Facility Coordinator to support the Facility Manager in running the day-to-day maintenance of our Riyadh facilities. The role receives and prioritizes work orders, schedules technicians and vendors, tracks preventive maintenance, keeps compliance records up to date, and reports on performance. It is the first point of contact for site teams and restaurant partners on anything maintenance-related.

  

**What you'll do**

* Receive, log, prioritize, and dispatch work orders from site operations teams and restaurant brands through the CMMS / ticketing system.
* Schedule and coordinate the daily work of facility technicians and external vendors across Riyadh sites.
* Track the preventive maintenance calendar (HVAC, kitchen exhaust, gas, firefighting, fire alarm, electrical, plumbing) and flag overdue items to the Facility Manager.
* Coordinate vendor visits: raise purchase requests, confirm scope and quotes, supervise access and completion, and verify invoices against work done.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, permits, Civil Defense certificates, warranties, service logs, and equipment manuals.

Title: Regional Technology Specialist – Mission Critical & Enterprise
Description:
**Job Description**
The
**Regional Technology Specialist – Mission Critical & Enterprise (MEA)**
is a key member of the Mission Critical & Enterprise (MC-E) Technology Strategy team and reports to the Segment Technology Lead. The role serves as an important bridge between the segment’s global technology strategy, domain expertise, and the customer-facing Sales and Pre-Sales organizations across the Middle East and Africa Region.
  
  
T
**he position brings broad, horizontal technology depth across the MC-E segment’s mission-critical domains, including energy and utilities, transportation and rail, public sector and defence, and research and education.**
Rather than being focused on a single vertical or technology area, the Regional Technology Specialist is expected to understand the common technology requirements, architectural patterns, operational challenges, and emerging trends that cut across these industries and translate them into relevant solutions for customers in the region.
  
  
Working closely with the segment’s domain experts, the Regional Technology Specialist complements deep vertical expertise with a broader end-to-end technology and architecture perspective. The role helps connect customer requirements and business challenges with the appropriate technologies, solutions, architectures, and capabilities across the portfolio, ensuring that Sales and Pre-Sales teams can engage customers with a cohesive and technically credible point of view.
  
  
A significant part of the role is focused on supporting strategic customer engagements across MEA. This includes partnering with account teams during opportunity development, participating in customer workshops and technical discussions, helping shape solution architectures and technical value propositions, and providing guidance during complex or high-value pursuits. The specialist will also help identify where deeper involvement from MC-E domain experts, product teams, or other technology specialists is required and bring those resources together around the customer opportunity.
  
  
The role also acts as a two-way connection between the region and the broader MCE Technology Strategy organization. It helps bring global technology strategy, architectural direction, best practices, use cases, and lessons learned into MEA customer engagements, while also capturing regional customer requirements, competitive dynamics, technology trends, and emerging use cases and feeding those insights back into the segment.
  
  
Through this combination of regional engagement, horizontal technology expertise, and close collaboration with domain specialists, the Regional Technology Specialist strengthens the technical capabilities of the MEA field organization. The ultimate objective is to enable Sales and Pre-Sales teams to engage customers earlier and more strategically, develop stronger solution architectures, accelerate complex opportunities, and position the MC-E portfolio effectively across the region’s mission-critical markets.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales teams to support opportunity qualification, solution architecture, and technical positioning across Mission Critical & Enterprise domains.
* Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, technical presentations, executive briefings, and competitive discussions.
* Support RFI/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, proof-of-concept planning, and strategic pursuits.
* Translate customer business and technology requirements into compelling solution architectures and value propositions.
* Gather and analyze customer, partner, market, and competitive insights, converting findings into actionable recommendations.
* Contribute to technology strategy by developing business cases, supporting roadmap discussions, and providing market-driven requirements.
* Act as a liaison between regional teams and global technology strategy functions, communicating portfolio direction, best practices, and technology updates.
* Provide competitive intelligence, field-readiness input, and technical enablement assets to strengthen customer engagement and drive growth across the region.

**Key Skills And Experience**
Must have:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, telecommunications, business, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in IP networking, data centre networking, solution consulting, Pre-Sales, product management, or business development.
* Demonstrated experience supporting complex enterprise or mission-critical customer pursuits and collaborating with global Sales and Pre-Sales organizations.
* Broad working knowledge of IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, EVPN, timing (PTP/IEEE 1588), network security, and network automation, with the ability to apply them into mission-critical domains.
* Familiarity with one or more MC-E verticals (energy and utilities, rail and transport, public sector and defence, research and education).

Nice to have:
  
  

* Ability to translate technology capabilities into business outcomes and evidence-based business cases; strong presentation, facilitation, writing, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across functions, regions, and time zones in a matrixed organization; willingness to travel for customer and field engagements.
* Working knowledge of hardware platforms, optics, network software, orchestration, and lifecycle considerations in high-availability environments.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, differentiated value propositions, and clear customer recommendations.

* Responsible for monitoring scripts, doctor orders, D/C orders, and medical paperwork from doctors and uploading them into the electronic file.
* Responsible for creating monthly MARs for assigned caseloads and updating them with any new orders.
* Monitor the Medication Administration Records (MAR) for correct FHP documentation.
* Responsible for coordinating all initial HRST assessments for new to SCL waiver residents with contracted RN in the assigned caseload and sending them to the Medical Compliance Coordinator.
* Participate as a member of the Policy Committee, Admission Committee, and Management Team

Title: Environmental Inspector (Construction)
Description:
PACT (Pearson Accelerator Construction Team) is a General Partnership of Alberici, Amico, Kenaidan, and Obayashi, supported by design partners Egis, Mott MacDonald, and Weston Williamson + Partners. Together, we are delivering Accelerator, a major program of Pearson LIFT (Long-term Investment in Facilities and Terminals), Toronto Pearson's infrastructure development plan. This multi-year program is designed to address immediate passenger growth demands while preparing Canada’s largest airport for the future of air travel—including critical upgrades to airfield and infrastructure, greenhouse gas reduction initiatives, modernization of Terminals 1 and 3, and the creation of a world-class passenger experience.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Environmental Inspector is responsible for ensuring that all construction activities within the PACT program comply with applicable environmental regulations, project-specific environmental management plans, and industry best practices. This role plays a critical part in supporting sustainable construction practices while minimizing environmental impacts across project sites.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Conduct regular site inspections to verify compliance with federal, provincial, and municipal environmental regulations, as well as project permits and approvals.
* Monitor construction activities for adherence to Environmental Management Plans (EMPs), Erosion and Sediment Control (ESC) measures, and Spill Prevention Plans.
* Identify and document environmental risks, non-compliance issues, and potential impacts to soil, air, water, and wildlife.
* Prepare detailed inspection reports, including observations, deficiencies, corrective actions, and photographic records.
* Maintain accurate environmental logs, monitoring data, and regulatory documentation for audits and reporting requirements.
* Support internal and external environmental audits and regulatory inspections.
* Respond to environmental incidents (e.g., spills, unauthorized discharges, wildlife disturbances) and ensure proper containment, reporting, and remediation actions are implemented.
* Provide recommendations for corrective actions and follow-up to ensure resolution.
* Work closely with construction managers, subcontractors, engineers, and environmental consultants to promote compliance and environmental awareness.
* Communicate environmental requirements and site expectations to field teams and subcontractors.
* Liaise with regulatory agencies as required.
* Promote sustainable construction practices, waste reduction, and pollution prevention initiatives.
* Monitor waste management processes, including proper handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous materials.
* Support with environmental training and toolbox talks for site personnel.
* Support with other duties as needed.
