Title: Associate Administrative Officer (OPAS)
Description:
The Organizational Setting

Under the direction of the Director, Capacity Development and Implementation Bureau/ICAO (D/CDI), the Field Operations Section (FOS) is responsible for the strategic planning, development, execution, and evaluation of programmes in the Capacity Development and Implementation (CDI) Bureau. FOS assists with the identification of priority development requirements across civil aviation and with technical cooperation to recipient States. It carries out resource mobilization with multilateral and bilateral development partners and industry. FOS develops regional and country-specific technical cooperation programmes and projects and executes these programmes and projects in accordance with the policies and contractual modalities of CDI.

The Associate Administrative Officer is a combined finance and administration function that oversees the project office’s administrative and accounting tasks under the CDI Project: FSA2201. The incumbent reports to and works under the supervision of the CDI Programme Manager overseeing the project, in accordance with the terms of reference set out in this job description. The position is located in the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) of Saudi Arabia, in Riyadh, and works in close coordination with the CDI Field Operations Officer, ICAO Headquarters, GACA, and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to ensure the efficient, compliant and timely delivery of all financial and administrative services required for the successful implementation of the project. The incumbent exercises professional judgement in planning and delivering assigned work, analysing issues and identifying appropriate action within established policies, procedures and responsibilities. Complex or exceptional matters are referred to the supervisor for guidance.

Major duties and Responsibilities

Function 1 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides accounting and financial support for the effective administration of the project office by reviewing transactions, monitoring resource use and applying established financial procedure, achieving results such as:**

* Collaborate with relevant authorities to prepare the annual manning requirement list and coordinate with ICAO-HQ for budget preparation and submission of the budget report to the GACA Finance Department on a yearly basis.
* Liaise with GACA to ensure proper budget administration, authorization, and project funding, and bring discrepancies or delays to the attention of the supervisor.
* Manage petty cash, process payments towards project office expenses, reconcile monthly expenses, and prepare and submit Electronic Journal Cash Transactions (EJCT) cash book reports to ICAO Finance in Montreal.
* Analyse and monitor petty cash balances against the established threshold stipulated under ICAO financial rules and regulations, identify and address variances, coordinate the timely deposit of excess funds to UNDP, and prepare monthly replenishment requests to ensure the project’s petty cash balance remains consistent.
* Monitor local payments and payment authorizations for ICAO OPAS Experts, vendors, and other project-related expenses through UNDP, ensuring proper fund transfers and timely follow-up.
* Review vendor statements and invoices for completeness and submit them for approval and/or facilitate payment processing and manage the financial aspects of the ICAO experts and support staff members under the project.
* Manage travel claim records of ICAO OPAS Experts, ensuring compliance with ICAO and ICSC standards, monitor unsettled claims, and follow up on payments.

Function 2 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides administrative support to the project office, achieving results such as:**

* Coordinate day-to-day administrative activities, draft and review routine correspondence and letters, coordinate and monitor official email correspondence, and monitor follow-up actions to support timely field-project implementation.
* Organize project documentation, and coordinate the review, finalization and signature of the Management Service Agreement (MSA), the ProDoc, and related records.
* Coordinate the procurement of office supplies, and official operational requirements from local markets, and facilitate the procurement of digital publications for GACA and ICAO OPAS Experts.
* Contribute to the review of project reports, presentations, and financial analysis for the CDI Programme Manager.
* Organize and maintain an orderly e-filing system and documentation of all assigned tasks, correspondence and reports, applying applicable records-management standards; ensuring confidentiality and compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations; such documents to be shared only with the consent of the CDI Programme Manager.

Function 3 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides personnel and contract administration support, achieving results such as:**

* Compile, Analyse and submit key reports such as the Monthly Strength Return, Quarterly Reports, and Annual Reports.
* Coordinate with GACA authorities/Department Heads and ICAO-HQ on critical administrative matters, including contract extensions, staff performance reports, probationary reports, new expert arrivals, and repatriation of OPAS Experts.
* Review, reconcile and submit travel expense claim reports and educational grant claim reports for ICAO experts, and review, verify and submit leave requests (Annual, Sick, Home Leave, Family Visit, Lump Sum, and Mission Requests) to ICAOHQ in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate with the travel agency to arrange flight itineraries and issue domestic airline tickets for approved official travel and missions.
* Maintain updated and accurate administrative records, including contract renewal documentation, annual staff performance reports? (SPRs), driving authorization letters, and vehicle insurance records.
* Liaise with UNDP and GACA to facilitate the issuance and renewal of UN/GACA identification cards (IDs), and manage government-related requests such as Visas, IQAMA, Multiple Re-entry Visas, Final Exit Visas, and Driving Licenses through coordination with UNDP, UNRC and GACA.
* Coordinate training requirements for ICAO experts, including liaison with ICAO Global Aviation Training (GAT) Section, and prepare employment-related letters (bank letters, visa request letters, staff arrival letters, etc.).

Function 4 (incl. Expected results)

**Provides coordination, meetings and stakeholder support, achieving results such as:**

* Organize annual, quarterly and urgent meetings for the project office, and prepare draft agendas and minutes of the meetings (MOM) for project records.
* Liaise with GACA, ICAO, UNDP, UNDSS, UNRC and other relevant offices for project coordination, recruitment, and administrative support, and assist in meetings with these stakeholders to address project requirements.
* Facilitate recruitment processes, including coordination with GACA and ICAO for candidate approvals and onboarding, and assist with contract extensions, SPR, and repatriation processes for project staff.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination across all stakeholders, inside and outside the project office, for the effective implementation of the project.
* Maintain the confidentiality of all project-related data and ensure compliance with GACA, ICAO, and UN regulations.

Function 5 (incl. Expected results)

**Performs any other duties as required for the successful and timely implementation of the programme.**

Impact of The Outcome of the Position

The Associate Administrative Officer ensures effective project administration by managing communications, documentation, and stakeholder coordination. This role directly supports project efficiency, compliance, and the seamless operation of administrative tasks within the ICAO-CDI Project. The position plays a key role in maintaining efficient administrative operations, ensuring compliance with policies, and supporting project coordination, which directly impacts smooth project execution and stakeholder collaboration.

Work Relations and Contacts

The Associate Administrative Officer reports to the GACA Authorities in close coordination with the CDI Programme Manager. The incumbent also coordinates with ICAO experts on administrative matters, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.

COMPETENCIES

**Core Competencies** **:**

**Professionalism** : Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work.

**Teamwork** : Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organizational goals; solicits input by genuinely valuing others’ ideas and expertise; is willing to learn from others; places team agenda before personal agenda; supports and acts in accordance with final group decision, even when such decisions may not entirely reflect own position; shares credit for team accomplishments and accepts joint responsibility for team shortcomings.

**Communication:** Speaks and writes clearly and effectively; listens to others, correctly interprets messages from others and responds appropriately; asks questions to clarify, and exhibits interest in having two-way communication; tailors language, tone, style, and format to match the audience; demonstrates openness in sharing information and keeping people informed.

**Planning and Organizing** : Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies; identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required; allocates appropriate amount of time and resources for completing work; foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning; monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary; uses time efficiently.

**Accountability** : Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honours commitments; delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost and quality standards; operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules; supports subordinates, provides oversight and takes responsibility for delegated assignments; takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable.

**Client Orientation** : Considers all those to whom services are provided to be “clients ” and seeks to see things from clients’ point of view; establishes and maintains productive partnerships with clients by gaining their trust and respect; Identifies clients’ needs and matches them to appropriate solutions; monitors ongoing developments inside and outside the clients’ environment to keep informed and anticipate problems; keeps clients informed of progress or setbacks in projects; meets timeline for delivery of products or services to client.

Qualifications and Experience

Education

**Essential**

* A first-level university degree (Bachelor’s) in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

**Desirable**

* An advanced university degree (Master’s) in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

Professional Experience

**Essential**

* A minimum of four years of relevant experience in administration, finance, or project management, preferably in aviation or international projects.
* Proficiency in financial reporting, budget management, and cash management.
* Proven experience in office management and administrative procedures.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize and multi-task, and strong attention to detail, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills, with experience in coordinating with international and local organizations and various stakeholders.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint), document editing software (Microsoft Office, Adobe Pro), financial software and ERP systems.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of ICAO CDI – Field Service Staff Rules (FSSR) and associated Personnel Instructions (PIs).
* Experience in vendor management and procurement.
* Experience and knowledge in the aviation industry.

Languages

**Desirable**

Supervise a group of BIM team leads delivering concurrent infrastructure projects, and carry the accountability for what that group produces. **Deployment and progress**

* Local authority requirements in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, including utility depth, cover and corridor allocation standards.

Description:
About Gleason
  
With more than 2,200 employees and 13 manufacturing facilities worldwide, Gleason Corporation is a leader in gear technology. Gleason's product and service offerings include gear and transmission design software, gear manufacturing machines and related accessories, gear metrology equipment and automation systems. Gleason products are used by customers in e-mobility, commercial vehicles, aerospace, agriculture, mining, sustainable energy, construction, power tools, marine and many other industries

The result is a career defined by you, supported by Gleason and built on tangible accomplishments. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for the right people to join us on our mission. If you are interested in being part of our team, there are a few things you should know: We are energized by challenges and the effort needed to solve them. We like working with people who are positive, adaptable and growth-minded. We care how work gets accomplished and are deeply invested in the success of our customers and colleagues. If this sounds like you, we invite you to read on and learn more.
  
  
Why work at Gleason?
  

* Excellent benefits package including a 6% Company 401(k) match
* Flexible scheduling
* Tuition Assistance Program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Formal and informal Development opportunities.

Multi-site enterprise network security | Hands-on technical leadership
  
The opportunity
  
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on network and infrastructure security engineer to own the operational security, reliability, and continuous improvement of our networks across multiple company locations. This role is primarily focused on network engineering and defensive security—not a policy-only cybersecurity position. The successful candidate will be our resident technical expert for firewalls, secure connectivity, network segmentation, switching, wireless, and protection of internet-facing infrastructure.
  
You will work with Corporate IT and local IT teams to identify weaknesses before they are exploited, establish consistent technical standards, and resolve complex incidents without depending on vendors for routine diagnosis.
  
What you will own
  

* Firewall and perimeter security: Administer, harden, monitor, and troubleshoot next-generation firewalls and edge services; manage rule bases, NAT, IPS/IDS, remote access, VPNs, firmware, certificates, and secure management access. Experience with Palo Alto, SonicWall, Sophos, and/or Fortinet is especially relevant.
* Proactive vulnerability and patch management: Maintain an accurate inventory of network/security devices; track vendor advisories, exposed services, end-of-life systems, configuration drift, and vulnerabilities. Prioritize and coordinate firmware/security updates, validate remediation, and document exceptions.
* Segmentation and secure architecture: Design and maintain VLANs, ACLs, inter-VLAN controls, least-privilege access, site-to-site connectivity, and segmentation of user, server, guest, management, and other higher-risk networks. Reduce lateral-movement opportunities.
* Switching, wireless, and network operations: Configure and troubleshoot managed switches, routing, DNS/DHCP dependencies, wireless controllers/APs, authentication, and network performance. Understand the security implications of each component.
* Detection, response, and resilience: Review firewall/network telemetry and alerts, investigate suspicious traffic and attempted intrusions, support incident containment, validate backups of device configurations, and test recovery procedures.
* Multi-site standards and execution: Conduct regular site security reviews; maintain network diagrams, configurations, change records, runbooks, and remediation plans. Coordinate changes with local IT teams while ensuring common corporate security baselines.
* Technical Leadership and Continuous Improvement: Serve as a technical escalation point for complex network and security issues. Provide technical guidance to IT personnel across locations, establish engineering standards, and lead initiatives that improve the security and reliability of enterprise infrastructure.

Required experience and capabilities
  

* 3-5 years of hands-on enterprise network administration/engineering, including direct responsibility for firewall security and multi-site connectivity.
* Proven ability to configure, troubleshoot, and secure at least one major next-generation firewall platform; ability to learn and support additional platforms.
* Strong TCP/IP, routing, VLAN, ACL, VPN/IPsec, switching, wireless, DNS, DHCP, and network troubleshooting skills.
* Experience managing security patches, firmware upgrades, vulnerability remediation, and change control on production network devices.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, packet captures, traffic analysis, and a structured root-cause methodology.
* Practical understanding of attack paths, exposed services, credential-based attacks, segmentation, least privilege, and defense in depth.
* Clear documentation, sound risk judgment, and ability to coordinate with distributed IT staff and business stakeholders.
* Ability to independently investigate complex security incidents using firewall logs, packet captures, network traffic analysis, and other diagnostic tools.
* Experience implementing secure administrative access, privileged access controls, and network management security best practices.
* Ability to lead technical projects, make architecture recommendations, and serve as a escalation resource for network and security operations.

Preferred qualifications
  
Experience across Palo Alto, SonicWall, Sophos, and Fortinet; enterprise Wi-Fi and switch management; hybrid Active Directory/Entra ID environments; endpoint detection and response integration; CrowdStrike vulnerability scanning and SIEM/log monitoring; manufacturing or operational technology (OT) segmentation; Experience with high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity design. Relevant vendor certifications (for example PCNSE, NSE/FCP/FCSS, CCNP, or equivalent) are valued, but demonstrated hands-on ability matters more than credentials.
  
What success looks like
  

* Internet-facing devices are inventoried, hardened, monitored, and patched within risk-based targets.
* Firewall rules and VPN access are reviewed regularly; unnecessary exposure and overly permissive access are reduced.
* Sites follow consistent segmentation, configuration, logging, backup, and change-control standards.
* High-risk findings have clear owners, remediation plans, and evidence of closure.
* When an outage or suspicious event occurs, you can diagnose the technical cause, restore service safely, and prevent recurrence.

Title: Project Coordinator
Description:
**Who are we?**  
Global Maritime is a leading marine, offshore, and engineering consultancy that offers intellectually stimulating work within a deeply collaborative culture and with uniquely supportive leadership. This environment creates a culture where talented professionals truly thrive. At the heart of what we do are extraordinary challenges. We directly contribute to unique, often world-first projects on the global stage. We are driven by a vibrant culture of innovation, including dedicated R&D, advanced in-house software, and the freedom to develop your own ideas. This rapid exposure across the entire spectrum of marine, offshore, and engineering consultancy accelerates your expertise like nowhere else.
  
  
**Welcoming you to our team:**  
Based in Global Maritime’s Qatar office, the Project Coordinator will report directly to the Country Manager and play a critical role within the Marine Services Department. This team supports marine operations and offshore projects by ensuring the effective engagement, coordination, and deployment of subcontractors to meet project requirements safely, efficiently, and compliantly. Working closely with clients, vendors, agents, finance teams, and operational personnel, you will be at the heart of maintaining seamless project execution through effective administration, logistics coordination, documentation management, and stakeholder engagement. This role is ideal for an organized and proactive professional who enjoys working in a dynamic marine and offshore environment and thrives on ensuring operational excellence behind the scenes.
  
  
**What does success look like in this position?**  
Success in this role means keeping subcontractor and personnel records accurate, up to date, and readily available to support uninterrupted project operations. You will confidently manage qualifications, medical certificates, visas, training records, and travel arrangements, ensuring that subcontractors are always prepared for mobilization and demobilization activities. You will proactively identify upcoming document expirations and coordinate renewals well in advance, reducing operational delays and ensuring business continuity.
  
You will build strong working relationships with clients, vendors, agents, and internal stakeholders, creating clear communication channels that enable projects to progress smoothly. Success also means efficiently coordinating visas, port passes, travel, accommodation, and logistical arrangements while maintaining cost-effective solutions that support operational objectives.
  
In this position, you will accurately process timesheets, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor documentation through NetSuite, ensuring compliance with company procedures and client requirements. You will maintain reliable filing systems, provide management with real-time workforce availability and compliance data, contribute to monthly ESG reporting requirements, and support HSEQ initiatives through equipment calibration coordination, first aid kit maintenance, and reporting activities. Your attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to operational excellence will directly contribute to the successful delivery of marine services projects.
  
  
**How you make an impact:**  
As our Project Coordinator, you will make a significant impact by ensuring that all subcontractor deployment activities are managed efficiently, compliantly, and without disruption to project delivery. You will serve as a central point of coordination for operational documentation, mobilization logistics, compliance records, and stakeholder communications, helping the Marine Services Department deliver services effectively and maintain high standards of professionalism.
  
Your contribution will strengthen the organization's ability to mobilize qualified personnel quickly and efficiently while reducing operational risks associated with documentation, travel, compliance, and contractor management. By maintaining accurate records, supporting invoice and timesheet processing, generating purchase orders, and coordinating with the finance department, you will help ensure operational transparency and financial efficiency.
  
You will also play an important role in supporting the company's HSEQ and ESG objectives through reporting activities, equipment calibration management, customer feedback tracking, and health and safety administration. Through your proactive approach, attention to detail, and strong stakeholder management skills, you will help drive operational continuity, regulatory compliance, and exceptional service delivery for clients across Qatar and the wider region.

* Bachelor’s degree and/or relevant experience within marine, offshore, crewing, logistics, project support, or subcontractor coordination environments.
* Experience working with document management systems and maintaining compliance-related personnel records.
* Strong understanding of mobilization and demobilization processes, including visas, travel arrangements, port passes, and international travel coordination.
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills with the ability to maintain databases, trackers, reports, and operational records accurately.
* Experience processing timesheets, invoices, purchase orders, and supporting finance-related administration within a structured business environment.
* Fluent written and spoken English, with Arabic language skills considered advantageous.
* Knowledge of Middle Eastern business practices and culture, preferably within Qatar or the wider Gulf region.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to liaise professionally with clients, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy.
* A confident self-starter who can work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* To act within the powers of their role, leading by example and following GM compliance, ethics and company values.

Global Maritime stands out as the premier destination for any maritime professional due to our unique blend of technical opportunities – the chance to shape the industry's future on globally significant, cutting-edge projects – within a genuinely supportive and collaborative international community. This is all combined and led with leadership that actively mentors your growth within an empowering non-political environment.

The Network Engineer acts as the primary network architect for assigned domains, translating business, operational, and security requirements into scalable, resilient, and supportable network solutions. In addition to advanced operational responsibilities, the role provides technical leadership, mentors other network staff, serves as subject matter expert for initiatives, and collaborates with management, IT peers, vendors, and security stakeholders to deliver reliable and secure network services.

Operational Support & Service Reliability

* Participate in after-hours on-call rotation, with accountability for ensuring networks are architected to be stable, secure, and recoverable.

Network Architecture & Infrastructure Design :

* Own the network and network-security architecture for assigned domains, including LAN, WAN, WLAN, Internet connectivity, and secure access platforms.
* Design and maintain network solutions supporting a multi-site, 24x7 environment, with emphasis on availability, resiliency, segmentation, and security-by-design.
* Lead requirements gathering, architecture, and technical design for network and security initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and security architecture.
* Act as technical lead and network architect for projects and major changes, providing design authority and implementation guidance.
* serve as the primary technical authority for secure connectivity, network segmentation, perimeter defense, and traffic control platforms.

Security & Risk Management

* Partner closely with the Cybersecurity team to ensure network designs support enterprise security controls, risk management practices, and regulatory requirements.
* Assume technical authority and lifecycle accountability for the security posture of assigned network systems.
* Identify and drive architectural and operational improvements that reduce incidents, improve security, and enhance overall service reliability.

Project Leadership & Continuous Improvement

* Lead network and security initiatives from requirements gathering through implementation and operational transition.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance for projects, major changes, and infrastructure enhancements.

Title: Principal Network Developer
Description:
As a Principal Network Development Engineer within NAT, you will serve as a senior technical leader for network acquisition, connectivity delivery, and activation across OCI’s global infrastructure. You will guide the engineering execution of connectivity supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, backbone growth, and strategic network deployments.

You will operate at the intersection of network architecture, telecommunications, optical infrastructure, service providers, data center engineering, deployment, and operations. Your scope will span carrier circuits, dark and lit fiber, DWDM and wavelength services, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects. You will translate complex network designs and business requirements into clear technical specifications, implementation approaches, and acceptance criteria for internal teams and infrastructure partners.

At the Principal level, you will lead engineering decisions across programs and deployments, resolve ambiguous technical requirements, and evaluate tradeoffs involving capacity, performance, resiliency, physical route diversity, operational supportability, and delivery constraints. You will partner with architecture and engineering teams to identify implementation gaps early and use delivery and operational experience to influence future designs, technical standards, and supplier requirements.

You will establish the technical requirements for circuit acceptance, fiber and optical validation, turn-up, activation, and production readiness. You will guide teams in evaluating test evidence, resolving deficiencies, and documenting readiness decisions, exceptions, and remediation requirements before operational handoff. As a senior technical escalation point, you will lead the resolution of complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 issues across OCI teams and external providers, drive root cause analysis, and ensure recurring failures result in corrective actions and engineering improvements.

You will work closely with Program Managers to assess technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and recovery options across the delivery portfolio. You will strengthen NAT’s engineering practices through reusable standards, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, acceptance frameworks, accurate infrastructure records, and clear operational handoffs. You will also guide the use of automation, scripting, telemetry, database management tools, and AI-assisted engineering to improve validation, troubleshooting, data quality, and delivery efficiency while maintaining engineering rigor and validating outputs.

This role requires deep network engineering expertise, sound technical judgment, and the ability to drive complex outcomes across organizations and external suppliers. You will influence technical direction, mentor engineers, and raise engineering standards across NAT, with an emphasis on repeatable practices that improve connectivity quality, reliability, and readiness at global scale.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Provide senior technical leadership for complex global connectivity programs supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, and strategic network deployments.
* Own technical outcomes across the lifecycle of carrier circuits, dark fiber, lit fiber, wavelengths, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects.
* Translate high-level network architecture and business requirements into detailed technical delivery requirements and implementation strategies.
* Lead technical design reviews covering topology, physical paths, diversity, demarcation, transport, interfaces, optics, capacity, routing, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Identify design and delivery risks early and drive engineering decisions that prevent downstream deployment and operational issues.
* Define technical acceptance standards and validation requirements for network infrastructure delivered by external providers.
* Lead complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting across fiber, optical transport, Ethernet, routing, and provider networks.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for systemic or high-impact connectivity issues.
* Lead deep-dive root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions across Oracle and supplier engineering organizations.
* Act as a technical authority in supplier engagements, challenging proposed solutions and ensuring services meet OCI engineering, reliability, scalability, and operational requirements.
* Partner with Program Managers to assess technical risk, establish delivery strategy, make tradeoffs, and develop recovery plans for critical infrastructure.
* Lead cross-functional engineering efforts involving network architecture, backbone, Internet, optical, capacity, deployment, operations, data center teams, and suppliers.
* Develop technical standards, design patterns, acceptance criteria, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, and engineering best practices that can be applied globally.
* Identify systemic gaps in network acquisition and delivery and lead technical improvements that increase quality, predictability, and operational readiness.
* Influence supplier capabilities, technical roadmaps, testing methodologies, and service offerings based on OCI requirements.
* Lead or contribute to technical evaluation of new carriers, services, hardware, optical technologies, and connectivity solutions.
* Define requirements for automation and tooling that improve network delivery, validation, monitoring, inventory accuracy, and troubleshooting.
* Partner with software and automation teams to ensure engineering requirements are translated into scalable tools and workflows.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate technical analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution development while maintaining engineering rigor.
* Provide technical coaching and mentorship to NDEs, Program Managers, and partner teams.
* Raise the technical bar for NAT and serve as a trusted technical advisor across the organization.

**Critical Focus Areas**
========================

* Global carrier and service provider networking
* Optical transport, DWDM, dark fiber, lit fiber, and wavelengths
* Internet transit, peering, and inter-domain networking
* Backbone and metro connectivity
* Network architecture and resiliency
* Circuit and fiber acceptance
* Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting
* Supplier technical leadership
* Network readiness and production acceptance
* Root cause analysis and systemic remediation
* Technical standards and engineering governance
* Automation requirements and AI-assisted engineering

**Qualifications**
==================

* Extensive experience designing, building, operating, or delivering large-scale networks within hyperscale cloud, Tier 1 ISP, telecommunications, service provider, or comparable environments.
* Expert-level knowledge in at least one networking domain such as routing, optical transport, Internet, backbone, or data center networking, with strong knowledge across multiple adjacent domains.
* Deep understanding of network architectures and network device behavior.
* Strong knowledge of routing and networking protocols including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, TCP/IP, IPv4, and IPv6.
* Deep experience troubleshooting complex network problems across physical, optical, Ethernet, transport, and routing layers.
* Strong understanding of optical networking, fiber infrastructure, structured cabling, cross-connects, transceivers, and physical network design.
* Experience with Internet peering, transit, inter-domain networking, backbone infrastructure, or large-scale service provider connectivity.
* Experience translating high-level architectures into detailed technical designs and implementation requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple engineers and cross-functional organizations.
* Experience working directly with supplier engineering teams to resolve technical issues and improve infrastructure solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as an escalation point and lead root cause analysis for complex or large-scale network events.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to evaluate tradeoffs involving architecture, resiliency, performance, cost, schedule, and operational complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical issues and recommendations to engineering and senior leadership audiences.
* Experience with scripting or programming and a strong understanding of software development and network automation concepts.
* Experience defining technical requirements for automation, tooling, monitoring, or operational systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience designing or delivering carrier connectivity at global scale.
* Deep experience with dark fiber, lit fiber, DWDM, optical transport, wavelengths, metro fiber, or long-haul networks.
* Experience with OTDR, optical power testing, fiber characterization, acceptance testing, and complex optical troubleshooting.
* Experience working directly with major telecommunications carriers, ISPs, fiber providers, optical vendors, or colocation providers.
* Experience with network diversity, route engineering, physical path analysis, and resiliency requirements.
* Experience with Internet peering, transit architecture, BGP policy, and inter-domain networking.
* Experience supporting hyperscale AI or GPU infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Broadcom and NVIDIA/Mellanox-based networking platforms.
* Familiarity with YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF, gNMI, telemetry, and model-driven networking.
* Experience influencing supplier technical roadmaps, hardware adoption, testing strategies, or service capabilities.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate troubleshooting, analysis, documentation, scripting, and engineering workflows.
* Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership across engineering organizations.

Title: Inflight Training Operations Controller
Description:
Job Summary:

Reporting to the Manager, Crew Planning, the Inflight Training Operations Controller is responsible for the coordination, execution, and oversight of all short-term inflight training activities. This role manages the day-to-day and monthly scheduling of Flight Attendant training programs, ensuring compliance with all regulatory and company training requirements.

Working collaboratively with Inflight Training, Crew Planning, and operational stakeholders, the Controller ensures training activities are effectively scheduled, monitored, and recovered in the event of operational disruptions. The role is critical to maintaining crew qualifications, operational readiness, and compliance with Transport Canada regulations and company standards.

Duties & Responsibilities:

### **Training Operations & Scheduling**

* Execute and manage all short-term (current month and day-of) inflight training schedules.
* Plan, adjust, and optimize training activities within crew management systems.
* Coordinate recovery of disrupted training events, including initial, recurrent, upgrade, and specialized training.
* Schedule and adjust instructor resources to support training delivery requirements.

### **Tracking & Compliance**

* Monitor and track completion of all inflight training to ensure regulatory and company compliance.
* Oversee inflight crew training validity and currency in accordance with Transport Canada regulations and company policies.
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate compliance risks, including expiries or missed training.

### **Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Liaise with Inflight Training, Crew Scheduling, and external vendors to support training delivery and recovery efforts.
* Partner with Inflight leadership on training priorities, constraints, and operational impacts.
* Communicate training schedules, updates, and changes clearly to inflight crew members.

### **Systems & Administration**

* Maintain accurate training records and scheduling updates within crew management systems.
* Input and validate schedule adjustments and associated pay implications.
* Review and reconcile manual adjustments related to training and crew utilization.

### **Reporting & Monitoring**

* Monitor daily training performance and identify risks to completion or operational readiness.
* Generate and maintain reports on training status, expiries, and recovery plans.
* Provide data-driven insights to support planning and decision-making.

### **Safety & Compliance**

* Actively participate in the Safety Management System (SMS), including reporting hazards and operational irregularities.
* Promote adherence to company safety policies and regulatory requirements.

Behavioural Competencies:

* **Concern for Safety:** Identifying hazardous or potentially hazardous situations and taking appropriate action to maintain a safe environment for self and others.
* **Teamwork:** Working collaboratively with others to achieve organizational goals.
* **Passenger/Customer Service:** Providing service excellence to internal and/or external customers (passengers).
* **Initiative:** Dealing with situations and issues proactively and persistently, seizing opportunities that arise.
* **Results Focus:** Focusing efforts on achieving high quality results consistent with the organization’s standards.
* **Fostering Communication:** Listening and communicating openly, honestly, and respectfully with different audiences, promoting dialogue and building consensus.

Qualifications:

* Minimum 1 year of experience in Crew Scheduling, Crew Planning, Training Coordination, or a related operational role
* Experience in inflight operations or training environments is considered an asset
* Familiarity with aviation regulatory requirements (e.g., Transport Canada Cabin Safety) is preferred
* Experience with crew management systems (e.g., Navblue or similar platforms) is an asset
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace
* Strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, operational environment
* Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Effective interpersonal and communication (written and verbal) skills
* High level of accountability, integrity, and professionalism
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team
* Proactive approach with a focus on continuous improvement
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence

Title: Project Engineering Management, Principal Engineer
Description:

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings

Title: Network Engineer II
Description:
iT1, a leading national technology solution provider headquartered in Tempe, AZ, is looking for a skilled and experienced Network Engineer II to join our Consulting team. iT1 has been ranked as one of Arizona’s Best Places to Work for over a decade, running in the Small Business category. This role is an exciting opportunity to continue your career in the IT consulting and managed services world. You will be exposed to many of the top technology offerings in the market and can work with some of the most talented engineers in the country.  
  
The Network Engineer II provides day-to-day operational support for the client’s in-scope network, connectivity, wireless, security, optical, voice, and unified communications infrastructure. With at least two years of relevant network support experience and hands-on Cisco ACI/APIC experience, the engineer monitors platform health, performs incident triage and routine troubleshooting, implements approved standard changes, maintains documentation, and escalates complex issues to senior engineers, carriers, or technology vendors. The role works closely with iT1 service management, the dedicated Client Success Manager, client stakeholders, and other technical teams.

 **Requirements**  

* Serve as a dedicated Tier 2 network support resource, resolving incidents within documented procedures and escalating complex or high-impact conditions to senior engineering resources.
* Provide operational support for routers, LAN and data center switches, firewalls, load balancers, network access control, WAN edge devices, VPN infrastructure, routing and switching protocols, VLANs, segmentation, QoS, and high-availability configurations.
* Provide hands-on Cisco ACI/APIC operational support, including fabric-health monitoring, fault and event triage, endpoint and EPG troubleshooting, VLAN/VXLAN connectivity. Escalate fabric design or high-risk changes to senior engineers.
* Monitor, investigate, and improve infrastructure availability and performance using health, capacity, telemetry, configuration, threshold, log, interface, latency, jitter, packet-loss, redundancy, and failover indicators where supported.
* Troubleshoot and manage Cisco SD-WAN controllers, edge devices, overlays, tunnels, internet circuits, and site-to-site or remote-access VPN services.
* Support wireless controllers and access-point infrastructure, including availability, registration, RF utilization indicators, authentication failures, roaming, interference, firmware status, configuration backup, security alerts, capacity, and coverage trends.
* Perform alert validation, incident triage, service-restoration actions, incident remediation, problem management, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, known-error tracking, and corrective-action follow-up.
* Implement approved standard changes and assist senior engineers with normal or emergency changes, including maintenance-window coordination, validation, rollback execution, closure documentation, and follow-up actions.
* Coordinate OS, firmware, and infrastructure patching activities within the approved scope, including planning, testing, rollout, validation, and vendor coordination.
* Maintain accurate HLD/LLD documentation, logical and physical diagrams, configuration records and backups, SOPs, runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, IPAM/DNS/DHCP records, inventories, monitoring definitions, change logs, and knowledge-base articles.
* Provide technical input for recurring service reviews, including infrastructure health, incident and alert trends, capacity, performance, lifecycle concerns, risks, documentation currency, vendor cases, and continuous-improvement recommendations.

**JOB QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum of two years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise or public-sector network environments in a managed-services, NOC, infrastructure operations, or similar support model, including practical Cisco ACI/APIC administration or troubleshooting experience.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting experience across routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, wireless, SD-WAN, network segmentation, QoS, high availability, and network performance, with the judgment to escalate issues beyond the role’s level of authority.
* Hands-on Cisco ACI/APIC experience is required, including working knowledge of tenants, application profiles, EPGs, bridge domains, contracts, endpoint learning, fabric health, faults, interface policies, and basic leaf-spine troubleshooting. Experience with Cisco enterprise networking should also include Catalyst switching, ISR/ASR or Catalyst 8000 routing, common routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP, and switching protocols such as Spanning Tree; Nexus experience is strongly preferred.

The Group operates multiple F&B concepts, with a focus on casual fine dining and premium dining experiences. This role will play a pivotal part in strengthening operational excellence, driving commercial performance, developing scalable business models, and supporting the Group's long-term growth ambitions.

Job Purpose

The Head of F&B will provide strategic direction and end-to-end operational leadership across the Group's F&B entities. The position requires a commercially driven hospitality professional with a proven track record in managing multi-unit restaurant operations, driving profitability, developing people, and scaling F&B businesses.

The successful candidate will be responsible for translating business objectives into actionable strategies, ensuring operational consistency across concepts, and identifying opportunities for sustainable growth and expansion.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Leadership & Business Development

* Develop and implement the overall F&B strategy in alignment with the Group's vision, business objectives, and growth plans.
* Lead the development, expansion, and scaling of existing restaurant concepts and identify opportunities for new concepts.
* Drive business growth through market analysis, competitor benchmarking, and identification of new revenue streams.
* Establish organisational structures, operational frameworks, and business processes to support a growing multi-entity F&B portfolio.
* Present strategic business plans, expansion proposals, and performance reviews to senior leadership.

2. End-to-End Operations Management

* Oversee the complete operational lifecycle of all F&B entities, covering front-of-house, back-of-house, kitchen operations, service delivery, and guest relations.
* Ensure consistent food quality, service standards, brand positioning, and operational excellence across all outlets.
* Develop and implement SOPs, operational manuals, policies, and performance management frameworks.
* Monitor outlet performance through regular operational reviews, site visits, and management reporting.
* Ensure compliance with UAE food safety regulations, municipality requirements, hygiene standards, and applicable legislation.
* Drive continuous improvement in operational efficiency, productivity, and customer experience.

3. Financial & Commercial Management

* Take full accountability for the financial performance and profitability of the F&B portfolio.
* Develop and manage annual budgets, business plans, financial forecasts, and revenue targets.
* Monitor and optimise key financial indicators, including food cost, labour cost, operating expenses, wastage, average transaction value, and outlet profitability.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins, optimise resources, and maximise commercial returns without compromising quality.
* Oversee pricing strategies, menu engineering, inventory management, and procurement efficiency.
* Work closely with Finance to ensure effective financial controls, accurate reporting, and budgetary discipline.

4. Brand Management & Guest Experience

* Protect and strengthen the identity and market positioning of each restaurant concept.
* Drive menu innovation, product development, pricing strategies, and seasonal offerings in collaboration with culinary teams.
* Establish a strong guest-centric culture focused on service excellence and customer retention.
* Monitor customer feedback, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with Marketing to develop brand campaigns, promotional activities, partnerships, and revenue-generating initiatives.
* Ensure a consistent and differentiated dining experience across all concepts.

5. Business Expansion & New Outlet Development

* Lead the planning and execution of new restaurant openings, from concept development through to launch and operational stabilisation.
* Evaluate potential expansion opportunities, new locations, and business models.
* Provide operational input into feasibility studies, financial projections, kitchen layouts, equipment requirements, and outlet design.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Projects, Procurement, Finance, HR, Marketing, and Facilities Management.
* Oversee pre-opening activities, including manpower planning, recruitment, procurement, training, SOP development, and operational readiness.
* Ensure new outlets achieve agreed launch timelines, operational standards, and commercial targets.

6. People Leadership & Organisational Development

* Lead, mentor, and develop senior operational leaders, restaurant managers, executive chefs, and other key personnel.
* Build a high-performing leadership structure across all F&B entities, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability.
* Drive succession planning, talent development, and workforce planning.
* Establish performance management frameworks and training programmes to strengthen operational capabilities.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure appropriate manpower structures and productivity levels across all outlets.

7. Stakeholder & Group Collaboration

* Work closely with Group leadership and senior management to align F&B objectives with wider business priorities.
* Provide regular performance updates, business insights, and recommendations to senior management.
* Develop and maintain relationships with suppliers, landlords, business partners, and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure effective coordination between F&B operations and centralised Group support functions.
* Support Group-level initiatives and contribute to broader business planning and strategic decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 12–15 years of experience within the hospitality and F&B industry, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-unit, multi-brand, or multi-entity F&B operations.
* Strong background in casual fine dining, premium casual dining, and full-service restaurant concepts.
* Proven track record of successfully scaling restaurant businesses, expanding outlet portfolios, and launching new concepts.
* Strong commercial acumen with demonstrated ownership of P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance.
* Extensive experience in end-to-end restaurant operations, including kitchen management, front-of-house, service delivery, procurement, and supply chain coordination.
* Proven ability to develop operational structures, implement SOPs, and establish scalable business processes.
* Experience in building, leading, and developing high-performing management teams.
* Strong understanding of UAE hospitality regulations, food safety standards, and local market dynamics.
* Previous experience within the UAE or GCC hospitality market is highly desirable.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strategic business planning and execution.
* Multi-unit and multi-brand operational leadership.
* Business expansion and scalability.
* Financial management and commercial acumen.
* P&L ownership and profitability management.
* Restaurant concept development and pre-opening management.
* Guest experience and service excellence.
* Operational transformation and process optimisation.
* Leadership development and talent management.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and decision-making capabilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The role will be measured against key business and operational performance indicators, including:

* Achievement of revenue, profitability, and annual budget targets.
* Improvement in outlet-level P&L performance and operating margins.
* Optimisation of food costs, labour costs, and operating expenses.
* Guest satisfaction, customer retention, and brand reputation.
* Successful execution and timely opening of new outlets.
* Operational consistency, food quality, and regulatory compliance.
* Employee retention, leadership development, and succession planning.
* Successful implementation of scalable operational systems and processes.
* Achievement of agreed business expansion and growth objectives.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a strategic yet hands-on F&B leader who has successfully managed and grown restaurant businesses within a multi-brand or multi-entity environment.

They should bring a strong understanding of casual fine dining, a commercially focused approach to business management, and the ability to balance operational excellence with sustainable growth.

Most importantly, they should have the vision and execution capabilities to build, structure, and scale an F&B portfolio while maintaining strong brand identities, exceptional guest experiences, and financial discipline.

Principal, Advisors & Consulting Services, Sub-Cluster Lead

The Services organization drives Mastercard's growth by providing innovative services to customers. Role –
  

* Engagement & Delivery Leadership – Lead project teams to deliver high-quality analyses, creative solutions, and actionable recommendations that generate tangible business value. Provide subject-matter or industry expertise and guide teams toward efficient, business-focused outcomes.

Core Competencies
  

* Passion – Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in guiding project teams toward delivering the highest-quality results and recommendations.
* Problem Solving – Leads teams to identify the most critical aspects of a problem and guides them to business-focused solutions and recommendations that drive client value; initiates course corrections where required.
* Analytic Excellence – Demonstrates strong structured-problem-solving and quantitative skills; ensures efficient use of technical capabilities regardless of context.
* Project Management – Deep interest in project delivery with business clients and strong intuition for how companies make decisions.
* Client Management – Inspires client confidence through timely, reliable execution; develops stakeholder management plans to align priorities and address support or resistance.
* Communication & Presence – Crafts clear, complete deliverables and communicates effectively—verbally and in writing—across complex scenarios up to senior management levels.
* Teamwork – Motivates medium-sized teams or key workstreams on regional engagements to produce superior deliverables while fostering open collaboration and a “will-to-win” attitude.
* Commercial Orientation – Identifies opportunities to leverage internal capabilities, including cross-sell opportunities beyond direct project work; partners with broader Services teams on contracting and solution design.
* Leadership – Instills a sense of urgency, ownership, empowerment, and thoughtful risk-taking in leaders at all levels; structures work to align with team members’ goals and motivators.
* Integrity – Models Mastercard’s values of honesty and integrity; follows through on commitments and holds others accountable to do the same.
* Diverse Perspective – Brings unique skills or approaches to every client engagement and internal activity.

**Qualifications**

* Undergraduate or master’s degree and significant post-graduate work experience in payments and consulting.
* Deep understanding of the KSA , including regulatory frameworks, competitive dynamics, and cultural nuances that influence financial services and payments adoption
* Strong knowledge of Mastercard’s products, data assets, and ecosystem partnerships, and how these capabilities create competitive advantage and drive client value in KSA
* Experience in coaching and leading teams across large, strategic consulting engagements that involve structured problem solving and stakeholder management
* Deep knowledge of business KPIs, financials, and organizational leadership
* Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills; proven ability to guide project teams to structure and resolve ambiguous client challenges.
* Demonstrated success in owning and developing relationships with mid- to executive-level client contacts, inspiring confidence in Mastercard as a trusted partner.
* Strong ability to communicate complex ideas effectively—both verbally and in writing—in English and local market language(s).
* Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, balancing thought with action while maximizing limited resources.
* Advanced proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Title: CHARTERING MANAGER – OIL & ENERGY TRADING
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONCHARTERING MANAGER – OIL & ENERGY TRADING

**Company:** NAFT Energies FZCO  
**Department:** Shipping & Chartering  
**Designation:** Chartering Manager / Senior Chartering Manager  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / Head of Trading  
**Experience Required:** 10–15+ years in oil tanker chartering, shipping and/or energy trading

1. Job Purpose

The Chartering Manager will be responsible for managing the company's complete vessel chartering activities in support of its international oil trading business.

The successful candidate must have extensive experience in the global oil and shipping industry, with a strong understanding of crude oil and petroleum product markets, international tanker movements, freight rates, vessel availability and shipping routes.

The individual will be responsible for identifying suitable vessels, negotiating chartering agreements, managing relationships with international shipowners and shipbrokers, monitoring freight market movements and ensuring that all shipping arrangements are commercially competitive and operationally efficient.

The candidate must bring substantial industry knowledge, established market relationships and the ability to independently handle complex chartering negotiations and transactions.

2. Detailed Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Oil Tanker Chartering and Vessel Booking**

* Manage the chartering of vessels for transporting crude oil, refined petroleum products and other energy commodities.
* Identify, evaluate and secure suitable vessels based on cargo volume, type of product, loading and discharge ports, delivery schedules and trading requirements.
* Source vessels through direct relationships with shipowners, ship operators and international shipbrokers.
* Handle spot chartering, voyage chartering and time chartering arrangements.
* Negotiate vessel availability, freight rates, laycan dates, loading windows and other commercial terms.
* Review vessel specifications, including carrying capacity, vessel age, technical suitability and cargo-handling capabilities.
* Coordinate vessel nominations and ensure that vessels are secured within the required trading schedules.
* Maintain a reliable database of available vessels, owners, brokers and shipping contacts.

**B. International Oil and Freight Market Knowledge**

* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of the international oil shipping and tanker markets.
* Monitor global freight rate movements and identify changes in vessel demand and availability.
* Understand major oil-producing regions, oil-exporting countries, importing markets and international shipping routes.
* Monitor developments in major trading and shipping hubs, including the Middle East, Asia, Europe, Africa and other key markets.
* Analyse the impact of geopolitical developments, sanctions, port restrictions, supply disruptions and changes in global oil demand on shipping costs and vessel availability.
* Keep management informed about freight market trends, shipping opportunities and potential risks.
* Provide recommendations on the most commercially beneficial shipping routes and chartering arrangements.

**C. Commercial Negotiations and Freight Cost Management**

* Negotiate competitive freight rates with shipowners, vessel operators and brokers.
* Review and negotiate charter party agreements and contractual shipping terms.
* Evaluate voyage costs, freight expenses, bunker costs, port charges and other associated shipping costs.
* Analyse voyage economics to determine the financial viability of different shipping arrangements.
* Negotiate demurrage rates, laytime provisions, cancellation terms and other commercial conditions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce freight costs and improve overall trading margins.
* Ensure that chartering decisions support the company's purchasing, sales and profitability objectives.
* Review freight quotations and provide commercial recommendations to management before finalizing fixtures.

**D. Shipowner, Shipbroker and Industry Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with international shipowners, shipbrokers, charterers and shipping companies.
* Establish direct connections with reputable tanker owners and operators across major international shipping markets.
* Build a strong network of reliable shipping partners to secure competitive vessel availability.
* Maintain relationships with key industry contacts to obtain market information, freight indications and vessel availability updates.
* Attend relevant oil, energy, shipping and commodity trading industry events.
* Identify new business contacts and develop strategic partnerships that support the company's international trading activities.
* Leverage existing industry relationships to obtain competitive commercial terms and timely vessel fixtures.

**E. Charter Party Agreements and Contract Management**

* Prepare, review, negotiate and administer charter party agreements.
* Understand different chartering structures, including Voyage Charter, Time Charter and, where relevant, Consecutive Voyage Charter arrangements.
* Review contractual provisions relating to freight payment, demurrage, dispatch, laytime, cargo handling, cancellation and vessel performance.
* Ensure that agreed commercial terms are properly reflected in the charter party documentation.
* Coordinate with the legal and commercial teams on contractual matters and disputes.
* Monitor contractual obligations and ensure compliance with agreed chartering conditions.
* Manage contractual issues arising from vessel delays, loading or discharge disruptions and other shipping-related disputes.

**F. Vessel Vetting, Due Diligence and Risk Management**

* Evaluate the suitability and reliability of vessels before confirming chartering arrangements.
* Review vessel particulars, ownership details, classification certificates, insurance and technical records.
* Ensure that vessels meet the required safety, technical and operational standards.
* Coordinate vessel vetting and approval processes with relevant parties.
* Conduct appropriate due diligence on shipowners, vessel operators and other counterparties.
* Ensure compliance with applicable international maritime regulations, sanctions, trade restrictions and company policies.
* Identify potential shipping, commercial, operational and counterparty risks.
* Avoid engaging vessels or counterparties that may expose the company to sanctions, compliance or reputational risks.

**G. Voyage Planning and Shipping Operations**

* Coordinate with the trading, operations and documentation teams to understand cargo requirements and shipment schedules.
* Ensure appropriate vessel arrangements are made for loading and discharging cargo.
* Monitor vessel movements from the loading port to the discharge port.
* Coordinate with shipowners, agents, terminals and other relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor loading and discharge schedules and address operational delays.
* Review Statements of Facts, Notice of Readiness and other relevant shipping documents.
* Monitor laytime calculations and manage demurrage or dispatch claims.
* Resolve shipping-related issues in coordination with the relevant departments.
* Ensure that shipments are completed within the agreed contractual and commercial timelines.

**H. Strategic Planning and Business Development**

* Develop and implement chartering strategies aligned with the company's oil trading activities.
* Identify opportunities in international tanker markets and new shipping routes.
* Evaluate opportunities for long-term vessel arrangements and strategic shipping partnerships.
* Advise management on market conditions, freight trends and chartering opportunities.
* Support the expansion of the company's crude oil and petroleum product trading activities.
* Provide market intelligence to support purchasing, selling and trading decisions.
* Identify opportunities to improve the company's shipping network, commercial efficiency and market competitiveness.

3. Required Industry Experience

The candidate must demonstrate:

* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience in the international oil, tanker chartering or shipping industry.
* Extensive practical experience in crude oil and/or petroleum product tanker chartering.
* Strong understanding of the international oil and freight markets.
* Proven experience in negotiating and concluding vessel chartering transactions.
* Direct exposure to international shipowners, shipbrokers and vessel operators.
* Strong knowledge of global tanker availability, freight rate movements and shipping routes.
* Experience handling charter party agreements and commercial shipping negotiations.
* Experience working with oil trading companies, energy companies, tanker operators or international shipping firms.

**Preferred industry exposure:**

* Crude Oil Tankers
* Petroleum Product Tankers
* Clean Petroleum Products (CPP)
* Dirty Petroleum Products (DPP)
* International Oil Trading
* Marine Transportation
* Tanker Chartering and Shipping

4. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Maritime Studies, Shipping Management, Logistics, International Trade, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional qualifications in shipping, chartering or maritime operations will be an advantage.
* Strong commercial and technical understanding of the international tanker industry is essential.

5. Technical Knowledge Required

The candidate should have a strong working knowledge of:

* International tanker chartering practices.
* Crude oil and petroleum product transportation.
* Voyage Charter and Time Charter arrangements.
* Charter Party Agreements.
* Freight calculations and voyage economics.
* Laytime, Demurrage and Dispatch.
* Vessel specifications and tanker classifications.
* Global shipping routes and major oil trading hubs.
* International maritime regulations and vessel vetting.
* Shipping documentation and cargo transportation procedures.
* Freight market analysis and industry pricing benchmarks.

6. Essential Skills and Competencies

* Exceptional commercial negotiation and deal-making abilities.
* Strong understanding of global oil and tanker markets.
* Established international industry network and business relationships.
* Excellent market intelligence and analytical capabilities.
* Ability to independently identify and secure suitable vessels.
* Strong commercial judgement and cost-control capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple chartering transactions simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure in a fast-moving oil trading environment.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed based on:

* Competitive freight rates achieved through successful negotiations.
* Number and quality of successfully concluded vessel fixtures.
* Reduction in avoidable freight expenses and demurrage costs.
* Timely vessel availability and cargo transportation.
* Quality and strength of international shipowner and broker relationships.
* Accuracy of freight market analysis and commercial recommendations.
* Effective management of chartering contracts and operational risks.
* Identification of new shipping opportunities and strategic partnerships.
* Compliance with vessel vetting and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Contribution to the company's overall oil trading profitability.

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a highly experienced oil and shipping industry professional who has spent a substantial part of their career in tanker chartering and international oil transportation.

The ideal candidate should have a strong reputation in the market, extensive knowledge of international freight movements, established relationships with major shipowners and brokers, and a proven ability to negotiate and execute commercially beneficial chartering transactions.

The individual must be commercially driven, well-connected within the oil industry and capable of bringing valuable market intelligence, business relationships and chartering expertise to the company.

**The position is intended for an established industry professional who can independently manage the company's chartering function and contribute directly to its international oil trading business.**

* Write and test standard recipe cards, plating guides and prep sheets for every menu item; lead the pre-opening tasting.

* Deliver every dish to brand specification: standard recipes, portion sizes, methods and presentation.

* Coordinate with the Bar Manager on shared fridge space, garnish prep and service flow.

--------------------------------------

* Store all products correctly with FIFO, labelling and date control.

* Hit the target food cost %; control waste with daily waste logs and use-first lists.
* Manage kitchen labour to the rota budget and approve overtime.
